jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer - Compute & Storage
jobs.description: **About Highrise AI** Highrise AI is a GPU\-native infrastructure platform built for modern AI workloads. Designed for developers and enterprises operating in performance\-critical and security\-sensitive environments, Highrise delivers scalable GPU compute across dedicated clusters, managed cloud, and confidential environments. Highrise combines bare\-metal performance with full\-stack orchestration, API\-driven access, and hardware\-enforced isolation to support training, fine\-tuning, and production\-scale deployment of AI models. From reserved GPU capacity to enterprise\-grade confidential compute, Highrise provides flexible infrastructure models tailored to the needs of builders operating at scale. Beyond infrastructure, Highrise integrates disciplined operations, advanced automation, and on\-site engineering expertise to sustain high uptime and predictable performance across deployments. These capabilities extend beyond Highrise\-owned fleets: through managed services, Highrise also operates third\-party GPU hardware on behalf of customers and partners, applying the same operational standards to infrastructure it does not own. Highrise is a subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp., an energy infrastructure platform. Hut 8 integrates power, digital infrastructure, and compute at scale. Highrise serves as the compute and operations layer—designing, deploying, and operating next\-generation GPU clusters from commissioning through production. **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are seeking a mid\-level AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer to provide Tier 2 operational support for large\-scale GPU compute and storage platforms. This hands\-on role focuses on owning technical tickets, restoring service, investigating recurring issues, and maintaining reliable day\-to\-day operation of production AI clusters. Working closely with the NOC, on\-site data hall technicians, SRE teams, and senior infrastructure engineers, the engineer will troubleshoot Linux\-based compute nodes, GPU systems, storage services, and their supporting software. Complex or systemic issues will be escalated to Tier 3 engineering with clear diagnostics and supporting evidence. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Tier 2 Incident and Ticket Management** * Own and manage escalated incidents, service requests, and problem tickets from initial technical triage through resolution, escalation, or documented handoff. * Diagnose compute and storage faults using system logs, monitoring dashboards, management interfaces, and approved diagnostic tools. * Assess severity and customer impact; coordinate with the NOC and site teams to restore service within operational and SLA targets. * Produce clear troubleshooting records, timely ticket updates, shift handovers, and actionable Tier 3 or OEM escalations. **Compute and GPU Platform Operations** * Troubleshoot Linux servers, GPU health alerts, boot failures, firmware/driver issues, hardware faults, and resource availability problems. * Support node provisioning, reimaging, configuration changes, routine maintenance, and return\-to\-service validation using established automation and runbooks. * Investigate Kubernetes and Slurm node or workload failures, working with platform engineers when application or scheduler\-level escalation is required. * Perform first\-level analysis of connectivity or GPU communication symptoms and engage network or Tier 3 engineers for deeper fabric and performance investigation. **Storage Operations and Troubleshooting** * Monitor and troubleshoot distributed and high\-performance storage systems, including capacity, throughput, availability, and client connectivity. * Investigate filesystem mount failures, storage\-node or disk alerts, degraded services, and access or performance complaints. * Execute approved recovery, maintenance, and component replacement workflows with storage vendors and data hall technicians. * Support operational tasks across file, object, and block storage platforms as deployed at Highrise sites. **Operational Readiness and Continuous Improvement** * Assist with upgrades, planned maintenance, cluster expansions, and validation activities following established change controls. * Maintain accurate asset, configuration, and ticket records; improve runbooks, troubleshooting checklists, and knowledge articles. * Identify recurring incidents and automate repeatable operational work with scripts and existing infrastructure management tools. * Collaborate with remote engineering teams, on\-site technicians, OEMs, and vendors to resolve issues safely and efficiently. **ABOUT YOU** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 3–6 years of experience supporting Linux servers, HPC, cloud, or data center infrastructure in a production environment. * Practical troubleshooting experience with enterprise compute hardware, BMC interfaces (iDRAC/iLO or equivalent), operating systems, and monitoring tools. * Working familiarity with storage technologies such as NFS, distributed filesystems, object storage, and storage performance fundamentals. * Experience using ticketing systems, change management procedures, and Bash or Python scripting for routine diagnostics and automation. * Exposure to NVIDIA GPU systems, InfiniBand/RDMA, Kubernetes, Slurm, or AI/HPC storage platforms is a strong advantage. **Core Competencies** * Structured, evidence\-driven troubleshooting with sound judgment on when to remediate, collaborate, or escalate. * Strong ownership of tickets, attention to operational detail, and commitment to reliable customer service. * Ability to work effectively across NOC, SRE, hardware, network, storage, and Tier 3 engineering teams. * Clear written and verbal communication in English. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This is a full\-time, engineering role supporting large\-scale AI compute infrastructure across multiple sites. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Flexibility to assist with critical incidents or maintenance activities outside regular business hours is expected. This role is hybrid or remote depending on location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT MAKES HIGHRISE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** At Highrise, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and production readiness of large\-scale AI clusters, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and help define the technical standards for a growing global AI infrastructure platform. At Highrise, you will have the opportunity to: * Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting * Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government * Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team * Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting\-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

jobs.title: AI Software Developer
jobs.description: Job Description Tech Build Dreams is listed as the company for this AI Software Developer position. This suggested job description is intended for a software developer who can build, integrate, and maintain applications powered by artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies. The AI Software Developer will collaborate with software engineers and project stakeholders to develop intelligent application features, integrate AI services, and improve software performance. The ideal candidate combines strong programming skills with an understanding of AI concepts, API integration, data processing, and responsible software development. Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, and maintain AI\-enabled software applications. * Build application features using programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. * Integrate AI models and third\-party AI services through APIs. * Develop and maintain backend services, application interfaces, and data\-processing workflows. * Collaborate with engineering and product teams to translate requirements into technical solutions. * Evaluate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, reliability, and suitability for intended use. * Develop testing procedures to identify software defects and improve application quality. * Troubleshoot performance issues involving application logic, APIs, and AI integrations. * Work with structured and unstructured data to support application functionality. * Follow secure coding practices and protect sensitive application data. * Maintain source code, technical documentation, and development records. * Participate in code reviews and recommend improvements to software architecture and maintainability. Requirements * Experience in software development, AI application development, or a related technical field. * Proficiency in Python or another suitable programming language. * Understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, and algorithms. * Familiarity with REST APIs, databases, and application integration. * Basic understanding of machine learning, generative AI, or large language model applications. * Experience with Git or another version\-control system. * Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to collaborate effectively and communicate technical concepts clearly. * Commitment to writing reliable, maintainable, and well\-tested code. Preferred Skills * Experience with AI frameworks or libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit\-learn. * Familiarity with large language model APIs, prompt design, and retrieval\-augmented generation. * Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search. * Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. * Understanding of AI evaluation, data privacy, security, and responsible AI practices. * Relevant education in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, or equivalent practical experience. About the Company Tech Build Dreams is the company name provided for this draft. Its current business operations, AI products, and presence in Miami, Florida, have not been independently verified. Confirm the company's identity, services, and actual technology focus before including specific company claims in a published job advertisement. Benefits Potential benefits may include health insurance, paid time off, retirement savings options, professional development, and opportunities to work on AI\-related projects. Actual benefits must be confirmed by the employer. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Website Builder
jobs.description: **About the company** Agentplace is a platform for building AI agents that serve customers: they answer questions, book appointments, handle customer service, and deliver services online. Based in San Francisco, featured in VentureBeat, USA Today, and Fast Company. **About the role** We're looking for an AI Agent Builder to create AI agents for real businesses on Agentplace: understand each business, design the interface and AI workflows, connect integrations, test, and publish. This isn't a classic developer role. It's about product and UX thinking, design taste, and shipping working products fast through vibe coding and no\-code. Freelancers and solo agencies welcome: keep your own clients and work with us on a contract basis. **What you'll do** * Dive into each client's business and understand their customers * Design the interface and user flows (UX/UI) * Build AI workflows: how the agent answers questions, helps choose a service, collects data, and drives users to booking or payment * Connect integrations via API (calendar, payments, CRM, messengers) * Test, refine, and publish AI agents **Who you are** You combine product and UX thinking with vibe coding or no\-code experience, a strong sense of design, and basic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and API skills. You might be: * A Framer or Webflow developer * A product designer who codes * A no\-code or automation builder (Zapier, Make, n8n) * A vibe coder shipping with Cursor, Lovable, Bolt, or Replit * A freelancer who builds chatbots and websites for clients * A junior solutions engineer **Details** * Format: remote * Type: contract, flexible hours * Compensation: up to $1,500/month **How to apply** To apply, complete a short test task. Plan on 1–2 hours. Pick any real business, look at its website, and build an AI agent for it on Agentplace. The agent should do more than look good. It should: * answer customer questions * help choose a service * collect customer details * guide the customer to booking or payment Build it here: agentplace.io. Use the Luna model, it's free. Publish your agent as public and send the link to **nikita@agentplace.io**. **Applications are reviewed by email only.** Applications sent through the job board's Apply button, without a link to your agent, will not be considered. We review applications quickly and will reach out to successful candidates with an offer. The best agents may be featured in our public agent gallery. Pay: From $1,500\.00 per month Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Change Management / Trend Engineer
jobs.description: **ROLE SUMMARY** The Change Management / Trend Engineer proactively identifies, evaluates, tracks and manages changes and emerging cost and schedule trends on Data Centers construction program before they become major financial or schedule exposures. Projects involve rapidly evolving designs, changing scopes, multiple contractors, aggressive schedules and significant capital commitments. The role brings structure and discipline to change management without slowing construction execution, and gives project leadership early visibility of exposure so decisions can be made quickly.**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES*** Identify and track emerging cost and schedule trends arising from design development, scope changes, field conditions, contractor claims, procurement changes and productivity issues. * Manage the full change lifecycle: trend notification, evaluation, approval, change order execution and incorporation into budgets and forecasts. * Establish and maintain change and trend registers, including scope descriptions, cost estimates, schedule impacts, status, ownership, approval requirements and supporting documentation. * Evaluate the financial impact of changes: review contractor estimates, validate quantities and rates, identify cost exposure and coordinate with Cost Engineering and Estimating. * Work with Scheduling and Construction to assess schedule impacts, including critical path exposure, delay, acceleration and sequencing changes. * Assess proposed changes against scope definitions, approved budgets and contract baselines to distinguish legitimate scope changes from design evolution and contractor obligations. * Review contractor change requests, validate supporting documentation, identify duplicate or unsupported costs and coordinate commercial and technical evaluations. * Coordinate with Cost Engineering so approved changes, pending changes and potential trends are reflected in forecasts and EAC with clear exposure visibility and no double counting. * Work with Contracts and Commercial teams on change provisions, notice requirements and entitlement, without assuming contractual approval authority. * Provide early visibility of exposure to project leadership; make preliminary assessments and refine them as information develops. * Challenge unsupported requests and follow up with stakeholders to drive changes to resolution. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE*** Strong change management, trend management, cost engineering or project controls background on large\-scale construction, power generation, data center, industrial, infrastructure or EPC projects. * Proven experience identifying and tracking cost and schedule trends. * Strong understanding of the change management lifecycle and of scope, baseline and budget management. * Experience evaluating cost impacts and contractor change orders. * Good understanding of EPC and construction contracts, including change provisions, notice requirements, entitlement principles and approval authorities. * Strong Excel and data management skills. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Omega 365 experience (change management, cost control, commitments and reporting modules). * Working knowledge of Primavera P6\. * Data center construction experience. **KEY COMPETENCIES*** Analytical and commercially aware * Adaptable when designs and priorities change and information is incomplete * Collaborative with Construction, Engineering, Contracts, Procurement, Cost Engineering, Scheduling, Estimating and contractors * Proactive, energetic and detail\-oriented; takes hands\-on ownership * Able to challenge unsupported requests while keeping productive working relationships **THE IDEAL CANDIDATE** The ideal candidate does more than maintain a change order log or process contractor requests. Effective change management begins well before a formal change order is submitted: this person recognizes potential exposure from evolving engineering, execution, procurement and contractor activity even when the full financial impact is not yet known, and balances commercial discipline with the realities of accelerated construction. Demonstrated change and trend experience on complex projects, sound commercial judgment and field awareness matter more than familiarity with any single software platform.**WORKING ENVIRONMENT** Fast\-paced construction program with aggressive schedules, rapidly evolving priorities and multiple contractors working concurrently. Hands\-on, site\-engaged role.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: **About This Role** ------------------- You'll be the second designer at SageOx, partnering closely with our Founding Designer — not joining a design org, not reporting into one. Before you apply, read **her post about what this actually feels like**. It's the most honest preview of this role that exists, including the uncomfortable parts. We're not looking for another generalist. We want a **T\-shaped designer**: exceptional at one thing — good enough to take part of our product somewhere none of us could have imagined — and strong enough to play across everything else. In the AI era, someone who is a rock star in one area can push out and have real influence in the others. SageOx doesn't live on one screen. It lives in the product people use every day, on the conference room screen a whole team looks at together, and in hardware that sits on the table. You'll design and build across all of it, along with the agentic design harness that lets every AI coworker on the team build the way you would. And you'll push us. We want someone who tells us we aren't thinking ambitiously enough about the experience — then ships the version that proves it. **What You'll Design and Build** -------------------------------- These are shipping surfaces, not concepts on a roadmap, and most of them have no obvious precedent. ### **The product itself** * **Design features end to end,** from your own user research to the shipped experience — web, desktop, mobile, CLI. Designers here write the production code. If you can't build it, the design doesn't ship. * **Memory you can walk up to.** What a team has said, decided, and built. Designing retrieval people trust — where a claim came from, what an AI coworker actually read — is an information\-design problem worthy of Tufte. * **Ambient coordination.** Murmurs — small signals from your coworkers, human and AI, that reach you without becoming another notification you resent. * **How people grow into SageOx.** We're breaking trail on human–AI collaboration, so the learning curve is part of the product: how people start, what nudges them next, and how they get more value over time. * **Talk to users, and use SageOx daily.** Everyone here does. Design from lived use. ### **Conference room screens** * **A room, cast to a screen.** A live conversation on the TV everyone is already looking at, legible from across the room. Different rules than anything designed for arm's length. * **A living mural.** A meeting draws itself as it happens, in front of everyone in the room. What should a thought look like thirty seconds after someone says it? Nobody knows yet. * **The room as a surface.** What a meeting room becomes when a team's memory and its AI coworkers are present in it, and how everyone in it can see and steer what's happening. ### **Hardware** * **A device with almost no screen.** The Ox Dot sits on the table and gives the hivemind a body in the room. Its whole vocabulary is presence, light, and sound. Every instinct you've built for a rectangle is the wrong instinct here. * **SageOx in the real world.** Packaging, unboxing, first run, and pairing — every moment someone holds something of ours in their hands. * **What comes next.** A watch, new devices, and whatever we decide to build after that. Work out what our patterns become on each one, and lead those builds. ### **The agentic design harness** * **Own the design system.** Components, tokens, patterns, and states across every surface above, built in code, with accessibility built in so every feature inherits it. * **Make it readable by AI coworkers.** Docs, skills, and rules that Claude Code reaches for before it invents something new. When an AI coworker gets it wrong, treat that as a gap in the harness and close it. Our litmus test: can a future AI coworker read the UI's state, change it correctly, and confirm the result with no human in the loop? * **Catch drift before users do.** Turn design rules into automated checks. Sample what shipped this week — at random, not curated — find the drift, codify the rule, automate it, and verify it stopped. The goal is a team that ships good design without a design approval gate. * **Turn the harness into product.** Parts of it become agentic tools we ship to customers, starting with design walkthrough tooling in our desktop app. **Location — Seattle, In Person** --------------------------------- **This job is done in person, in Seattle, five days a week.** Not remote. Not hybrid. Not "in person to start." At the speed we're moving, being in the same room is essential, and we strongly believe that magic happens when people are in the flow together working on ambitious problems. If you're looking for a remote or remote\-friendly role, please don't apply to this one — we'd rather you not spend the time. Two narrow situations we'll still talk to you about. Both are in person; neither is remote work: * **You'd be relocating to Seattle.** For select Staff/Principal\-level candidates, we may h . The title matters less than the evidence: what you built, and what happened to the product after. * **AI\-pilled, for real.** Claude Code, Claude Design, or your own stack is already your daily practice. You've built something AI coworkers use — a skill, an MCP server, a lint rule, a generator. Show us. * **Technically fluent, with craft.** At home in a codebase and in the terminal. You notice the empty state, the focus ring, and the error message. No CS degree required. * **Working software over polished mockups.** You balance speed with taste. In an age of AI slop, that often means editing and systematizing rather than producing more. * **Curious sideways.** Why a mic distorts, how an index works, what makes an animation feel expensive. * **Ownership, low ego.** You own outcomes, make things happen with limited resources, and find direction in early\-stage ambiguity. Strong opinions in crit, open to new perspectives. * **You believe in what we're building.** A world where people and AI coworkers work as one team — and you want to be the one designing it. ### **Great to Have** * Hardware, industrial, or packaging design experience on a product that shipped. * Interfaces for large shared screens: TVs, conference rooms, signage. * An engineering background, or time at a developer\-tools company. * Growth or onboarding experience — designing education and activation. * Founder or early\-employee experience somewhere that grew fast. **You Might Not Be a Fit If** ----------------------------- * The best part of your week is a pixel\-perfect spec that someone else implements. * Your portfolio is all mockups and case studies, with nothing you built yourself. * You'd rather go wide on everything than go deep on anything. * Watching an AI coworker write your code makes you anxious rather than curious. * Design review, to you, is a gate you hold. Here it never blocks a ship — we ship, then reconcile with a loop, so no human sits in the critical path. None of that is a knock on great designers. It's just not this job. **How We Hire** --------------- No whiteboard interviews, no take\-home redesign of somebody's app. We start with your portfolio. Clear an initial assessment and we'll invite you to a work trial: 3–5 days, full\-time, in person in Seattle, building something real alongside the team, the way the team actually works. It's paid, and the terms are agreed with you up front. Most of what either side needs to know about fit shows up in those few days, and it goes both ways — you learn as much about us as we do about you. Before applying, please **learn more about our work trials**. Ajit, our CEO, wrote up why we replaced interviews with this, including the uncomfortable math behind it: **Read the post** **SageOx Today** ---------------- $15M seed led by Canaan, with A.Capital, Pioneer Square Labs, and Founders' Co\-op. Founded by Ajit Banerjee (AWS EC2/EBS, XetHub Hugging Face), Ryan Snodgrass (early Amazon, Kindle/AWS\-scale cloud systems), and Milkana Brace (EVP Product at Remitly) — people who've built this kind of infrastructure, and scaled through an acquisition or two, before. We're small on purpose, hiring our first ten. **More about the team** **Compensation** ---------------- Competitive salary and meaningful equity. We'll talk specifics once we know it's a real mutual fit. That's what the trial is for. **Apply** --------- There's no shortage of comfortable places to design software right now. This is not one of them, and that's the point. **Include your portfolio, and lead with your spike.** Show us the one area where you're exceptional, then the things you built yourself — an app, a tool, a device, a live site, a skill or MCP server — next to the design work behind them. For each, tell us what you made, how you built it, and what happened after. A repo or a live link beats a polished case study. ***We're not working with recruiters or recruiting agencies/consultants at this time — direct applications only, please.***

jobs.title: Founding AI Agent Engineer
jobs.description: **tl;dr/Overview:** =================== At Alleviate Health we’re building AI Agents that drastically accelerate clinical trials by autonomously communicating with patients to recruit them into trials and support them over years, pruning billions in excess spend. We’re solving the problem that keeps execs at the largest $100B\+ Pharma companies up at night. We bootstrapped to winning some of the largest enterprise accounts in the market and are seeing massive market pull. We’ve now raised a $4\.3M seed round led by a16z and are hiring a world\-class team to solve the largest problem in drug development and win one of the largest opportunities in AI – while slashing the time it takes to bring life\-changing medicines to the patients who desperately need them. **Context:** ------------ Conducting a clinical trial is the most complex and broken, but also the most high‑stakes and capital intensive, problem of our era. To bring a life\-saving medicine from the lab bench to patients, pharma companies spend **tens of billions a year** for research sites to **qualify \& screen hundreds of thousands of patients and then to stay in contact with those patients over years.** Approximately 80% of clinical trials are delayed due to problems with recruitment and between $600,000 and $8 million is lost for each day a trial is delayed. This enormous, labor\-intensive struggle of screening, recruitment, and retention of patients across thousands of small research sites in every single trial is the foundational bottleneck in clinical trials. **About Alleviate:** -------------------- At Alleviate we've built SOTA AI Agents that autonomously recruit \& retain patients in trials. Currently, our AI agents conduct over 100,000 conversations every month by: * Intelligently screening \& routing patients to the right trials. * Collecting necessary data for the trial from patients multiple times per week. * Answering patients’ questions perfectly and supporting them 24/7 throughout the trial \- reducing costly drop\-offs. * Continuously learning from each interaction to optimize performance. Our team worked at a small research site for months to understand the problem deeply \- personally calling and speaking to patients \- and then **bootstrapped to working with some of the largest clinical research organizations** in the world and conducting over a 100k conversations per month. **Some vitals on Alleviate (Achieved without a single dollar raised):** ----------------------------------------------------------------------- * **Hypergrowth**. We’re growing rapidly MoM (both within existing \& new accounts). We’ve landed (and realized) multiple 6 figure deals. Our largest live contract has an annual value of \>$350k. * **Our win rate on commercial deals is \>92%.** We’re the market leading solution \- we’ve never lost a deal to competitors and have actively poached multiple customers from competitors. * **Our market is gigantic and immensely painful.** We can’t mention their names publicly but have landed pilots with top 20 pharma(s) that will grow to $XM\+/yr. Our pipeline grows organically due to customer fear of falling behind after hearing from our existing customers. **Investors (a16z, Jack Altman…):** ----------------------------------- We’re now backed by Andreessen Horowitz and other investors like Jack Altman (Co\-Founder of Lattice), Zach Weinberg (Co\-Founder of Flatiron Health, the largest Pharma tech exit of all time), Ali Rowghani (Former CFO \& COO of Twitter), Trey Holterman (CEO \& Co\-Founder of Tennr) and many others who’ve built category defining healthcare \& pharma companies. **What you might work on:** --------------------------- * Orchestrating a fleet of AI agents that coordinate patient recruitment across hundreds of clinical trials across North America (For now). * Scaling language models across Voice, SMS, and email while keeping conversations consistent and personalized across all channels. We’re going after the largest problem in one of the largest markets in the world. We already replace tens of millions in excess spend and will replace billions of dollars of excess spend while slashing the time it takes to bring life\-changing medicines to the patients who desperately need them. We’re looking for exceptional founding engineers to help us realize this ambition. If you’re an engineer that finds this goal compelling, we'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Multiple U.S. Locations - Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE) - Electrical - All Levels
jobs.description: **About Us** Apollo is a Mission\-Critical Infrastructure Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Operations Support Services Company. We serve mission\-critical industries globally with commissioning, emergency response, operations support, and owner's representative services. Apollo is currently executing projects in multiple states in the United States, in Canada and Brazil. Since our inception, we have built a commissioning firm based on trust, one relationship at a time. We hire the best people who can handle critical systems, love challenges, and thrive in a dynamic environment. We focus on understanding each client's needs and are relentless in meeting them. **Location** Multiple U.S. Locations – Atlanta, GA; Ashburn, VA; Chicago, IL; Phoenix, AZ; Columbus, OH; Portland, OR; Jackson, MS **Job Description** We are seeking skilled and motivated professionals of all experience levels to join our team as Data Center Electrical Commissioning Engineers (CxEs). The Electrical CxE will commission electrical systems in data centers, ensuring they meet top performance and reliability standards. This role requires a deep understanding of mission\-critical environments, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively under pressure. All newly hired team members entering Apollo’s Commissioning Engineer career path begin in the role of Commissioning Engineer in Training (Cx\-EIT). In this role, team members develop and apply technical commissioning knowledge, engineering judgment, and field experience through structured project execution, mentorship, and progressive responsibility within mission\-critical environments. Cx\-EIT team members actively contribute to project execution activities, including technical reviews, systems evaluations, commissioning documentation development, field inspections, functional testing, issue identification and resolution support, and coordination with project stakeholders. Upon successful demonstration of technical competency, achievement of qualification and performance milestones, and management approval, team members may progress into the role of Electrical Commissioning Engineer. Progression timing may vary based on individual performance, project experience, business needs, and completion of required development objectives. Activities will include but are not limited to testing and/or validation of transformers, electrical switchgear, Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) units, Static Transfer Switch (STS) units, Power Distribution Units (PDU), electrical distribution equipment, Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), and Building Management and Automation Systems (BMS). This role involves supporting data center construction/commissioning activities, so working hours may include nights and/or weekends. This is an onsite, client\-facing role that may require approximately 90% or more travel to various client locations. **Education** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, equivalent professional experience or experience in a related field (including but not limited to electrical field service technician, data center technician or military). **Key Responsibilities** * Conduct commissioning activities for electrical and EPMS/BMS systems in data centers. * Create and implement detailed commissioning plans, procedures, and checklists for Level 2, Level 3, Level 4, and Level 5 systems. * Review and evaluate design documents, submittals, and equipment specifications. * Conduct site inspections, functional performance tests, and system verifications. * Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations. * Work closely with project teams, including contractors, engineers, and data center operators, to maintain schedule. * Diagnose and resolve system performance, reliability, and safety issues. * Document results/findings and generate comprehensive commissioning reports. * Maintain open and current communication with the client about the status of the project. * Provide training and support to data center staff on system operation and maintenance. * Ensure adherence to industry standards, codes, and regulations. * Attend project meetings and offer technical expertise. * Other duties as assigned. **Physical Demands** The following physical demands must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions: * Frequently manipulating, moving, or grasping small parts, devices, or tools. * Frequently required to remain in a stationary position. * Frequently moving through office areas, critical facilities and other environments, including tight and confined spaces. * Exposure to low/high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind. * Working and walking on different types of terrain on active construction sites (e.g., concrete flooring, gravel, unpaved roads). * Frequently ascending and descending stairs and ladders to access equipment. * Occasionally positioning oneself under or over equipment. * Occasionally moving equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. **Qualifications** * Proven experience in commissioning, designing, or constructing electrical systems, especially in data centers or mission\-critical environments. * Extensive knowledge of electricity systems, medium\-to\-low voltage electrical distribution systems, power generation systems, UPS systems and control systems. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and clients. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Ability to read and interpret construction documents, specifications and engineering design drawings. * Ability to read and operate electrical test equipment. * Skilled in using commissioning software and tools, including MS Office Suite; Mid\-Level and Experienced\-Level candidates should also be proficient with Procore and CxAlloy. * Ability to travel to different data center locations as needed. **Experience Levels** * **Entry\-Level:** 0\-1 years of experience in commissioning or a related field, with a focus on mission\-critical facilities. * **Mid\-Level:** 2\-5 years of experience with demonstrated project management capabilities and a solid understanding of data center systems. * **Experienced\-Level:** 6\+ years of experience, with extensive knowledge of complex mission\-critical systems and leadership experience. **Prerequisites for Employment** * Successful background check, including pre\-employment drug screening * US citizens, permanent residents or any candidate with eligibility to work in the US **What We Offer** Apollo offers its employees a full benefits package, including: * Health and wellness plans (medical, dental, vision, life, disability) * Flexible spending accounts * Paid time off, holidays, and more * Paid parental leave * 401K plan with immediate match benefits * Employee assistance programs * Tuition reimbursement programs Employee discount programs * Apollo challenges the brightest, most talented, and driven individuals in the industry by providing an environment that embraces initiative, diversity, and achievement. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer supporting women, minorities, veterans and people with disabilities. We participate in the Department of Homeland Security E\-Verify program.

The Mechanical CxE will commission mechanical systems in data centers, ensuring they meet top performance and reliability standards. This role requires a deep understanding of mission\-critical environments, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively under pressure. All newly hired team members entering Apollo’s Commissioning Engineer career path begin in the role of Commissioning Engineer in Training (Cx\-EIT). In this role, team members develop and apply technical commissioning knowledge, engineering judgment, and field experience through structured project execution, mentorship, and progressive responsibility within mission\-critical environments. Cx\-EIT team members actively contribute to project execution activities, including technical reviews, systems evaluations, commissioning documentation development, field inspections, functional testing, issue identification and resolution support, and coordination with project stakeholders. Upon successful demonstration of technical competency, achievement of qualification and performance milestones, and management approval, team members may progress into the role of Mechanical Commissioning Engineer. Progression timing may vary based on individual performance, project experience, business needs, and completion of required development objectives. Activities will include but are not limited to testing and/or validation of chillers, water loops/components, cooling distribution equipment, air handling units (AHUs), air conditioning units, fan coil units (FCUs), pumps, heat exchangers, cooling towers, humidification systems and Building Management and Automation Systems (BMS). Note, the Mechanical CxE should also have knowledge of the electrical components involved in the above mechanical systems, including electrical motors (for pumps, fans, and compressors), motor control centers (MCCs), automatic transfer switches (ATSs), variable frequency drives (VFDs), Control Panels, and electrical supply systems. This role involves supporting data center construction/commissioning activities, so working hours may include nights and/or weekends. This is an onsite, client\-facing role that may require approximately 90% or more travel to various client locations. **Education** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, equivalent professional experience or experience in a related field (including but not limited to mechanical field service technician, data center technician or military). **Key Responsibilities** * Conduct commissioning activities for mechanical systems, their electrical components and BMS systems in data centers. * Create and implement detailed commissioning plans, procedures, and checklists for Level 2, Level 3, Level 4, and Level 5 systems. * Review and evaluate design documents, submittals, and equipment specifications. * Conduct site inspections, functional performance tests, and system verifications. * Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations. * Work closely with project teams, including contractors, engineers, and data center operators. * Help accomplish team goals both on\-site and remotely as necessary. * Diagnose and resolve system performance, reliability, and safety issues. * Document results/findings and generate comprehensive commissioning reports. * Provide support to data center staff on system operation and maintenance. * Ensure adherence to industry standards, codes, and regulations. * Attend project meetings and offer technical expertise as needed to help accomplish team goals. * Other duties as assigned. **Physical Demands** The following physical demands must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions: * Frequently manipulating, moving, or grasping small parts, devices, or tools. * Frequently required to remain in a stationary position. * Frequently moving through office areas, critical facilities and other environments, including tight and confined spaces. * Exposure to low/high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind. * Working and walking on different types of terrain on active construction sites (e.g., concrete flooring, gravel, unpaved roads). * Frequently ascending and descending stairs and ladders to access equipment. * Occasionally positioning oneself under or over equipment. * Occasionally moving equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. **Qualifications** * Proven experience in commissioning, designing, or constructing mechanical systems, especially in data centers or mission\-critical environments. * Extensive knowledge of HVAC, electrical supply systems, and control systems. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and clients. * Excellent problem\-solving skills, adaptability and attention to detail. * Ability to read and interpret construction documents and specifications. * Skilled in using commissioning software and tools, including MS Office Suite; Mid\-Level and Experienced\-Level candidates should also be proficient with Procore and CxAlloy. * Ability to travel to different data center locations as needed. **Experience Levels** * **Entry\-Level:** 0\-1 years of experience in commissioning or a related field, with a focus on mission\-critical facilities. * **Mid\-Level:** 2\-5 years of experience with demonstrated project management capabilities and a solid understanding of data center systems. * **Experienced\-Level:** 6\+ years of experience, with extensive knowledge of complex mission\-critical systems and leadership experience. **Prerequisites for Employment** * Successful background check, including pre\-employment drug screening * US citizens, permanent residents or any candidate with eligibility to work in the US **What We Offer** Apollo offers its employees a full benefits package, including: * Health and wellness plans (medical, dental, vision, life, disability) * Flexible spending accounts * Paid time off, holidays, and more * Paid parental leave * 401K plan with immediate match benefits * Employee assistance programs * Tuition reimbursement programs Employee discount programs * Apollo challenges the brightest, most talented, and driven individuals in the industry by providing an environment that embraces initiative, diversity, and achievement. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer supporting women, minorities, veterans and people with disabilities. We participate in the Department of Homeland Security E\-Verify program.

jobs.title: Principal AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Highrise AI** Highrise AI is a GPU\-native infrastructure platform built for modern AI workloads. Designed for developers and enterprises operating in performance\-critical and security\-sensitive environments, Highrise delivers scalable GPU compute across dedicated clusters, managed cloud, and confidential environments. Highrise combines bare\-metal performance with full\-stack orchestration, API\-driven access, and hardware\-enforced isolation to support training, fine\-tuning, and production\-scale deployment of AI models. From reserved GPU capacity to enterprise\-grade confidential compute, Highrise provides flexible infrastructure models tailored to the needs of builders operating at scale. Beyond infrastructure, Highrise integrates disciplined operations, advanced automation, and on\-site engineering expertise to sustain high uptime and predictable performance across deployments. These capabilities extend beyond Highrise\-owned fleets: through managed services, Highrise also operates third\-party GPU hardware on behalf of customers and partners, applying the same operational standards to infrastructure it does not own. Highrise is a subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp., an energy infrastructure platform. Hut 8 integrates power, digital infrastructure, and compute at scale. Highrise serves as the compute and operations layer—designing, deploying, and operating next\-generation GPU clusters from commissioning through production. **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are seeking a senior, hands\-on AI Cluster Integration Engineer to bring large\-scale GPU compute clusters from physical installation to validated, commercially ready production. Working alongside a team of senior infrastructure engineers, this person will own critical elements of cluster bring\-up, bare\-metal provisioning, advanced systems configuration, performance optimization, and acceptance testing. After deployment, the engineer will provide Tier 3 technical escalation and sustained performance support for operating clusters. The focus is on compute\-platform readiness and workload performance rather than primary ownership of network switch and fabric configuration. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Cluster Bring\-Up and Systems Integration** * Lead technical bring\-up of materially complete, racked, powered, and cabled AI clusters through production readiness and customer handoff. * Establish and validate system baselines across BIOS/BMC, firmware, GPU drivers, operating systems, and cluster software stacks. * Deploy and optimize automated bare\-metal provisioning, imaging, node configuration, and lifecycle workflows at scale. * Configure and troubleshoot advanced Linux and GPU systems, including kernel, driver, accelerator, and host\-level performance settings. * Integrate and validate Kubernetes and Slurm environments in partnership with platform, networking, and operations engineers. **Performance Engineering and Acceptance** * Execute NVIDIA Field Diagnostics, L11/L12 validation, burn\-in, stability, and hardware health qualification procedures. * Run and analyze NCCL collective communication tests, GPU benchmarks, and distributed workload performance at node, rack, and cluster scale. * Troubleshoot GPU, NVLink/NVSwitch, PCIe, RDMA, and InfiniBand/Ethernet performance issues, partnering with network engineers on fabric\-related remediation. * Identify configuration bottlenecks and optimize throughput, latency, scaling efficiency, and cluster reliability. * Own technical acceptance criteria, test evidence, defect tracking, remediation verification, and readiness recommendations for commercial service. **Tier 3 Operations and Reliability** * Serve as a senior escalation point for complex production incidents involving compute nodes, GPU software, provisioning, scheduling, and degraded performance. * Perform deep root cause analysis, coordinate vendor engineering escalations, and lead corrective actions for recurring or systemic issues. * Support fleet\-level upgrades, configuration changes, cluster expansions, and post\-maintenance validation with appropriate change controls. * Develop diagnostic tooling, automation, runbooks, and operational handoff material for SRE, NOC, and site support teams. **Cross\-Functional Execution** * Work closely with infrastructure engineering, site operations, OEMs, and software/platform teams to resolve cross\-stack issues and meet delivery milestones. * Provide concise technical status, benchmark findings, risks, and acceptance recommendations to engineering leadership and stakeholders. **ABOUT YOU** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of hands\-on Linux systems engineering, HPC, cloud, or large\-scale infrastructure experience, including senior\-level troubleshooting. * Proven experience bringing GPU or HPC clusters into production and qualifying systems against performance and reliability targets. * Strong expertise in Linux, automation (Python/Bash/Ansible), bare\-metal provisioning, configuration management, and systems diagnostics. * Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPU platforms, NCCL, Field Diagnostics, and multi\-node performance testing. * Practical experience with Kubernetes and Slurm; familiarity with high\-speed Ethernet, InfiniBand/RDMA, and parallel or distributed storage. **Core Competencies** * Deep technical curiosity and the ability to isolate difficult problems across hardware, firmware, operating systems, and distributed workloads. * Strong ownership of outcomes, with a systematic approach to testing, documentation, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement. * Comfortable collaborating with highly experienced peer engineers while driving independent technical decisions and execution. * Clear communication with engineering leadership, vendors, site personnel, and customer\-facing stakeholders. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This is a full\-time, engineering role supporting large\-scale AI compute infrastructure across multiple sites. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Flexibility to assist with critical incidents or maintenance activities outside regular business hours is expected. This role is hybrid or remote depending on location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT MAKES HIGHRISE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** At Highrise, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and production readiness of large\-scale AI clusters, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and help define the technical standards for a growing global AI infrastructure platform. At Highrise, you will have the opportunity to: * Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting * Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government * Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team * Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting\-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Ad Platforms is responsible for Disney’s industry\-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in Disney’s sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms. **Job Summary:** As Principal Data Engineer for Marketing and Consumer Data, you will serve as the senior technical leader for Identity and Device data products — including Identity360 and related consumer identifier datasets — that underpin marketing measurement, activation, and analytics across Disney Entertainment \& ESPN. You will define technical direction, drive complex cross\-system initiatives, establish engineering standards, and mentor leads and senior engineers, while partnering with onshore squad leaders, product, and enterprise architecture to deliver reliable batch and near\-real\-time data at petabyte scale. **Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:** * Define and drive technical strategy for Identity \& Device data products within Marketing and Consumer Data — including pipeline architecture, platform patterns, and modernization roadmap in partnership with onshore squad leaders and enterprise architecture. * Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex, high\-impact initiatives across Identity360, device/consumer identifier datasets, and dependent Marketing data products — setting technical approach, sequencing, and quality bar for other engineers. * Serve as principal SME and escalation point for identity foundational data — data modeling, batch and near\-real\-time processing, performance at scale, and production reliability — including participation in on\-call rotation and incident leadership for critical pipelines. * Establish and uphold engineering standards for the Identity \& Device team and Marketing Data Engineering — code quality, CI/CD, observability, data governance (GDPR, RTBF, CCPA), and reusable platform patterns across Databricks, AWS, and orchestration tooling. * Mentor and develop engineers through design reviews, pairing, and coaching — building depth in big\-data engineering, identity domain knowledge, and operational excellence. * Partner cross\-functionally with Product, QA, Operations, Privacy/Legal, and peer Marketing data squads (Data Collection, Activation, Acquisition) to align requirements, resolve cross\-domain dependencies, and represent Bangalore technical decisions to stakeholders. **Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:** Basic Qualifications * 10\+ years of related big data engineering jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Computer Vision & Edge AI
jobs.description: **QQR LABS** **Principal Engineer, Computer Vision \& Edge AI** **Fort Worth, TX / Cincinnati, OH / Austin, TX (full relocation covered) or Remote, US \| Full\-time** **$220,000 to $280,000 base \+ 20 to 25% milestone bonus** Freight fraud and cargo theft drain tens of billions of dollars a year from the US supply chain, and the industry still verifies trucks with paperwork. QQR Labs is building its first product where machine vision meets physical freight. The full scope and excitement of what we are building will be shared during the interview process. QQR Labs is the technology arm of QQR Freight, a platform whose sister companies include an asset\-based motor carrier and a nationwide 3PL brokerage. We are not a pitch deck. There are trucks, lanes, revenue, and customers behind this, which means a real\-world proving ground and a built\-in first customer from day one. We are hiring the first engineer on the product, and you will own it end to end: the hardware in the field, the models on the edge, and the platform customers log into. **What you will build** * Ruggedized capture hardware: industrial cameras, IR illumination, Jetson\-class GPU compute, cellular backhaul, weatherproof enclosures built for unattended outdoor duty * On\-device ML: detection, classification, and OCR on vehicles at highway speed, day and night * The data platform: high\-volume ingestion, entity resolution, search, alerting, APIs * The data engine: auto\-labeling pipelines, continuous retraining, and evaluation loops fed by real\-world captures * Fleet tooling: provisioning, over\-the\-air updates, and health monitoring for hardware deployed far from a desk **Requirements** **Who we want** * You have shipped computer vision on real hardware in the real world, not just in a notebook. Detection, tracking, OCR, deployed where weather, vibration, and glare live. * A camera\-first mindset: multi\-camera perception, vision\-only stacks, and models that hold up in rain, glare, and darkness * Edge and embedded fluency: Linux on ARM, camera pipelines (GStreamer or similar), model optimization (TensorRT, ONNX, quantization) * Cloud and data competence: Python, AWS or GCP, streaming ingestion, practical MLOps * You make hardware decisions, work without a playbook, and own outcomes * If you have built vision systems that live outdoors or on vehicles at scale, you already know this class of problem. Come build one where you hold real skin in the game. **Benefits** **The package** * $220,000 to $280,000 base, plus a 20 to 25% annual bonus tied to build milestones (first unit live in the field, accuracy targets, deployment count) * Long\-term upside beyond salary, covered in the interview process. We want an owner, not an employee. * Full relocation to Fort Worth, Cincinnati, or Austin, or remote (US) with regular time at HQ and in the field * Visa sponsorship available, including H\-1B transfers * A funded hardware lab and field deployment budget from day one * You interview with, and report to, the CEO

jobs.description: AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. Realm\-X serves as both a **foundation for internal teams to build and scale AI\-powered products**, and a **core layer delivering intelligent, high\-impact experiences directly to our customers**. At its core, Realm\-X is built on a **structured domain ontology and a set of shared business primitives**—such as transactions, actions, reports, metrics, and skills—that enable AI systems to deeply understand and operate across the full context of property management workflows. direction. * **Influence:** You've led or influenced large, cross\-team technical initiatives. * **Originality:** You introduce new ideas, architectures, or paradigms — not just implement existing decision\-making under partial observability. * Experience designing evaluation and benchmarking systems for AI. * Background in distributed systems and real\-time architectures. * Experience building site. Our innovative platform and trusted partnership enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, and grow their business. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend/Infra [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== At Concurrence, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payers, and government agencies run their patient\-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre\-visit intake, care navigation, post\-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction. Unlike single\-purpose chatbots or scribes, Concurrence is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments, and not just one narrow use case. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you. **About this role** =================== As a Senior Backend/Infra Engineer at Amigo, you'll build the core services behind our agent platform. The systems you own handle millions of conversations a month, so concurrency, reliability, and clean design are the job itself, not an afterthought. You'll own services end to end, from design through production. **What you'll do** ================== * Designing high\-throughput services that handle concurrent conversations at scale * Owning a core platform service from design to production * Building systems that stay available and degrade gracefully when things fail * Handling sensitive healthcare data with the care it requires * Improving performance, observability, and operational health across services * Shaping architectural decisions as the platform grows * Think carefully and holistically about system design under time pressure. **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've built and operated production backend systems at scale and owned the outcome * You're strong with concurrency, distributed systems, and service design * You prefer simple, maintainable solutions to hard problems * You debug well across services, queues, and databases * You're low ego, direct, and hold yourself to a high bar * You can work on site in New York City or San Francisco **Nice to have** ================ * Experience in a regulated or high\-reliability domain (healthcare, finance, legal) * High\-throughput or low\-latency system design * Experience with production AI or ML systems **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $220K \- $260K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Tools
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Expand human ambition in the physical world. *Critical infrastructure is constrained by labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and operational complexity. Watney builds and deploys autonomous robotic systems that increase the speed and capacity of buildout, starting with data centers.* **About the Role** ================== At Watney, a tools engineer builds the tools that turn what our robots record in the field into data our models learn from. Engineers use the same tools to match a change in a robot’s telemetry to the moment an error happened. What a robot should learn from a day of real work is still an open question: which moments are worth training on, and which labels hold up under review. Some of our best labels come from records captured on site while the robots work. Data quality is model quality here. You will own the tools that decide what goes into a training set, and what those tools reveal about the data shapes where our R\&D goes next. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Own the viewer engineers use to play back a robot’s data and line up telemetry with errors. * Own dataset curation: the dataset API and the tools engineers use to find and group episodes and build training sets. * Build annotation tooling with the rest of the software team, and weigh what we build against what we buy. * Build the quality review process for annotated data. * Work with the ML team who train on this data, the engineers who debug the fleet with it, and the annotators who label it. **You May Be a Good Fit If You:** ================================= * Have built an internal tool that became the way a team works. * Have built visualization or analysis tools for large volumes of sensor and video data. * Have built dataset tooling or a data pipeline that ML engineers train from. * Have designed a labeling or review workflow that people use to annotate data at volume. We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you’re passionate about robotics but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply! **Curious to learn more?** ========================== Follow us here on**X**and**LinkedIn**

There are 850,000 franchises in the US, constituting a $921B industry. Creeda is growing very fast, so we are looking for the brightest engineers to help us execute. **The role** You'll start by building. We need a strong generalist who can work anywhere in the stack, front end to back end to data, and make the platform better wherever it needs it most. Some weeks that's shipping a feature a customer is waiting on, some weeks it's fixing an integration that breaks a bookkeeper's close, some weeks it's making onboarding faster so a firm can bring over hundreds of locations instead of fifty. You take a problem and own it end to end. As we sign larger firms, the job will become more of a FDE role. You'll fly out, sit with their accountants, watch how they actually work, and build automations on site that go straight into production. Their bookkeepers describe what they need, you build it that week, and every firm serving that brand gets it. Half engineer, half the person our customers call when they want something built. This is one of the highest\-leverage seats at Creeda. You'll see the customer, write the code, and ship the fix in the same day. Who this is not for * Engineers who want clean specs and a well\-defined surface. There is no such thing here yet. * Engineers who do not want to talk to customers. Roughly a third of this job is people. * Engineers who want to work only on the interesting parts. The data cleaning is not a phase we are going to grow out of; it is the product. What we are looking forRequired * Strong backend engineering in TypeScript or Python. We run both (TypeScript on Node and Next.js for the product, workers and importers; Python for the classifier and ML training) on Postgres. You need to be strong in one and willing to work in the other. * Real experience with data that was not made for you: documents meant for humans (PDFs, spreadsheets a bookkeeper has already edited), vendor exports, third\-party APIs that contradict themselves. * Enough rigor to work on financial data, where being approximately right is being wrong. You should be able to explain why a balance check passing proves the arithmetic and not the entry. * Judgment about code\*\*.\*\* We build with AI coding agents, and they are fast enough that the bottleneck has moved to review. You need software design fundamentals strong enough to look at generated code and say precisely why it is wrong. You should be good at the other end of it too, setting constraints up front so the agent produces something reviewable in the first place. * Clear written communication. Every area of the codebase carries its own orientation doc, read by the next engineer and by the AI coding agents we build with, and we treat that documentation as an asset. * Willingness to travel periodically once phase two begins, several multi\-day trips per quarter Helpful, not required * Putting ML or LLM output into production behind hard constraints, where the model is allowed to be wrong but the system is not * Double\-entry bookkeeping. You know what a journal entry is and why it has to balance. * Accounting, fintech, POS, payroll or ERP background * QuickBooks Online's API, Plaid, or any general ledger system * Having worked somewhere small enough that titles did not decide who did what We do not require a CS degree, and we do not care where you worked before. We care that you have built something that had to be right. Details * **Location:** New York City * **Visa:** We can accept CPT/OPT but unfortunately cannot sponsor H1B Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10018

jobs.title: Staff Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Expand human ambition in the physical world. *Critical infrastructure is constrained by labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and operational complexity. Watney builds and deploys autonomous robotic systems that increase the speed and capacity of buildout, starting with data centers.* **About the Role** ================== At Watney, firmware engineers write the firmware for our robots’ mainboards and actuators, and bring up new boards with our manufacturing partners. They work with our mechanical, electrical, and ML teams as new sensors and embodiments arrive. How far firmware can take a robot on its own is still an open question: which faults a board can recover from without a person, and how one design carries across new boards and embodiments. The firmware you write sets how reliable and safe every robot is. The architecture bets you make carry into every robot we build after this one. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Lead board bring\-up with our manufacturing partners, from specification discovery through first boot. * Write the drivers and hardware abstraction layers that run on our microcontrollers and actuators. * Build and run automated hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests across embodiments. * Build the common firmware base for mainboards and actuators, in Rust and C. * Work with the ML and mechanical teams to prototype and validate new sensors. **You May Be a Good Fit If You:** ================================= * Have shipped production firmware to millions of devices. * Have written production firmware in Rust, C, or both. * Have debugged communication buses on real hardware. * Have built or operated hardware\-in\-the\-loop test infrastructure. * Have worked with contract manufacturers or OEMs to turn ambiguous requirements into a board layout. * Have worked with electromechanical systems or cameras and optics, electrically, mechanically, or in software. * Have working knowledge of electrical engineering and either field\-oriented control or RF. We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Expand human ambition in the physical world. *Critical infrastructure is constrained by labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and operational complexity. Watney builds and deploys autonomous robotic systems that increase the speed and capacity of buildout, starting with data centers.* **About the Role** ================== At Watney, infrastructure engineers keep a fleet of robots in the field connected and safe to change. The robots do production work at customer sites and stream real\-time video from their cameras. The same infrastructure carries that video and data to our ML team and the rest of engineering. Changing software on robots that are doing real work, over customer networks we do not control, is a problem the field has not settled: how a change reaches the fleet safely, and how video and data keep moving when a network fails. Our software engineers run this infrastructure today alongside the robot software. You will partner with them, own it full time, and decide what a safe release looks like. Every robot in the field depends on that answer. At Staff, you lead the infrastructure changes that cross teams. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Own networking, remote access, and the real\-time video pipelines for the fleet. * Own CI, observability, and alerting for the fleet and the services behind it. * Build the release gate and rollout process for the fleet, and own the bar a change must clear. * Decide where data lives, how it is kept, and what our infrastructure costs to run. * Lead infrastructure changes with the software engineers who run this infrastructure today, and across the ML and fleet operations teams who depend on it. **You May Be a Good Fit If You:** ================================= * Have led an infrastructure change across several teams, or founded the team that owns one. * Have owned production networking or edge traffic for a large system. * Have migrated a large system in stages, through breaking changes, without breaking its users. * Have owned observability and alerting for a production system. * Have built tooling that other engineers rely on every day. We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you’re passionate about robotics but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply! **Curious to learn more?** ========================== Follow us here on**X**and**LinkedIn**

jobs.title: Scientist III - AI Scientist for Quantitative Neuropathology
jobs.description: ***Scientist III – AI Scientist for Quantitative Neuropathology*** The **Allen Institute** accelerates science for a healthier world through large\-scale research designed to answer some of the most complex questions in biology. Our multi\-disciplinary teams generate foundational knowledge, tools, and data to understand how our brain, cells, and immune system work. We share our work openly so others can build on it, move faster, and ask bigger questions. We drive discovery forward and create new possibilities for improving human health. **Brain Health** is a new global collaborative research initiative designed to accelerate understanding of human brain diseases through large\-scale human tissue analysis, open science, AI\-enabled disease modeling, and translational platform technologies. Building on foundational advances in human brain cell atlases, quantitative neuropathology, single\-cell and spatial biology, multimodal molecular profiling, and AI\-enabled analysis, Brain Health is developing a scalable framework for understanding disease progression directly in the human brain and identifying new opportunities for therapeutic development.; We are searching for a **Scientist III in AI/ML Neuropathology** who will develop and deploy state\-of\-the\-art large\-scale machine learning methods to integrate multimodal neuropathological data, model disease progression, and drive the mechanistic understanding of brain disease at cellular resolution. This role sits at the intersection of computational biology and neuropathology, working within the Brain Health Accelerator and collaborating with experimental neuropathologists. AI/ML focus areas could include multimodal foundation models, diffusion models, causal representation learning, implementing and training computer vision architectures, and beyond. At the Allen Institute, we believe that science is for everyone – and should be open to everyone. We are dedicated to combating biases and reducing barriers to STEM careers more broadly. We also believe that science is better when it includes different perspectives and voices.
