jobs.title: Motion Controls & Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Give hope. Give health. Make your mark in the fight against cancer.** At Accuray, we make a direct and powerful impact on the lives of cancer patients every day — helping them live longer, better lives. But our commitment to innovation offers a truly unique opportunity: the chance to change the fight against cancer — helping to develop, introduce and support new treatment delivery systems and software that will give new hope and new health to cancer patients and cancer survivors around the world. Accuray develops, manufactures and sells radiotherapy systems for alternative cancer treatments. Our radiation therapy for cancer makes treatment shorter, safer, personalized and more effective, ultimately enabling patients to live longer, better lives. **Job Description** The Motion Controls \& Robotics Software Engineer contributes to the research, planning, design, implementation, and verification of software that controls critical electro\-mechanical and robotic motion mechanisms contributing to the function and performance of Accuray’s radiation therapy products. This is a software\-forward motion control role for early\-career candidates with foundational experience or strong demonstrated capability developing software that interfaces with physical hardware. The role supports high\-level architecture, detailed implementation, integration, and verification of these motion devices while building cross\-functional experience across Software, Mechanical, Electrical, and Systems Engineering to solve complex engineering problems. **Essential duties and responsibilities:** PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT * Object\-oriented software development and hands\-on hardware integration for Accuray’s control systems, including robotic manipulators, precision positioning systems, thermal and pneumatic control systems. Detailed analysis reports (design reviews, control system models, DFMEA, etc.), debugging, reliability cycling, system integration, and formal software/hardware testing are key components of the development activities. * Researches, analyzes, plans, and implements the control system design in accordance with product requirements as established from various sources including marketing, manufacturing, reliability, and customer specification documents. Supports the distillation of system\-level requirements into sub\-system and component\-level requirements. * Develops and executes comprehensive test plans, including manual, automated, unit, integration, and system\-level tests, to rigorously verify developed software and hardware against defined requirements and specifications. * Hands\-on, data driven problem solving – commonly working directly with motion hardware to move development efforts forward. Assists with hardware prototype builds and troubleshooting as needed. * Documents, implements and tests applicable design requirements for production. This includes supporting the transfer of relevant design output documents, recommended assembly and test instructions, and service troubleshooting support. * Collaborates closely and frequently with Embedded Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, and test teams throughout the software development and product development lifecycle. * Provides subject matter expert input and guidance for field service escalations into engineering. * Supports the Mechanical Systems Manager in establishing or updating project and departmental deliverables. COLLABORATION AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT * Works collaboratively within project teams and Product Development, seeking input from senior engineers and cross\-functional partners as appropriate. * Communicates technical progress, risks, and roadblocks clearly, and incorporates feedback into design, implementation, and verification of work. * Follows applicable quality processes on projects and within the Mechanical Systems group. * Contributes to process improvement activities as experience grows. SAFETY AND QUALITY * Supports the effective implementation of safety and quality considerations and requirements in product design. * Supports timely investigation, communication, and resolution of safety and quality issues raised by customers or staff. * Supports Accuray’s Quality System and Safety and Health Program by following applicable procedures and documentation practices. **Qualifications** Required * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics Engineering, Mechatronics, Engineering Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field, with coursework or experience in software development for physical systems. * **Software experience:** Professional software development experience is preferred, but strong candidates with substantial internship, co\-op, academic project, research, or personal project experience developing software for physical systems will be considered. Relevant experience should demonstrate hands\-on software developm nd/or Python, including class design, interfaces/abstractions, modular code structure, debugging, and unit/integration testing. * **Software development practices:** Experience using professional software development practices such as version control, code review, issue tracking, build/release workflows, and automated testing. * **Product development exposure:** Exposure to software development, testing, or release activities for products, prototypes, lab systems, or hardware\-integrated software. * **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Able to effectively present technical concepts to individuals that are not subject matter experts and assist as needed. Preferred or Desired * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, Engineering Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. * Internship, co\-op, research, academic project, or early professional experience in a regulated, safety\-critical, medical device, robotics, automation, or high\-reliability engineering environment. * Demonstrated ability to test and verify developed hardware and software against requirements. * Ability to develop system\-level requirements for motion control systems and effectively integrate both individual components into a system and sub\-systems into a larger system. * Experience or strong academic/project exposure working with automated or robotic systems and their components (motor controllers, drive electronics, sensors, etc.), including low\-level firmware, mid\-level software interfaces/device drivers, APIs, and robot controls middleware. * Experience developing robotics, motion control, or embedded software in regulated, safety\-critical, or high\-reliability environments. * Experience programming digital motion controllers, including configuration and utilization of digital I/O for motion control applications. * Self\-starter who can make progress independently while seeking guidance appropriately, collaborating with peers and management as needed. * Demonstrated experience developing, building, debugging, or deploying software in Linux\-based environments. * Exposure to 3D CAD modeling software (SolidWorks preferred) and virtualization tools for robotics applications. * Exposure to Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) and parallel computing concepts. * Proficiency with linear algebra, rigid transformations, coordinate frames, and/or robotics software for serial\-link manipulators. * Proficiency in working with databases, including querying, data manipulation, and schema design. * Strong foundational knowledge in control theory combined with hands\-on experience developing data\-driven control strategies. * Comfortable using AI\-assisted tools to enhance productivity, accelerate problem solving, and strengthen software development workflows while maintaining engineering judgment, verification discipline, and ownership of the final work product. * Understands fundamental machine learning and reinforcement learning concepts and their potential utility in advancing robotic capabilities. * Formal product reliability qualification and testing background. \#LI\-BB1 **To qualify for this position, candidates must be able to furnish proof that they are authorized to work in the country they are applying on a permanent basis without sponsorship.** **EEO Statement** At Accuray, our commitment to patient\-first outcomes drives an inclusive and collaborative work environment where the best ideas rise to the top — and everyone works to push them further. We value diversity in both the professional and personal backgrounds of our employees, as this variety adds rich energy to every team, every project and every work day. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin – including individuals with disabilities and veterans.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. #### **The Role** The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers. As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship. This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi\-day engagements. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment\-based visas such as H\-1B, F\-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment. #### **What You'll Do** * Build AI\-powered agents and tools end\-to\-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production * Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval\-augmented workflows * Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain\-specific * Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality * Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client\-specific work into product features * Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines) * Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance #### **Who You Are** * 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language) * Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs * Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data\-grounded AI workflows * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) * You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified. * A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate. * You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does * BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience #### **Nice to Have** * Experience building agentic systems (multi\-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows) * Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment) * Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting) * Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container\-based deployments * Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality **Our Values** * **Act Like an Owner \-** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. * **Build Together \-** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. * **Champion Our Clients \-** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. * **Drive Innovation \-** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. * **Embrace Learning \-** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

Python. * You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well We are looking for experienced engineers who are comfortable owning services end to end: API design, data modeling, deployments, and production debugging. Most of your time will be spent writing Go (backend services, gRPC/REST APIs, shared client libraries), with meaningful work in React/TypeScript for auth\-related UI, and occasionally Java for identity\-provider extensions. You will also work with Helm charts, analyze logs and metrics, manage deployments, and help other teams to integrate with our services. #### **Things You Get To Do** * Build and improve authentication\-related experiences in customer and partner web applications, including login, permissions, and credential management. * Develop and maintain the platform's authentication, authorization, and IdP services. * Create and evolve shared libraries and SDKs. * Integrate with identity providers and keep login and access policies working reliably across products. * Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot identity services in production. * Help modernize legacy authentication patterns as the platform evolves. * Own work end to end, from requirements through delivery and follow\-up. * Collaborate with other engineering teams on identity and access integration. * Maintain high code quality, write tests, and participate in code reviews. * Help investigate incidents and bugs, including on\-call rotation. #### **Who You Are (must\-haves)** * You have **5\+ years of experience** writing code in strongly\-typed languages, with at least **one year of experience in Go**. * You have experience building web applications with **React and TypeScript**. * You have worked with relational databases before \- we use **PostgreSQL**, but we are not particularly picky about this one as long as you have a solid grasp on the fundamentals. * You have worked at a **startup** before \- you thrive in ambiguous environments, embrace changing priorities, know when to balance technical debt with speed, and proactively tackle whatever needs to get done without relying on pre\-existing processes or documentation. * You are not afraid of **taking a task from start to finish** \- gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results. * You have worked at least 3 years on **systems at scale**. #### **Who You Might Be (nice\-to\-haves)** * You know what a **JWT** token is, and how **OpenID Connect** and **SAML** work. Maybe you even heard about **Keycloak**, or have worked on authentication systems before. * You have experience with **role\-based access control**. * You have built or maintained **OpenAPI\-driven** HTTP APIs. * You are familiar with **Kubernetes and Helm**. * You have experience with **Java**. * You understand how **Kafka** works \- maybe you even worked with **Redpanda** before. * You have experience with **Grafana**'s observability stack \- **Prometheus**, **Tempo** and all the rest. You might have even written a **PromQL** query for a new alert once or twice. ### **How We Take Care of You:** * Competitive Salary \& Stock Options * Health Benefits * New Hire Home\-Office Setup: One\-time USD $500 * Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card *Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.* *Recruitment Privacy Policy*

Implementing end\-to\-end AI/ML and GenAI projects, from understanding business needs to data preparation, model development, deployment and monitoring 2\. Designing and implementing machine learning pipelines that support high\-performance, reliable, scalable, and secure ML workloads 3\. Collaborating with cross\-functional teams (Applied Science, DevOps, Data Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Applications) to prepare, analyze, and operationalize data and AI/ML models 5\. Serving as a trusted advisor to customers on AI/ML and GenAI solutions and cloud architectures 6\. Sharing knowledge and best practices within the organization through mentoring, training, publication, and creating reusable artifacts 7\. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. jobs.title: ML Compiler Engineer, Neuron Kernel Interface
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Machine Learning accelerators are at the forefront of AWS innovation. Trainium delivers best\-in\-class ML training performance with the most teraflops (TFLOPS) of compute power for ML in the cloud. This is all enabled by the AWS Neuron Software Development Kit (SDK), which includes an ML compiler, the Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) compiler, and a runtime that natively integrates into popular ML frameworks such as PyTorch and JAX. Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) is a bare\-metal language and compiler for directly programming AWS Trainium instances. You can use NKI to develop, optimize, and run new operators directly on hardware while making full use of available compute and memory resources. Explore NKI: * https://awsdocs\-neuron.readthedocs\-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/index.html AWS Neuron is used at scale by customers such as Epic Games, Snap, Airbnb, Autodesk, Amazon Alexa, and Amazon Rekognition, along with many others across a range of segments. Amazon's Annapurna Labs is responsible for building innovative silicon and software for AWS customers. We are at the forefront of innovation, combining cloud scale with the world's most talented engineers. Our team covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design and verification, software, and operations. With such breadth of talent, there is opportunity to learn all the time. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. When you couple that with the ability to work on so many different products and services, it makes for a unique learning culture. Learn more about our history: * https://www.amazon.science/how\-silicon\-innovation\-became\-the\-secret\-sauce\-behind\-awss\-success Explore the Product: * https://aws.amazon.com/machine\-learning/neuron/ As an ML Compiler Engineer with the Annapurna Neuron team, you develop and scale compilers to handle the world's largest ML workloads on AWS Trainium. You design and ship features across the compiler stack, work directly with Amazon ML partner teams to unblock their workloads, and grow your skills alongside senior engineers. You want to work close to the hardware, help bring new products and features to market, and ship high\-quality code. A background in Machine Learning, AI accelerators, or Kernel performance is helpful, but not required. In order to be considered for this role, candidates must be located near or willing to relocate to Seattle or Cupertino. Key job responsibilities * Design and build compiler features for the Neuron compilers. Your work may span the frontend, intermediate representations, optimization passes, and code generation for the hardware. * Own features from design through production: design, implement, test on hardware and simulation, and support customers. * Work with Amazon ML teams (PyTorch, JAX, and internal model teams) to understand their workloads and unblock them. * Give hardware teams compiler and programmability feedback on upcoming chips. * Review code and designs, and mentor newer engineers. A day in the life You start the day reviewing a teammate's code for a new compiler feature, leaving feedback before it merges. Mid\-morning, you work with a model team whose kernel isn't reaching peak performance on Trainium, and you trace the bottleneck through the compiler's passes. After lunch, you write and test the feature you designed last week, then run it on hardware to confirm correctness. The team moves quickly and you are always in the details. Our ML compiler takes a full model from PyTorch or JAX and compiles the graph to run across the chip. The Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) is a bare\-metal language and compiler that lets customers program Trainium directly, down to the compute and memory, for a new operator or a faster kernel. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Life Sciences)
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As an Applied AI Engineer on the Startups team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the top AI\-native life sciences and biotech startups as they grow from early product to scale. Some of these companies build products on Claude that they sell to the rest of the industry, and others do the science themselves and want Claude woven into how their own research runs, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with startup engineering and scientific teams to help them build their products on Claude and run their own research with it, advising on implementation and agent design as they build what is newly possible with AI in the life sciences. You will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what the life sciences need, working alongside some of the strongest teams in the field on problems that matter and pushing the boundaries of AI in science as you go. Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll help startups build at the edge of what is possible with Claude. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise and your scientific domain knowledge to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable life sciences startups to succeed with Claude. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Serve as a deep technical advisor to high\-potential life sciences and biotech startups, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they make discoveries, working alongside them to build innovative use cases that push the boundaries of AI in scientific research and development * Work hands\-on with startup engineering teams and their scientists through pair programming and architecture reviews that accelerate their development, and understand their scientific workflows end to end so that your guidance fits into real research pipelines * Develop prototypes and technical documentation, including evaluation suites, scientifically grounded benchmarks, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable startups to build, operate, and scale with Claude * Create reference implementations and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, such as example MCP servers for domain\-specific data sources like genomics platforms, literature databases, and experimental repositories, along with agent skills for common scientific workflows * Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements * Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about deploying AI in the life sciences such as heterogeneous data, auditability requirements, and the gap between a working prototype and a system that scientists trust, and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team, including feedback on the model capabilities and product features that would most accelerate discovery work * Create technical content for startup audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code * Represent Anthropic across the life sciences startup ecosystem and foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, in\-person founder events, and research show and tells * Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * Deep experience in the life sciences or biotech, gained through research or industry work in areas such as genomics, drug discovery, molecular design, lab automation, or clinical development, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and what the life sciences need * 4\+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, ML or research engineer, computational biologist, research scientist, or technical founder, with either production experience building LLM\-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, or a track record of successfully applying AI to real scientific work in the lab or in research * Experience with startups or high\-growth companies and a love of working with founders and small teams that move quickly * Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans for both enginee itch across scientific domains and use cases, and a passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. Annual Salary: $280,000 \- $320,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** We are seeking a talented AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications using modern Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and Python\-based application development. The candidate will work with engineering and business teams to build intelligent applications, integrate AI capabilities into existing systems, and deliver scalable, reliable solutions for real\-world business problems. **Key Responsibilities** Design, develop, and maintain AI\-powered applications using Python and modern AI frameworks. Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), including GPT, Claude, Llama, or similar models, into enterprise applications. Build and optimize RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and document retrieval. Develop AI agents and intelligent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies. Implement prompt engineering, tool calling, and model evaluation techniques to improve AI response quality and reliability. Develop REST APIs and backend services to integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, databases, and external systems. Work with structured and unstructured data to support AI applications, knowledge retrieval, and model inference. Deploy and maintain AI applications on cloud platforms such as AWS or Microsoft Azure. Test, troubleshoot, and optimize AI applications for accuracy, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. Implement logging, monitoring, security controls, and appropriate safeguards for production AI systems. Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into practical AI solutions. **Required Qualifications** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 3\+ years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, or application development experience. Strong programming skills in Python and experience building backend applications or APIs. Hands\-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI, or machine learning applications. Understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases. Experience with at least one AI development framework, such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex. Experience developing REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks. Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably AWS or Azure. Knowledge of Git, software testing, debugging, and collaborative development practices. Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience building AI agents, agentic workflows, or multi\-step AI automation. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool calling, and agent orchestration. Experience with AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Azure AI Foundry. Familiarity with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, or ChromaDB. Knowledge of machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit\-learn. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or MLOps/LLMOps practices. Familiarity with SQL, data pipelines, Apache Spark, or PySpark. Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, or conversational AI solutions. Knowledge of AI evaluation, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and responsible AI practices. **What We're Looking For** **Mid\-Level Engineers:** Strong hands\-on development skills, a solid understanding of LLMs and RAG, and the ability to build and maintain AI applications with appropriate guidance. **Senior Engineers:** Deeper experience designing production AI solutions, optimizing RAG and agent workflows, making technical decisions, and supporting deployment and performance improvements. Candidates do not need to have experience with every technology listed. Strong Python development skills and practical experience building AI applications are the primary priorities. Pay: From $85,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Vision insurance Experience: * Copilot Studio: 4 years (Required) * Contact Center: 4 years (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sterling, VA 20166

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) - Enterprise Technology Services
jobs.description: Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. The IS\&T Enterprise Business Application group is seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) with a proven track record of sustaining high\-quality enterprise software solutions. Our group owns Apple's enterprise Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) transformation initiative \- delivering a next\-generation Product Information Management (PIM) platform that drives Apple's product innovation across hardware, software, and services lines of business. In this position, you will work closely with key business stakeholders to build an enterprise PIM platform that enables product innovation and collaboration across Apple's product value chain. We are looking for someone with extensive experience building and delivering large\-scale, on\-premise and cloud\-based enterprise solutions \- especially PLM. This individual should have sound technical and functional knowledge of PLM domains and modern test frameworks. A great candidate will create a collaborative work environment that fosters autonomy, transparency, innovation, and learning. **Description** This hands\-on role demands the best and brightest; the ideal candidate will be well rounded and offer a diverse set of skills that aligns with the key qualifications listed below. This is a highly cross\-functional role \- we interact closely with technical and business teams all across Apple and with third\-party partners. Collaboration \& Engineering Partnership Partner with engineering, infrastructure, site reliability, program management, and partner technical and business teams to formulate engineering specifications and testable acceptance criteria. Participate in design and architecture reviews as the quality voice \- surface testability gaps, missing observability, and risky integration points before a line of code is written. Act as the quality advocate in agile ceremonies: refine stories into verifiable behaviors, estimate test effort, and hold the team's definition of done. Test Strategy, Design \& Automation Craft test plans, test cases, and the associated automation for complex full\-stack PLM workflows; set standards, estimate effort, and coordinate execution across functional, integration, regression, and release cycles. Own the automation architecture in TypeScript: build and maintain a strictly typed, reusable, data\-driven UI and API test framework on Playwright Test \- custom fixtures, page\- and service\-object layering, shared typed clients, parallel sharded execution, and no flaky tests tolerated. Treat test code as production code: strict TypeScript configuration, lint and format gates, typed API contracts generated from schema rather than hand\-written, and peer\-reviewed pull requests. Apply the test pyramid deliberately \- push coverage down to unit and service layers, and reserve end\-to\-end UI suites for genuine business\-critical journeys. Build service\-virtualization and mocking capability (Playwright network interception and WireMock stubs) so downstream integrations can be tested without waiting on partner environments. Engineer test data management for PLM: item/BOM/change\-order fixtures, revision and lifecycle states, seeded via API or ITK/SOA rather than hand\-built in the UI; guarantee repeatable setup and teardown. Asynchronous \& Distributed Systems Testing Automate and validate asynchronous, event\-driven, and distributed behavior \- message queues and streams (Kafka), workflow engines, scheduled jobs, and batch/ETL pipelines. Write deterministic assertions over eventual consistency: typed polling helpers with bounded waits and expect.poll\-style retries, idempotency and replay checks, out\-of\-order and duplicate message handling, and dead\-letter/retry paths \- never sleep\-based waits. Verify data integrity end to end across system boundaries \- reconciliation between source PLM, the PIM platform, and downstream consumers, including migration and cutover validation. CI/CD \& Quality Engineering Infrastructure Integrate automated suites into CI/CD (Jenkins and Rio) so every commit and every deployment is gated by meaningful, fast, trustworthy feedback; manage the toolchain, dependency hygiene, and build caching that keeps those runs fast. Manage on\-demand, isolated test environments so suites can run in parallel without contention. Maintain reporting and traceability \- Playwright traces and Allure dashboards, requirement\-to\-test coverage mapping, and clear triage of every failure as product bug, test bug, or environment issue. Non\-Functional \& Resilience Testing Design and execute performance, load, and soak tests for large BOM structures, bulk imports, and peak concurrent usage; define and defend latency and throughput budgets. Validate security and access control: role\- and project\-based permissions, data segregation, authentication/SSO flows, and audit trails \- critical in a system holding unreleased product data. Cover accessibility, cross\-browser, and cross\-platform behavior for the PIM user experience. Defect Management \& Quality Metrics Identify and document defects with crisp reproduction steps, evidence, and impact; collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize and drive resolution. Engage with stakeholders to define and consistently assess metrics that monitor product quality \- automation coverage and pass rate, escaped\-defect rate, mean time to detect and repair, regression cycle time, and environment stability. Drive root\-cause analysis on escaped defects and convert every one into a durable automated test. **Preferred Qualifications** Depth in the Playwright Test ecosystem \- custom fixtures, projects and sharding, network interception, trace viewer, visual comparison, and component testing. Extensive knowledge of back\-end development technologies, particularly Java and related frameworks (Spring/Spring Boot, microservices) \- enough to read the services under test and debug alongside their developers. Working knowledge of browser technologies and frameworks such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React, including the DOM and accessibility semantics that make an application testable. Proficiency in relational database technologies such as Oracle or Postgres. Depth in Siemens Teamcenter \- Active Workspace, BMIDE data model, SOA/ITK services, workflows, and Teamcenter Integration Framework (TcIF). Experience with PLM data migration and cutover validation \- extract, transform, load, and reconciliation at scale. Experience with message brokers and streaming platforms (Kafka via kafkajs, JMS/ActiveMQ) and with ETL or data pipeline testing. Experience with performance and resilience testing of enterprise workloads. Familiarity with test management and defect tracking practices, including requirement\-to\-test traceability and Allure\-based reporting. Self\-motivated, proactive, and meticulous individual with excellent written and oral English communication skills. **Minimum Qualifications** Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in quality assurance or software engineering. Proficient in developing test plans and automation strategies for intricate full\-stack applications. Experience testing and automating browser\-based applications across platforms using Playwright (TypeScript), Selenium, or equivalent. Experience testing and automating enterprise applications such as Siemens Teamcenter or an equivalent PLM system. Hands\-on experience automating and testing asynchronous and distributed systems. Strong programming ability in TypeScript \- typed interfaces and generics, async/await, clean code practices, code review, and Git\-based workflows. Our automation codebase is TypeScript end to end, with Java used on the services and integrations under test. Experience with API and contract testing (REST/SOAP, JSON/XML) using Playwright's API request client, Postman/Insomnia, or equivalent, including JSON Schema validation. Working knowledge of SQL for test data setup and backend verification. Experience integrating automated test suites into a CI/CD pipeline.

jobs.description: ### **Who We Are** At Apptegy, we are more than a tech company; we are partners dedicated to transforming how schools communicate and shape the future of education. In this role, you will serve as a hands\-on builder and cross\-functional partner, working with leaders and process owners across finance and operations to design and implement AI\-powered workflows that make our teams more effective. You will focus on using tools like Claude and Claude Code, N8N, Glean, and direct API work against NetSuite, Salesforce, and Snowflake to automate, integrate, and scale how we work without needing to reinvent the wheel. This is not a traditional engineering role. It is ideal for someone who loves solving complex problems at the intersection of technology and business operations, a true solutions engineer who is just as comfortable connecting APIs as sitting with an accountant to learn why a process works the way it does. You will also work closely with the AI Champions and builders already embedded across the business to align efforts, ensure adoption, and share best practices company\-wide. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Find the work** by partnering with process owners to map how work actually happens today, including the exceptions, the workarounds, and the steps that only live with a user. Much of the highest\-value work will be work nobody filed a request for. * **Size it before you build it** by defining the metric and stating the expected result up front, whether that is hours removed, cycle time, error rate, or cost avoided, then measuring the actual result once it ships. * **Build and automate smart workflows** using AI agents and skills, API integrations, SQL and Python, workflow orchestration, and scripting against the systems where the work lives, taking each one from prototype to production. * **Own the connective layer** by moving data cleanly between NetSuite, Salesforce, DealHub, Workday, Greenhouse, Snowflake, and the rest of the stack through APIs, webhooks, and pipelines, including the reconciliations that prove both sides agree. * **Multiply the builders already in each function** by publishing the shared primitives, patterns, and templates they need, so capability compounds instead of queueing behind one person, and by maintaining the jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Job Description – Software Engineering Manager** Reports To \- Director of Engineering **Summary** AxisCare is hiring a full\-time, fully remote Software Engineering Manager to build and lead high\-performing engineering teams and to help us reimagine how software teams work in the age of AI. You've been a software engineer, so you know what it takes to build software. But your true calling is creating the environment where engineers thrive, succeed, and grow. That job is changing fast. We're no longer coding everything by hand. We're building the systems that let us bring great ideas to life and solve real customer problems quicker than ever before. (Read more about how we think AI is changing product development.) There will always be a need for people who deeply understand our customers' most important problems, solve them with high\-quality software, and run that software reliably in production. That's the work that endures, and you'll be building and leading the teams that do it. We're looking for a manager who's already internalized this shift. Someone who pushes their team to use AI tools aggressively, but who also has the judgment to know when the AI is producing confident\-sounding garbage, and who's building that same judgment in their engineers. Someone who helps their team develop taste and discipline, not just speed. **What You'll Do** Own the day\-to\-day health of your teams. Help engineers develop great daily habits, strong communication, and reach the next level, including helping them grow from engineers who only write code into engineers who direct AI effectively. Partner with product and design counterparts to quickly get from "important customer problem" to "working software," favoring rapid iteration over upfront resolution of every ambiguity. Partner with staff engineers on technical direction, code design, and systems thinking. Set a high standard of excellence and lead by example, including in how you and your team adopt AI tools and rethink your workflows. If you're asking your engineers to embrace this shift, you'd better be living it yourself. Stay hands\-on by running spikes, prototyping, and exploring ideas your team hasn't had time to chase, without taking on critical\-path work. Coach engineers to use AI as a core part of how they build: when to trust the output, when to throw it out, and how to maintain code quality when the machine is doing the typing. Teach them to fish rather than doing it for them. Challenge your team's assumptions about how software gets made. Question old habits inherited from the era of scarce coding time (exhaustive PRDs, excessive backlog refinement, premature mockup fidelity, story\-point ceremony) and encourage cheaper, faster paths to working software. Create an environment where engineers think about the whole problem, not just the code: understanding customer needs, system dynamics, and what it takes to run software reliably in production. AI makes it dangerously easy to build the wrong thing quickly, so clear thinking about what to build matters more than ever. **What We're Looking For** An **AI power user with substance and good judgment**. You drive agents, have opinions about where today's models break down drawn from real experience, and you're actively rethinking what engineering management looks like when writing code is no longer the bottleneck. You help your team move fast with these tools without becoming dependent on them for the thinking. You know the difference between leveraging AI and outsourcing your brain to it. A **systems thinker**. You look beyond the element at hand to the broader dynamics at play. A **strong writer and compelling storyteller**. Remote work demands clear writing, clear writing is clear thinking, and clear thinking is how you get the biggest impact from AI. But clarity alone doesn't motivate people. You know how to tell the story of why the work matters, where the team is headed, and what winning looks like. A **humble, always\-a\-student approach** to management itself. You treat management as a craft you're actively learning, and you treat the changing nature of product development with the same curiosity. **Technical enough to lead engineers credibly.** You don't need to be the best engineer on the team, but you need to earn their respect, ask sharp questions in code reviews and design discussions, and provide real guidance. **Experience required:** * Track record managing software engineers on teams building full stack web applications * Demonstrated, substantive use of AI development tools in your own work, not just encouraging your team to use them * Able to work remotely from the Eastern, Central, or Mountain time zones * Qualified to work in the United States **What We'd Be Excited to Find** * Familiarity building and maintaining HIPAA\-compliant software * A track record of leading teams through significant shifts in tooling or process. You've helped people navigate real ambiguity and come out stronger. * Concrete examples of how you've changed your team's workflows around AI. Not just "we adopted Copilot." What did you actually do differently, and what happened? **Working Conditions** * Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals. **Compensation and Equipment** * Salary (TBD based on job experience and skill level) * Medical insurance is covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental, and Vision) * Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment **How to Apply** Apply with a brief resume and either a written or video cover letter. We review the cover letter before anything else in your application, so this really matters. This is your single biggest opportunity to improve your chances, and video submissions go right to the front of the line. **Prompt:** How has AI changed the way you think about engineering management? Not just the tools your team uses, but how you lead, what you prioritize, and what you've stopped doing. Tell us why this position is the one you've been hoping to find. **Written:** No more than 600 words. We're looking for clarity of thought and strong communication. Use AI if you want, but don't send slop. **Video:** 1–2 minutes, linked in the "Website, Blog, or Portfolio" section of your application. Doesn't need to be highly produced. We care about how you think and communicate. We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds and every walk of life to apply. Every person on our team brings their own unique perspective, and it's what makes our products better and our work more rewarding. We're eager to support you so that you and your team can ship work you're proud of. **Candidates only. No recruiters, please.** ***About AxisCare*** *According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non\-medical (also referred to as non\-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.* *AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more user\-friendly and mobile\-compatible solution. Our product is a web\-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 6 other countries. We are a fast\-growing company seeking high\-performing individuals looking for a fast\-paced, autonomous working environment.*

jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed Data Scientist
jobs.description: Date live: 10/16/2026 Business Area: USCB Support Services Area of Expertise: Data \& Analytics Contract: Permanent Reference Code: JR\-0000136246 Salary / Rate **$ 215,000\.00 \- $ 280,000\.00** \_ **Principal Forward Deployed Data Scientist** This is a very senior, hands\-on technical leadership role for a data scientist who has built real, production AI applications for internal teams and for customers and knows what it takes to take an idea all the way from prototype to production within a regulated environment. You'll sit at the intersection of our business, our users, and the bleeding edge of AI. You won't be handed a spec you'll work directly with stakeholders to understand the problem, choose the right approach for it, build the solution, deploy it, and stay with it as it grows. You are the person who turns ambiguous goals into production agentic systems that people depend on, and who keeps us ahead of a technology landscape that changes week to week. WHAT YOU'LL DO * Take ideas from prototype to production. Start from a rough concept or business problem, prove it quickly with a prototype, then do the hard engineering to turn it into a reliable, scalable, production\-grade system people can depend on — and know what each stage demands. * Build agentic AI, end to end. Design, implement, deploy, and evolve autonomous and tool\-using AI systems — agents that reason, plan, call tools, and act on the user's behalf — for both internal and customer\-facing use, owning the full lifecycle and the outcome. * Design agentic architectures. Build agent\-orchestration systems: single and multi\-agent setups, tool and function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent\-to\-agent coordination, planning and reasoning loops, memory, identity and access for agents, and the control and safety mechanisms that keep autonomous behaviour trustworthy. * Match the solution to the problem. No one\-size\-fits\-all. You assess each problem on its own terms and choose the right approach — a different model, agent pattern, or architecture for a different need — rather than forcing everything through a single template. * Live on the bleeding edge. Actively track new models, agentic frameworks, techniques, and tooling as they emerge; prototype quickly, form a view, and bring the ones that matter into production with sound judgement about what's ready and what's hype. * Deliver, dependably. Ship software to production on time and to a high standard, navigating the controls, governance, and compliance expectations of a regulated environment. * Embed with the business. Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with stakeholders, shape the roadmap, and translate business goals into working AI capability. * Set the standard. Define how agentic AI is built here — quality, evaluation, observability, and responsible\-AI practices that others follow — and be the trusted technical authority for AI delivery across the organisation. ESSENTIAL (MUST\-HAVE) * Building AI/LLM applications in production — real systems people rely on, whether internal or customer\-facing, not prototypes or demos. * Taking ideas from prototype to production — a proven ability to move from a fast proof of concept to a hardened, scalable, maintainable production system, and the judgement to know what changes between the two. * A proven track record of delivering software to production in a regulated environment — real, shipped systems with lasting impact, delivered within governance, risk, compliance, and audit controls (e.g. financial services or similar) without losing delivery pace. * Hands\-on experience with agentic AI — building systems where models reason, plan, call tools, and take actions, including multi\-agent and agent\-to\-agent (A2A) coordination, tool and data integration via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the control and safety mechanisms that keep autonomous behaviour trustworthy. * Identity and access for AI — how agents authenticate, act on behalf of users with delegated authority, and operate under non\-human/service identities, with the authentication, authorisation, and auditability a regulated environment demands. * Strong software engineering fundamentals — reliable, observable, testable, maintainable systems. * Excellent communication and stakeholder skills — fluent moving between a business conversation and a technical design, and comfortable working directly with non\-technical stakeholders. * A forward\-deployed mindset — comfortable with ambiguity, close to the business and the user, biased toward shipping and iterating. STRONGLY DESIRABLE * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) — grounding responses in trusted organisational knowledge. * Evaluation (evals) — defining, measuring, and improving the quality and reliability of AI and agent behaviour. * Guardrails and safety — input/output filtering, hallucination mitigation, control over autonomous actions, and responsible\-AI practices. * Prompt and context design, memory, and other techniques for shaping reliable model and agent behaviour. * Choosing the right approach for the problem — range and judgement to select between different models, agent patterns, and architectures as the problem demands. * Leading architecture across teams — setting technical direction that other engineers build on. * An insatiable pull toward new and emerging technology — you keep up with the frontier because you want to, and you can tell production\-ready from hype. NICE TO HAVE * Experience building customer\-facing AI — delivering AI systems that real external customers interact with, and handling the extra bar for safety, trust, and polish that comes with it. * Exposure to agent\-driven and AI\-generated UI — interfaces that agents render, drive, or adapt dynamically. All Senior Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others. All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Healthcare Platform - Remote
jobs.description: **Role Summary** ---------------- We are seeking a senior AI engineer to help build and operate a production\-grade healthcare GenAI platform for patient\-facing and enterprise conversational experiences. This role will focus on backend AI services, agentic workflows, MCP tool servers, secure clinical data integrations, and AI platform tooling. The ideal candidate is a strong Python/backend engineer with hands\-on GenAI experience who can build reliable agent systems using **Google ADK**, LLM tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, guardrails, and healthcare\-safe integration patterns. This is not a prompt\-only role; it requires production engineering judgment across security, observability, testing, deployment, PHI protection, and operational ownership. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Design, implement, and maintain backend AI services using **Python 3\.12\+**, async service patterns, and frameworks such as **FastAPI**, **Google ADK**, and **FastMCP**. * Develop and operate agentic GenAI workflows using **Google ADK 2\.x** as a primary orchestration framework. * Build MCP tool servers and domain\-specific tools for healthcare workflows such as care tasks, medications, scheduling, patient profile lookup, clinical record retrieval, and EHR/FHIR\-backed experiences. * Integrate LLM providers and GenAI toolkits including **Google Gemini/Vertex AI**, OpenAI, Anthropic, and related orchestration frameworks where appropriate. * Implement prompt engineering, RAG, structured output validation, tool selection patterns, memory strategies, and AI guardrails to support safe and reliable model behavior. * Design secure clinical integration boundaries for FHIR, EHR, user profile, scheduling, and other healthcare systems. * Protect PHI and sensitive credentials through secure JWT/OAuth flows, delegated authorization, token forwarding, encryption, redaction, and audit\-safe logging. * Leverage cloud services such as **Azure App Configuration, Key Vault, Cosmos DB, Event Hubs, Application Insights**, and Google Cloud services such as **Vertex AI/Gemini and Cloud Run**. * Build observability, telemetry, evaluation, and impact\-reporting capabilities for AI systems and AI\-assisted engineering workflows. * Author and maintain automated tests using **pytest** and support linting, type\-checking, CI/CD, and containerized deployments. * Collaborate with product, architecture, security, clinical, platform, DevOps, and application teams to deliver safe AI capabilities through well\-defined HTTP/MCP contracts. * Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, production support, operational readiness, and incident response. **BENEFITS** Our competitive benefits package includes the following * Immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits * 401(k) savings plan with dollar\-for\-dollar match up to 5% * Tuition Reimbursement * PTO accrual beginning Day 1 Note: Benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level**Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 7\+ years of professional software development experience. * Strong production experience with **Python**, asynchronous programming, backend APIs, and service\-oriented architecture. * Hands\-on experience building GenAI applications with **Google ADK 2\.x** or similar agent orchestration frameworks. * Demonstrated understanding of LLM tool calling, multi\-agent workflows, structured outputs, RAG, prompt engineering, and AI safety/guardrail patterns. * Experience integrating with LLM providers such as **Google Gemini/Vertex AI**, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent platforms. * Experience with **FastAPI**, **pytest**, Docker, CI/CD workflows, and containerized production deployments. * Strong understanding of API security, **JWT/OAuth**, delegated authorization, secrets management, and secure service\-to\-service communication. * Ability to design safe integration patterns for healthcare data, clinical systems, or other sensitive regulated environments. * Experience with cloud\-native services in Azure and/or Google Cloud. * Strong debugging, testing, and operational problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work with high ownership in a small, fast\-moving engineering team. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, security, product, and clinical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Healthcare domain experience, especially with **HIPAA**, **HL7/FHIR**, Epic integrations, patient portals, scheduling, medication, claims, or clinical workflow systems. * Experience with **MCP**, **FastMCP v3**, model\-tool integration, or agent tool\-server architecture. * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, PydanticAI, Semantic Kernel, or other orchestration and structured\-output frameworks. * Familiarity with **OpenTelemetry**, Application Insights, Kusto, AI evaluation pipelines, or production observability tooling. * Experience building AI platform tooling, internal developer enablement tools, AI governance automation, code review automation, or AI impact reporting. * Experience with **uv**, ruff, pyright, Python packaging, dependency isolation, and multi\-container service deployment. * Exposure to React and TypeScript for occasional full\-stack collaboration, while remaining primarily backend/platform focused. **AI\-Augmented Development Expectations** ------------------------------------------ This role requires disciplined use of AI tools as part of daily engineering work. The engineer should be able to use AI coding agents and GenAI systems to accelerate implementation, research, validation, and documentation while remaining fully accountable for correctness and safety. The successful candidate will know how to: * Give AI agents clear, scoped engineering tasks. * Require agents to inspect existing code, contracts, tests, and architecture before proposing changes. * Validate AI\-generated code with tests, type checks, linting, runtime review, and security judgment. * Identify when generated code is unsafe, incorrect, over\-engineered, noncompliant, or inconsistent with platform boundaries. * Use AI tools to improve delivery speed without compromising PHI protection, reliability, auditability, maintainability, or user trust. * Contribute to AI governance patterns, reusable agent instructions, tool ergonomics, and platform standards. **Ideal Candidate Profile** --------------------------- The ideal candidate is a senior backend/platform engineer with practical GenAI experience and strong healthcare\-grade judgment. They can design agent workflows, but they also understand authentication, deployment, observability, testing, failure modes, PHI handling, and operational ownership. They are pragmatic, security\-minded, collaborative, and comfortable building early platform foundations that will later support production patient\-facing AI experiences.

jobs.description: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Berry Street is building on the convergence of AI, GLP\-1s, and the consumerization of healthcare — while leveraging insurance to make life\-changing metabolic care as accessible as possible for all. Our platform connects patients with 2,000\+ clinicians and AI tools to treat obesity, diabetes/prediabetes, cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, maternal health, and dozens of other chronic and acute conditions, working with major health plans, health systems, and care management companies across all 50 states. We launched in 2023, have served hundreds of thousands of patients, and are Series B — backed by investors like Khosla, Northzone, FJ Labs, and the founders of Revolut, Grow Therapy, and Spring Health. The Role This is a founding\-caliber engineering role. You'll work directly with our founder and leadership team to build the AI\-native infrastructure and consumer experiences you’ve always wished existed in healthcare. You'll be one of a small number of engineers shaping how the system scales from hundreds of thousands of patients in the US to millions across the globe. We move fast. What you ship today will affect real patients and providers tomorrow. That's the job. AI is at the core of everything we build, both internally and externally. What You’ll Work On* Architect and ship AI\-native systems from the ground up: autonomous clinical agents, LLM\-powered workflows that replace manual processes, intelligent tools that make dietitians dramatically more effective and help us prescribe and monitor GLP\-1s at scale * Build the infrastructure that makes AI reliable in a clinical setting: evaluation pipelines, guardrails, feedback loops, the unglamorous stuff that makes the difference between a demo and a product * Set technical direction on our platform, making architectural calls that shape how Berry Street scales from tens of thousands of patients to millions * Own features end\-to\-end across provider\- and patient\-facing surfaces, from scoping and architecture through to production * Be a force multiplier for the engineering team: raise the bar on code quality, tooling, and practices without slowing anyone down * Work directly with our patients and providers to deeply understand what they actually need and translate that into systems that hold up at scale **Requirements** * **5\+ years of engineering experience.** You've built and maintained production systems at scale. You've made hard architectural calls and lived with the consequences — good and bad. * **AI\-led, not AI\-assisted.** We're not looking for someone who uses Cursor / Claude Code / Codex to autocomplete slop faster. We're looking for someone who thinks about how to architect AI\-driven architecture from the ground up: autonomous systems that do things that weren't possible two quarters ago. You've shipped something in this space, you have opinions about where it's going, and you're already building for that future. * **A product brain.** You think about users, not just systems. You push back when a spec doesn't make sense and offer better alternatives. You NEED to understand the ‘why’. * **Full\-stack, back\-end leaning.** You're comfortable across the stack but strongest on the platform and API side. You know our stack well: React, Next.js, NestJS, TypeORM, PostgreSQL, AWS. TailwindCSS and TypeScript are not intimidating. * **An ownership mindset.** You take a project from "vague idea" to "shipped and working" without needing someone to hand\-hold you through the middle. You flag problems early, drive decisions, and follow through * **A bias for speed.** You understand the difference between moving fast and cutting corners, and understand when situations call for one or the other. Engineering Standards \& Practices** * Own and define the 'how we build' standards across all five Plasma digital product domains: coding standards, testing standards, security standards (in formal matrix partnership with the CSL Cyber organization), DevOps and CI/CD practices, and architectural patterns. * Set the technical quality bar that all internal delivery teams, managed service providers, and to which external vendors are contractually and operationally held. * Enforce standards primarily through the shared engineering platform, automated quality gates, and review of significant technical designs. Architecture review boards are reserved for genuinely novel decisions, not routine sign\-off. * Reviews and approves significant technical designs personally, particularly those setting patterns others will follow. **2\. Architecture Governance** * Set and enforce integration standards, data architecture, and cross\-product technical decisions across the full Plasma digital ecosystem. * Serve as the formal interface with the CSL Enterprise Architecture organization. Establish and maintain the cadence with the CSL Enterprise Architecture team, represent Plasma architecture upward, and bring enterprise decisions back to the Plasma team. Cross\-Domain Team Leadership** * Provide direct people leadership for cross\-domain enabling functions: Plasma Business Architect, QA Lead, QA Automation Engineers, AI/ML Product Engineer, Automation Engineer, Data Engineer, SRE/DevOps Engineer, and UX Designers. * Own hiring standards, role design, career development frameworks, and succession planning for the cross\-domain engineering team. * Set and hold a culture of technical excellence, accountability, psychological safety, and continuous learning across the engineering organization. * Given the transformation of Plasma IT, personally interviews technical leads across the broader net\-new hires, not only direct reports, to hold the hiring bar across the Plasma technology team. **4\. Technology Platform Strategy** * Own the engineering tooling, platform, and capability roadmap — including the Data Backbone architecture, Middleware integration standards, cloud infrastructure direction, and the DevOps toolchain — in conjunction with enterprise capability owners. * Ensure the technology platform evolves in step with the Plasma product roadmap, anticipating capability needs 12–24 months ahead. * Evaluate build vs. buy vs. partner decisions for platform capabilities; provide technology investment recommendations to senior leadership. * Owns the shared engineering platform that every Plasma product team builds on. This covers service tem le. Stays close enough to the code and the architecture to earn the respect of the engineers doing the work. Contributes personally where judgment is required and delegates confidently everywhere else. **Competencies** * Architectural Vision — shapes a technology platform strategy that enables scalable, secure, and sustainable product delivery. * Standards Leadership — builds a culture where engineering quality standards are understood, respected, and consistently met. * Talent Developer — recruits, develops, and retains high\-caliber engineers and architects across disciplines. * AI \& Digital Innovation Mindset — evaluates emerging technologies and identifies practical opportunities to leverage AI and intelligent automation to create business value. * Responsible Technology Leadership — balances innovation with governance, ensuring AI capabilities are implemented in a secure, compliant, ethical, and sustainable manner. * Trusted Advisor — earns the confidence of product leadership, business stakeholders, and the CSL enterprise architecture community. * Governance with Judgment — applies standards with rigor while remaining pragmatic about delivery realities and trade\-offs. * Security Champion — ensures compliance and data protection are embedded in engineering DNA, not bolted on at the end. **About CSL Behring** --------------------- CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. jobs.title: Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cyngn, Inc.** Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly\-traded autonomous technology company. We deploy self\-driving industrial vehicles \-**specifically autonomous tuggers**\- to factories, warehouses, and other facilities throughout North America. To build this emergent technology, we are looking for innovative, motivated, and experienced leaders to join us and move this field forward. If you like to build, tinker, and create with a team of trusted and passionate colleagues, then Cyngn is the place for you. **Key reasons to join Cyngn:** **We are small and big.** With under 100 employees, Cyngn operates with the energy of a startup. On the other hand, we’re publicly traded. This means our employees not only work in close\-knit teams with mentorship from company leaders—they also get access to the liquidity of our publicly\-traded equity. **We build today and deploy tomorrow.** Our autonomous vehicles aren’t just test concepts—they’re deployed to real clients right now. That means your work will have a tangible, visible impact. **We aren’t robots. We just develop them.** We’re a welcoming, diverse team of sharp thinkers and kind humans. Collaboration and trust drive our creative environment. At Cyngn, everyone’s perspective matters—and that’s what powers our innovation. **About the role** As a **Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer on Cyngn’s Autonomy team**, you will develop, integrate, and deploy software across the autonomous driving stack for our industrial vehicles. This role is ideal for a strong robotics generalist who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. Depending on the problem, you may contribute to behavior and decision\-making, motion planning, controls, localization, perception interfaces, simulation, or vehicle integration. You will work closely with engineers across autonomy, vehicle infrastructure, hardware, QA, and deployment to turn robotics algorithms into reliable production systems operating on autonomous tuggers and forklifts at customer sites. **What you'll do** * Design, develop, test, and deploy software for autonomous industrial vehicles across areas including behavior and decision\-making, motion planning, controls, and vehicle systems. * Write and maintain production\-quality C\+\+ and Python software running on Cyngn’s autonomous vehicle platforms. * Develop and integrate algorithms for navigation, trajectory generation, vehicle control, obstacle handling, and autonomous behaviors. * Integrate autonomy software with sensors, drive\-by\-wire systems, vehicle hardware, and other onboard software components. * Bring up, validate, and debug software on real vehicles, tracing issues across autonomy modules, middleware, hardware interfaces, and vehicle behavior. * Develop simulation scenarios, testing infrastructure, metrics, and regression tests to validate autonomy behavior before deployment. * Investigate field issues and edge cases, reproduce failures, identify root causes, and implement robust production solutions. * Support deployment and validation of autonomous vehicles at customer facilities, translating real\-world observations into improvements across the autonomy stack. * Collaborate closely with engineers in Planning, Controls, Perception, Localization, Vehicle Infrastructure, Hardware, QA, and Operations. * Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical design, and continuous improvement of Cyngn’s autonomy software. **Priorities: 3\-6\-12 Month Goals** **First 90 Days** * Build a working understanding of Cyngn’s jobs.description: **ABOUT THE BRAND:** Callaway Golf Company is a premium golf equipment, gear and apparel company with a portfolio of global brands, including Callaway Golf, Odyssey, TravisMathew, and OGIO.
