Our company is a blend of experience and diverse backgrounds, and together we look to leave the past behind while moving the game forward. For more information, please visit https://www.callawaygolf.com **ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** The Software Engineer is accountable for the following responsibilities: * Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain backend services, workflows, integrations, and APIs supporting commerce applications. * Develop services primarily using C\#/.NET, Java/Spring Boot, and TypeScript/Node.js based on platform and business needs. * Apply object\-oriented design and established software engineering principles to create maintainable, scalable, and testable systems. * Build services supporting order management, inventory, payments, tax, loyalty, customer identity, product data, and related commerce capabilities. * Extend and integrate modular headless commerce platforms such as Medusa, and design middleware and backend\-for\-frontend layers connecting storefronts, commerce engines, and downstream services. * Define clear API contracts using REST, OpenAPI, and related tools so frontend and backend teams can develop independently. * Integrate payment and tax platforms, including transaction flows for authorization, capture, refund, void, tokenization, idempotency, reconciliation, checkout, orders, and returns. * Build reliable integrations and data pipelines between commerce systems and enterprise platforms such as SAP and Salesforce Commerce Cloud. * Work with product, pricing, catalog, customer, order, and inventory data at scale while protecting data integrity. * Participate in platform and service migrations, including field mapping, validation, idempotent processing, reconciliation, cutover planning, and rollback preparation. * Design relational database schemas, develop migrations, and troubleshoot query and application performance. * Build automated unit, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end tests. * Deploy and operate services using containers, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure, primarily within Microsoft Azure. * Troubleshoot production issues across application, API, database, integration, and infrastructure boundaries, and contribute to incident response and root\-cause analysis. * Reduce unnecessary complexity and repetitive work by improving architecture, documentation, tooling, guardrails, and automation. Partner with frontend engineers, product teams, business stakeholders, enterprise technology teams, and external vendors to define requirements, communicate trade\-offs, and deliver integrated solutions. * **AI\-FIRST ENGINEERING EXPECTATIONS** * Use AI agents to analyze unfamiliar codebases, legacy systems, APIs, schemas, logs, and technical documentation before implementation begins. * Use AI during design and planning to explore architecture options, identify risks, challenge assumptions, evaluate trade\-offs, and develop implementation plans with dependencies, sequencing, testing, migration, acceptance criteria, and rollback considerations. * Break complex initiatives into clearly scoped tasks and use coding agents for meaningful implementation work, including multi\-file changes, refactoring, API development, data mapping, automated testing, documentation, and repetitive engineering activities. * Provide AI agents with appropriate context, constraints, architecture guidance, security requirements, examples, and acceptance criteria. * Critically review, run, test, inspect, and validate AI\-generated designs and code; require iteration when results do not meet engineering or production standards. * Use AI to accelerate debugging through analysis of logs, traces, production behavior, code paths, and historical implementations. * Coordinate specialized agents when appropriate for backend architecture, database design, security, API review, migration analysis, and test automation. * Improve repositories and development environments so engineers and AI agents can work effectively through clear documentation, project instructions, tests, tooling, and guardrails. Continuously identify manual or repetitive work that can be safely delegated, automated, or supported by AI while retaining responsibility for the final outcome. * **TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES (Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities)** * Strong knowledge of object\-  and backend\-for\-frontend architecture. * Working knowledge of relational database design and development using SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including schema design, migrations, normalization, and query troubleshooting. * Working knowledge of Git, automated testing, containers, CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure, preferably Microsoft Azure. * Knowledge of distributed\-system reliability concepts such as retries, idempotency, reconciliation, transaction integrity, fault handling, and secure data exchange. Practical knowledge of modern AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar coding agents. * **Skills \& Abilities** * Ability to translate business and technical requirements into secure, reliable, maintainable, and scalable software solutions. * Ability to investigate ambiguous problems systematically and diagnose issues spanning applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and infrastructure. * Ability to create implementation plans, define acceptance criteria, estimate work, identify dependencies, and communicate technical risks and trade\-offs. * Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated architecture and code and remain accountable for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and design. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, collaborate across technical and nontechnical teams, and deliver results in an environment that includes modern cloud services and legacy platforms. Ability to document systems, decisions, operating procedures, and previously undocumented technical knowledge clearly. * **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience required. * Minimum four years of professional software engineering experience building production applications, backend services, or enterprise integrations required. * Experience building REST APIs, services, middleware, or integration layers and working with relational databases required. * Experience developing automated tests and using Git and modern CI/CD practices required. * Demonstrated hands\-on use of modern AI development tools for analysis, planning, implementation, debugging, testing, documentation, or refactoring required. * Experience with eCommerce, order management, payments, inventory, SAP integrations, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, headless commerce, Azure, Docker, or Kubernetes preferred. Experience migrating functionality from legacy or monolithic platforms and building reliable high\-volume integrations preferred. * **DISCLAIMER** This job description indicates, in general terms, the type and level of work performed as well as the typical responsibilities of employees in this classification, and it may be changed by management at any time. Other duties may also apply. Nothing in this position description changes the at\-will employment relationship existing between the Company and its employees. Distribution of this item outside of the Company without an authorized release is a violation of Company policy. **DE\&I and EEOC:** ***Inclusion \& Diversity:*** As a purpose\-led, performance driven company, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, supporting them to bring their authentic selves to work every day. *If your experience is close to what we’re looking for, please consider applying. Experience comes in many forms, skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way. We know that diverse backgrounds and experiences make for the best problem\-solving and creative thinking, which is why we’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and encourage everyone to apply. We look forward to learning more about you.* **ARE YOU READY TO MAKE THE TURN? APPLY TODAY!** 104,700\.00 \- 130,900\.00 \- 157,100\.00 USD Annual

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Query
jobs.description: ### **About CircleCI Engineering** CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them. At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here. ### **About the Query Team** Every pipeline, job, and test that runs on CircleCI generates data, and that history is one of our biggest advantages in an agentic software delivery lifecycle. Flaky test detection, test insights, pipeline search, and agents that reason about why a build failed all depend on fast, reliable access to it. The Query team owns the system that makes this possible. We pull product data out of the transactional services that create it and store it in datastores built for historical and analytical workloads. We serve it through domain\-level APIs to CircleCI's product teams and to customers through our public API. Our goal is to make storing data "fire and forget" for every other team, and querying it fast and dependable at a scale that keeps growing. ### **What You'll Do** * **Build AI\-natively.** AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved. * **Shape how we store data at scale.** Own and harden our ClickHouse\-based storage layer. Design schemas for known and emerging access patterns, and tune ingestion and query performance to support production\-scale data. * **Build the pipelines that move our data.** Design and own ingestion from event streams and durable workflows built on Temporal. Data should arrive reliably, stay queryable while it's in transit, and never slow down the critical path of the services that produce it. * **Serve data to the product and to customers.** Evolve our platform into the default path for historical queries. Make getting historical data easy, not a bottleneck. Teams should be able to get what they need quickly and with minimal hand\-holding, while Query keeps enough visibility into how the data is used to optimize ingestion and reads across every consumer. Build in the indexing, caching, and tiered storage required to keep it performant. * **Set technical direction.** When the problem is complex or the answer isn't obvious, you lead the design discussion, write up the architecture decision, and make the call. You help decide which data domain we migrate next and how. * **Champion observability.** Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to understand ingestion lag, query latency, and data correctness. For a data platform, operational data drives stability, not just incident response. * **Keep things moving.** You take ambiguous data problems from design to production quickly, and you help the people around you move faster too. You don't just patch problems, you ask why they happened. You'll fix the immediate issue, then solve the underlying team practice, process, or system that let it through. ### **What You'll Bring** * **AI\-native engineering practices.** You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short. * **Hands\-on data experience.** You've built or owned data\-intensive systems such as ingestion pipelines, event\-driven architectures, or analytical and time\-series datastores. You understand the tradeoffs between transactional and analytical storage, and you've designed schemas and tuned queries for high\-volume workloads. Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar database is a strong plus. * **Backend depth in Go.** You're strong in Go, or strong in a comparable language and eager to work in Go: interface design, data modeling, service integration, and concurrency. Familiarity with React and TypeScript is a plus, since you'll occasionally work on the product surfaces that display this data. * **Distributed systems judgment.** You understand delivery guarantees, idempotency, backpressure, and failure recovery. You know when to rely on a framework's reliability guarantees rather than building your own. * **Technical leadership.** You've led the design of complex systems and made tradeoffs deliberately. You leave foundations others can build on. You raise the quality bar through reviews, mentoring, and direct feedback, not just through the code you write. * **A track record of shipping.** 5\+ years building and operating production backend systems. Your work has served real users, and you've treated latency, reliability, and correctness as design concerns. ### **Sound like you?** You care about how data powers the product, not just where it lives. You know how to make a datastore fast at scale, and have tuned schemas and queries against real production load. You think like a platform engineer, measuring your work by how much it unblocks the teams building on it. AI isn't a tool you reach for occasionally; it's a core part of how you approach and solve problems. If that sounds like you, we want to talk. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. **About CircleCI** CircleCI is the world's largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most\-used DevOps tools \- processing more than 3 million jobs a day \- CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture\-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. **How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring** At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you. **Where we may use AI** * *Job descriptions and messaging*: AI may help draft job descriptions and role\-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate. * *Application review*: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. * *Interview notes*: With advance notice, an AI note\-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected. * *Outreach*: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending. **Our commitment** AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change. **Your choices** You can ask for human\-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note\-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com. For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.description: **Build Your Future with the City of Boca Raton!** At the City of Boca Raton, a career in public service is more than a job — it’s your chance to make a meaningful impact in a vibrant and sustainable coastal community. Driven by our core values of **Fairness, Integrity, Respect, Service**, and **Trust**, we are committed to fostering a workplace where employees feel appreciated, inspired, and supported. **Why Boca Raton?** **As the second largest city in Palm Beach County, the City of Boca Raton offers robust benefits to their employees:** * **Health Insurance Benefits**: No\-cost employee Medical, Dental \& Vision plans * **Generous Paid Time Off**: 12 paid holidays \+ vacation, sick, and 3 floating holidays * **Continuous Service Benefit**: Paid out annually after 5 years of service * **Work\-Life Balance**: Flexible work schedule * **Retirement Plans**: Two pension/retirement options to choose from Whether you're starting out or looking to take your public service career to the next level, the City of Boca Raton offers the tools, resources, and culture to help you succeed. **Apply now and join the city that’s building careers and shaping a stronger tomorrow!** **General Statement of Job:** Performs engineering and administrative work in the design of public works infrastructure; managing (with support) a variety of maintenance and capital improvements projects, including contract administration; project management from concept through construction; performs construction inspections; review and comment developers engineering projects; does related work as required. Reports directly to the Assistant City Engineer or the Capital Improvement Project Manager. **Positions Available:** * **Civil Project Engineer I:** Starting salary range from $75,449\.17 to $96,725\.84, based on education, experience and certifications. * **Civil Project Engineer II:** Starting salary range from $83,182\.71 to $106,640\.23, based on education, experience and certifications. * **Civil Project Engineer III:** Starting salary range from $91,708\.94 to $117,570\.86, based on education, experience and certifications. **Essential Functions** ----------------------- * Prepares and reviews a variety of estimates, designs, and specifications for a variety of capital improvements projects conducted by in\-house staff and consultants. * Provides project management and engineering work on capital improvement projects. * Reviews and approves site and construction plans, and specification for codes conformance to established departmental standards, policies, and sound engineering principles. * Reviews and approves pay request/invoices and change orders for construction projects. * Participates in the preparation of specifications, maps, plans, profiles, field notes, and designs of capital improvement projects. * Reviews, authorizes, and monitors construction permit compliance by private developers, inspects projects, prepares cost estimates, and initiates for noncompliance. * Reviews new development and redevelopment projects, engineering and construction plans to assure compliance with applicable Federal, State, and local laws, regulations, policies and procedures and makes recommendations for necessary revisions. * Responds to resident, business, and other City customer inquiries. * Works in conjunction with consulting engineers and other governmental agencies on the coordination of capital projects. * Assists in the preparation of long\-range plans for needed capital improvements. * Coordinates the activities of City, State and the Federal agencies, private contractors, and others involved with City projects. * Reviews municipal and private development projects for compliance with National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) requirements. * Assists with all tasks related to NPDES reporting requirements related to City stormwater utility systems * Works in conjunction with GIS Analyst on the data maintenance and management of the GIS stormwater utility assets and operations. * Provides support to Stormwater and Streets Divisions **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** ----------------------------------- Knowledge of * The principles and practices of civil engineering as related to the preparation of plans and specifications, design, construction, and maintenance of public works projects. * Modern methods and techniques as applied to the design, construction, and maintenance of public works projects. * Construction management. * Federal, State, and local laws governing local municipalities. Skilled in * Engineering plan preparation and review * Land and engineering survey systems, methods, and techniques of engineering drafting * The principles, practices, and techniques of computer\-aided engineering drafting * Prepare and present technical reports Ability to * Establish and maintain effective working relationships with City officials, employees, contractors, and general public * Express ideas clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing * Present to City officials, employees, contractors, and the general public * Attend after\-hour meetings as needed **Minimum and Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------------------- **Selected candidate may be considered for placement within the classification and pay range of Civil Project Engineer I, Civil Project Engineer II, or Civil Project Engineer III, subject to the criteria outlined below.** **Civil Project Engineer I** * Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in Engineering, Construction Management or related field. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: * Experience with hydraulic modeling and computer\-aided design (CAD). jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Network Engineering
jobs.description: The Team / Who We Are We build and operate the infrastructure backbone that powers one of the financial services industry's most demanding SaaS platforms. Our Platform Infrastructure Engineering team manages both the network engineering and systems engineering functions, sitting at the critical intersection of carrier\-class networking, data center operations, cloud integration, and financial technology — ensuring that mission\-critical investment accounting, portfolio analytics, and data connectivity services run with carrier\-grade reliability, 24/7, for over a thousand of the largest hedge funds, asset managers, family offices, insurers and corporations. This is a hands\-on manager role where you lead through technical depth and strong network engineering expertise. You'll drive infrastructure strategy, mentor your teams, and spend significant time on the network engineering challenges that define our platform's reliability. Your domain expertise in network architecture, routing protocols, and data center operations is as critical as your leadership capabilities. What We Need We're looking for an experienced engineering leader who brings strong hands\-on network engineering expertise to manage both Network Engineering and Systems Engineering squads. You'll be the strategic lead for our entire infrastructure platform—from edge routing and firewalls through data center LAN design, all the way up through Linux systems, virtualization, container orchestration, and cloud integration. This is not a purely people\-management role. You'll stay deeply involved in architecture decisions, technology evaluations, and hands\-on problem\-solving—especially in network engineering. You need to be credible technically with your teams, capable of diving into BGP routing issues, MPLS configurations, data center network design, and cross\-vendor integrations with the same rigor you apply to team leadership and hiring. You'll work with our software engineering, security, DevOps, data operations, and client connectivity teams to architect and operate a hybrid on\-premises/public\-cloud environment where network reliability is non\-negotiable. You'll be both a technical escalation point for complex infrastructure issues and an organizational leader setting direction and mentoring high\-performing teams. Primary Responsibilities In this role, you'll own and contribute to the following: * Lead, mentor, and scale both the Network Engineering and Systems Engineering squads; set technical direction, hire high performers, and create a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement. * Own network infrastructure strategy: design and implement scalable data center LAN architectures on Cisco, edge routing on Arista, and edge security on Palo Alto; drive BGP routing strategy for external connectivity with clients, vendors, and partners. * Drive MPLS strategy, implementation, and optimization across our hybrid on\-premises/public\-cloud environment; ensure MPLS\-based traffic engineering and failover mechanisms meet carrier\-grade reliability standards. * Lead data center network operations: manage LAN/WAN/MAN networks, oversee connectivity provisioning, handle infrastructure technology reviews and purchasing decisions. * Own full\-stack systems engineering: Linux systems administration, hypervisor/VM operations, Kubernetes cluster strategy and operations, CI/CD pipeline architecture, and infrastructure\-as\-code frameworks. * Drive observability and reliability: design monitoring, alerting, and log aggregation strategies; establish SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs aligned with financial platform requirements. * Architect and operate the platform's hybrid cloud footprint: manage on\-premises infrastructure, AWS integration, co\-location facilities, and ensure seamless connectivity and failover across environments. * Champion infrastructure automation and tooling: drive adoption of Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent IaC frameworks; evangelize configuration management and infrastructure versioning practices. * Support financial data connectivity: ensure robust integration patterns for market data feeds, custodian integrations, FIX/SWIFT/SFTP protocols, and third\-party data vendor connectivity. * Partner with Security and Compliance to ensure infrastructure adherence to SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and applicable financial industry regulatory requirements. * Evaluate emerging technologies and vendor solutions; make architectural recommendations grounded in operational maturity, business impact, and team capability. * Lead incident response for platform\-level outages; drive root cause analysis and permanent resolution of systemic reliability issues. You Are a Great Fit If You're a hands\-on technical leader with deep expertise in network engineering. You can design a data center network, explain BGP configuration trade\-offs with conviction, and dive into a production incident without needing context from your team. You take ownership, ship c s and vendor\-specific configurations. * Strong expertise in MPLS design, implementation, and troubleshooting; experience with MPLS\-based traffic engineering, Fast Reroute (FRR), or segment routing is expected. * Experience with layer 2 technologies (VPLS, multicast, spanning\-tree, VXLAN, dark fiber terminations); understanding of next\-generation data center network architectures. * Hands\-on Linux systems administration with RHEL and Debian\-based distributions; strong command\-line proficiency and systems\-level diagnostic ability. * Production\-grade experience with Kubernetes cluster operations, workload scheduling, resource governance, and service mesh configuration. * Proven infrastructure automation experience: Ansible, Terraform, Salt, or equivalent IaC tooling—not just scripting, but designing automation frameworks. * CI/CD platform expertise: GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Spinnaker, or equivalent; solid understanding of software delivery pipeline design. * Hands\-on observability stack experience: Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Stack (ELK/EFK), CheckMk, or equivalent enterprise monitoring and log aggregation tooling. * Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/PKI, load balancing, VPN, security architectures—especially as applied to host\-based and data center environments. * Experience working with Tier 1/Tier 2 global ISPs and configuring BGP routing with external partners and clients. * Familiarity with financial data connectivity: FIX protocol, SWIFT messaging, SFTP/FTPS file transfer workflows, market data feed management, and custodian integration patterns. * Experience with SOC 2, PCI\-DSS, or equivalent compliance frameworks; understanding of audit evidence, access control, and change management. * Solid scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Perl, or equivalent; comfort with API\-driven infrastructure management. * Strong communication skills: ability to explain complex technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders, lead technical discussions, write clear documentation. Preferred * Experience with hybrid and public cloud platforms (AWS EC2/EKS/RDS/S3\); cost governance and FinOps awareness. * Familiarity with server virtualization platforms (ProxMox, VMware vSphere, or equivalent). * Hands\-on experience with extranet providers and services (TNS, MegaPort, ECX). * Working knowledge of relational database systems (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and time\-series data stores in financial contexts. * Java application understanding: JVM internals, tuning, GC analysis (given financial platform prevalence of Java services). * Exposure to financial regulatory environments: SEC, FINRA, MiFID II, or similar. * Experience with secrets management and certificate lifecycle tooling (HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, Let's Encrypt). * Leadership certifications or training (Certified Scrum Product Owner, leadership coaching, etc.). * Industry certifications: CCNP, CCIE (highly desired), JNCIP\-\*, JNCIE\-\*, RHCA, CKA/CKAD, or equivalent. * Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field—or equivalent practical experience. **Salary Range** $171,000\.00 \- $244,150\.00*This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job\-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. For this role, benefits include: health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), PTO, parental leave, and medical leave, STD/LTD insurance benefits. Clearwater Analytics is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.*

All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes. **Role Type**: This is a full\-time position **About the Team** The Platform Operations team at College Board builds solutions to help reimagine and elevate engineering practices around cloud infrastructure, architecture, networking, CI/CD, IaC, and developer experience. We operationalize the platforms that are core to our development environment within our growing AWS ecosystem. We also lead the organization's approach to agentic and AI\-assisted software development, helping engineering teams safely and effectively adopt AI coding agents and tools. Our team consists of engineers with a unique blend of skills and experiences that foster a collaborative working environment where each individual member contributes to the success of the team. We learn and teach. We are creative and value the merit of ideas. **About the Opportunity** As a Senior Engineer focused on Agentic Engineering Governance for Open Source software, you are an idea\-generator, a catalyst, and a collaborator who sets the standard for how College Board engineers use AI coding agents and agentic development tools safely, responsibly, and effectively. You understand cloud software delivery, tools, and processes that empower efficient and resilient delivery, and you bring that same rigor to the guardrails, policies, and standards that govern how developers use AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and similar agentic tools). You are technologically curious and seek opportunities to research emerging technologies and trends, standards, and products. Your eagerness and vision enable you to create and learn complex solutions. Your focus will be on the fast\-moving area of agentic governance for open\-source software, where you build the program for license compliance, dependency risk, and review of the code we publish externally. You thrive in an environment with a strong mix of creativity and productivity, splitting your time between hands\-on building and setting the standards others follow. You work closely with Security, Legal, and the developers who rely on us. Your excellent communication and mentoring skills allow you to effectively articulate solutions and policies to the team, enabling all to make healthy, well\-governed contributions. The result is that the teams building for 7 million students each year can adopt AI with confidence. *In this role, you will:* Design \& Implementation (60%) * Design and implement guardrails, permission models, and policy\-as\-code controls that govern how AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and similar agentic tools) interact with source code, infrastructure, and production systems * Build solutions using the best practices of Agile, CI/CD, and DevOps * Build and maintain tooling for sandboxing, audit logging, and rollback of agent\-driven code and infrastructure changes * Continuously develop the skills required to work as part of the agile team in a poly\-skilled development environment, including hands\-on use of agentic coding tools * Be a subject matter expert in current technological capabilities such as cloud networking, API integrations, infrastructure resiliency, cloud design, and agentic/AI\-assisted development patterns * Write code to automate the infrastructure lifecycle, create and support internal tools utilizing IaC, and be able to use CLIs * Evaluate and pilot emerging agentic programming tools, frameworks, and protocols (e.g., MCP, agent orchestration frameworks), and make adoption recommendations * Partner with domain SMEs (Delivery Team Software Engineers, Security, Infrastructure, Network, Observability and Operations) to analyze features, capabilities, and risks of agentic tooling * Contribute to the development and growth of the Cloud Engineering Program, through thought leadership, design and implementation of tools and processes * Participate in the Enterprise Architecture Review process, with a focus on proposals involving AI coding agents and agentic tooling Governance \& Strategy (25%) * Establish and maintain organization\-wide standards, guardrails, and acceptable\-use policies for agentic and AI\-assisted software development * Partner with Security, Legal/Compliance, and Architecture Review stakeholders to assess risk and approve new use cases for AI coding agents * Contribute to technology strategy and planning; conduct research on emerging agentic and AI development technologies and recommend approaches that increase safety, cost effectiveness, and systems flexibility * Author documentation, playbooks, and governance frameworks for developers using AI coding assistants * Participate in agile scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Grooming,  itHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf) or other LLM\-based developer tooling * Experience with LLM platforms and APIs such as Anthropic Claude or OpenAI, including agent orchestration and tool\-use concepts like function calling and MCP * Understanding of AI/LLM security considerations such as prompt injection, data exfiltration, permission scoping, and sandboxing * Experience establishing technical standards, guardrails, or review processes across an engineering organization, in responsible AI governance or an adjacent discipline such as security * Technical knowledge of Cloud Computing, DevOps, and Microservices, with strong experience in distributed cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred, with experience in services such as Lambda, SNS, SQS, S3, Step Functions, EC2, ECS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, and DynamoDB a plus) * Experience building event\-driven cloud\-based serverless applications * A strong background in a language such as Python, JavaScript, React.js/Node.js, or Java, with the logic and problem\-solving skills to pick up new languages quickly * Excellent communication, collaboration, and documentation skills; ability to present ideas in business\-friendly and user\-friendly language, including to non\-technical stakeholders on AI governance topics * Experience supporting developers as internal customers, gathering their requirements and feedback, and earning adoption of the standards you set * Curiosity and discipline to research emerging technologies, standards, and products, and the ability to prioritize and execute in a high\-pressure environment *All roles at College Board require:* * A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission\-driven work * Authorization to work in the United States for any employer * Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI\-driven solutions and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. * Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal * A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input * A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data\-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking * A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success **About Our Process** * Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. * While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks. **What We Offer** At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Through a partnership\-based approach, Coterie helps insurance professionals unlock untapped revenue in the small commercial space. With an innovative quoting platform that delivers accurate pricing and bindable quotes in less than one minute, Coterie makes small business insurance effortless. We are on a mission to build and foster a world\-class team to bring speed, simplicity, and service to commercial insurance. We value integrity, humility, passion, and intelligence. If you want to push yourself and reshape a $200B\+ market, we’re excited to talk to you! **What will the Sr Software Engineer (Backend) do?** The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for leading the design, development, and maintenance of complex software systems that support organizational goals. This role provides technical direction, contributes to architectural decisions, and ensures the quality, scalability, and performance of engineering solutions. The Senior Software Engineer mentors team members, drives continuous improvement, and collaborates with cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver reliable and efficient software aligned with business needs. All engineers are granted a Claude Code premium license and are encouraged to leverage AI in their work **Key Responsibilities:** * Designs and implements complex systems; mentors others * Owns end\-to\-end delivery of significant features * Ensures code quality, scalability, and maintainability * Influences technical direction and team practices. **Required Qualifications:** * 5\+ years software engineering experience * 5\+ years working in the insurance industry * 5\+ years building production ready APIs in C\# with .NET 5\+ * Experience working within a micro\-services architecture in a containerized environment. * Experience working with cloud\-based SQL and NoSQL Databases, and other cloud\-based services to build scalable applications. * Experience using Git and GitHub to collaborate and review code. * Experience writing Unit tests and automated integration tests (Postman or equivalent) * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to debug issues and improve system performance. * Collaborates effectively with cross\-functional teams and participates in code reviews. * Willingness to learn new technologies and contribute to continuous improvement. **Our interview process:** Our hiring process generally consists of 4 phases. The goal is to provide an opportunity for us to learn more about our candidates while allowing them to get to know us as well! * **Phase 1**: Qualified candidates will first meet with a member of our People Operations team for a phone interview. This discussion is a high\-level conversation to understand more about your background and interests and for us to share more about Coterie and the position. * **Phase 2**: Selected candidates will be invited to meet with our Hiring Manager for a 2nd interview via Teams video. This interview is designed to be more detail oriented and allows you to learn more about the role and expected to be 30 minutes in length. * **Phase 3**: Top candidates will be invited to interview with members of our engineering team via Teams video. This series will include participating in live coding exercise/discussion. This series is expected to be 2 hours in length. * **Phase 4:** Final candidates will receive an invite to interview with our CTO. This video interview is expected to be 30 minutes in length. **What's in it for you:** Coterie has excellent benefits for all full\-time employees. We offer the following: * 100% remote * Health insurance through Aetna (we pay 100% of premiums) * Dental and vision insurance through Guardian (we pay 100% of premiums) * Basic life insurance (we pay 100% of premiums) * Access to flexible spending account (FSA) or health savings account (HSA) (for those using HSA eligible plans) * 401K plan (up 4% match with immediate vest). Must be 21 years of age or older to participate * Flexible PTO policy offering employees up to 4 weeks of PTO in their first 12 months. Thereafter, PTO usage aligns with company standards and typically does not exceed 5 weeks per calendar year. * 12 company\-paid holidays each year * Continuing education annual stipend * Annual salary estimated between $140,000\-$165,000 based on national data. Candidates who meet all the minimum requirements and possess additional relevant experience, as outlined in the job description, may be considered for a salary above the midpoint of the above range. Salary is based on internal equity; internal salary ranges; market data/ranges; applicant’s skills; prior relevant experience; degrees or certifications, etc. **Work Authorization:** At this time, Coterie Insurance is unable to consider candidates who require current or future visa sponsorship. Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future. Falsification of an application, including work authorization status, is immediate grounds for dismissal from consideration.

jobs.description: **Systems Administrator I/II/III** ================================== Salary $80,516\.80 \- $141,668\.80 Annually Location San Luis Obispo, CA Job Type Permanent \- Salary Job Number 1026PM\-002263\-01 Department Information Technology Division ITD Administration Opening Date 10/16/2026 Closing Date 11/1/2026 11:59 PM Pacific * Description * Benefits * Questions **About the Position** ---------------------- San Luis Obispo County Information Technology Department (ITD) offers an exciting, fast\-paced environment where exceptional performance is encouraged and rewarded. ITD consists of 84 staff within four (4\) operational Divisions: Administration; Applications; Customer Service / Delivery; and Infrastructure. ITD resources are operated and maintained in a manner that supports high availability of services while minimizing risk of business interruption. ITD's focus is on developing a sustainable customer focused technology environment that enhances and improves the quality of technology services used by County departments for the benefit of all San Luis Obispo County residents, businesses, and visitors. This career opportunity provides candidates the exposure of working with all county departments; essentially 23 different industries. The County supports a work\-life balance and hybrid work environment, provides a generous pension, and provides an outstanding community\-oriented environment. **About the Opportunity** The Systems Administrator I/II/III performs a variety of technical duties by providing technical support including the planning, installation, coordination, maintenance, upgrades and overall support for computer systems and their individual hardware and software components; administers, evaluates and modifies systems to assure proper security and operation; plans, coordinates and implements system software program release changes for systems and servers; resolves technology problems and provides for system enhancements; provides technical support and assistance to customers; and does other related work as required. **Typical Tasks and Representative Duties** * Configures, operates and maintains programs, databases and systems. * Troubleshoots problems with programs, databases and system software to successful resolution. * Maintains end user software accounts. * Performs program, data and system backups and restoration activities. * Researches and resolves problems and makes technical recommendations. * Prepares customer, operations and systems documentation according to pre\-established standards. * Provides assistance to customers during and after the conversion, implementation, or installation of new hardware, software and applications. * Communicates with County staff, vendors, customers and outside agencies to exchange information, coordinate activities and resolve issues or concerns. * Maintains current knowledge and communicates with external vendors For complete job description for Systems Administrator I click here. For complete job description for Systems Administrator II click here. For complete job description for Systems Administrator III click here. To learn more about the San Luis Obispo County's Information Technology Department Click Here. **The Ideal Candidate** ----------------------- **The ideal candidate will join an existing team of highly experienced enterprise system administrators. The ideal candidate will possess the following:** **Interpersonal competencies – the ideal candidate will be able to demonstrate the following interpersonal skills:** * Have a positive attitude with a “get it done correctly” the first\-time mind set * Have a high degree of self\-motivation * Have a passion for keeping technologies current and a willingness to learn new technologies * Be able to implement a careful and meticulous approach to configuring complex IT systems * Have strong analytic, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills to avoid service interruption * Be able to plan and execute work independently and as a team member * Be able to prioritize and manage several tasks daily * Be able to collaborate with others to solve problems, design solutions and implement changes * Have strong verbal and written communication skills * Interact in difficult situations with a professional, thoughtful, and open demeanor **Systems Administration Experience – the ideal candidate will have knowledge of and experience with administering and supporting the following technologies:** * Microsoft Office 365 online services including Exchange Online, Teams, and OneDrive * Microsoft SharePoint Online websites and Power Platform services * Microsoft Server operating system configuration and optimization * Microsoft Azure Cloud Computing servers and services * Microsoft Active Directory and Single Sign\-on authentication services * Microsoft PowerShell and other scripting languages * Microsoft SQL database administration, optimization, and reporting * Microsoft SCCM, SCOM, and Intune administration and  ntal (HMO, PPO) and Vision Insurance * Health enhancing programs such as Hinge Health, GIThrive and Carrum Health for medical enrollees. * Cafeteria (County contribution to pay for insurance premiums) * Free visits to the employee health clinic * Mental Health resources/benefits including Headspace * Voluntary insurance plans (life insurance, disability, critical illness and many more) * A lifelong retirement benefit through the San Luis Obispo County Pension Trust * Optional deferred compensation plan with up to $500 per year match (depending on bargaining unit) * Tax savings accounts (medical and dependent care) * Paid personal, sick and vacation days * 12 paid holidays * Employee Assistance Program * Education and Wellness Allowance * Post Employment Health Plan * Family Friendly workplace policies * Flexible work schedule options * Rideshare commuter benefits * Pet Insurance The County of San Luis Obispo has been recognized as a Diamond Level Family Friendly Workplace by San Luis Obispo Chamber of Commerce. We support our employees through: childcare assistance, flexible scheduling practices, paid and unpaid leave, comprehensive health benefits, flexible spending accounts, and employee assistance programs. **Pension Benefit and Employee Contribution Rates:** The County's pension is a defined benefit plan that provides a guaranteed monthly pension payment for life based on your time in service, wages, and other factors. The County is the primary contributor to the pension fund, but the health of the pension fund also depends on mandatory employee contributions. Employees are required to pay a percentage of their base pay towards the pension fund, ranging from 5% to 19%. This amount is deducted from your paycheck pre\-tax every pay period. jobs.title: Staff, Back-end engineer (Inventory Platform)
jobs.description: **Company Introduction** We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did we ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi\-billion\-dollar e\-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest\-growing e\-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce. We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurial surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world. **Job Overview** Coupang relies on technology to provide on\-time, fast delivery of products to customers every day. Inventory Platform organization comprises critical services and platforms that take care of delivering customer orders optimally right from the moment the order is placed up until it is successfully delivered at the doorstep of the customer. Building highly available and scalable systems to handle billions of order \& delivery transactions and support Coupang's rapidly growing Product Commerce business is a complex architectural challenge. We are responsible for delivering products to millions of online shopping customers by improving order reconciliation with technology. To deliver this challenge, we are looking for an experienced and passionate engineer who can design and build large\-scale, multi\-tiered, distributed services. **Key Responsibilities** Demonstrate excellence resulting in scalable systems and services with the highest quality architecture and design. Responsible for benchmarking the Platform, collecting metrics \& publishing results. Responsible for measuring \& ensuring reliability and uptime of the Platform with 99\.995% guarantees. Responsible for capacity estimation \& provisioning of cluster for different customer workloads. Responsible for production incident Monitoring \& Alerting for the Platform. Detail oriented and hands on engineer who can analyze OSS Platform components and code. Dive deep into critical system issues, proactively addressing similar root causes, and raise the bar on Operational Excellence. Exposure to one of the SQL or NoSQL database systems. (Cassandra, MySQL etc.) Collaborate with other teams to make the platform open and extensible to unlock innumerable opportunities for innovations. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math, or a closely related field * 8 years of experience in backend software development * Experience working in cloud environments, particularly AWS * Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining highly available, distributed systems **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in developing and operating backend services and web applications. * Experience building complex, high\-performance, and highly available distributed software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers. * Strong familiarity developing with Java and Spring Framework as well as experience in an AWS environment. * Extensive experience in managing mission critical services with high throughput and low latency. * Solid engineering skills as a lead engineer to coach and lead high performing software engineers and keep them motivated. * Excellent communication skills to shepherd communication with end users, technical \& business teams to collect requirements, describe product features, and develop technical designs to achieve business goals. * Knowledge of Agile software engineering practices \& patterns for the full software development lifecycle including coding standards, code reviews, build processes, testing, and live site operations. * Demonstrated leadership in cross\-functional, highly collaborative environment. **Pay \& Benefits** Our compensation reflects the cost of living across several US geographic markets. At Coupang, your base pay is one part of your total compensation. The base pay for this position ranges from $164,000/year to $282,000/year. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Annual bonus is 0\-20% of the base salary. General Description of All Benefits * Medical/Dental/Vision/Life, AD\&D insurance * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) \& Health Savings Account (HSA) * Long\-term/Short\-term Disability * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) program * 401K Plan with Company Match * 18\-21 days of the Paid Time Off (PTO) a year based on the tenure * 12 Paid Holidays * Up to 6 weeks of Paid Parental leave * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * MTV \- \[Free] Electric Car Charging Station **General Description of Other Compensation** "Other Compensation" includes, but is not limited to, bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation that would be offered to the hired applicant in addition to their established salary range or wage scale. **Privacy Notice** * Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below: https://www.coupang.jobs/privacy\-policy/ *Coupang is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, or gender (including pregnancy, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, transgender status), national origin, age, disability, medical condition, HIV/AIDS or Hepatitis C status, marital status, military or veteran status, use of a trained dog guide or service animal, political activities, or affiliations, citizenship, or any other characteristic or class protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you need assistance and/or reasonable accommodation in the recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at* *usrecruiting@coupang.com**.* Job Requisition ID: R0080580

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (API/Agentic)
jobs.description: **Company Description** Cricut® empowers people to make and personalize almost anything—from custom cards and apparel to everyday items and home décor. Our smart cutting machines, design apps, and materials make creativity easy and accessible for everyone. We believe everyone is born creative, and our mission is to put the power of handmade into the hands of all. With a passionate community of Makers around the world, Cricut helps turn inspiration into real, tangible creations—one project at a time. Let’s make. **Job Description** * Spend most of your time writing, reviewing and shipping production backend code. * Use agentic coding tools as a core part of your daily workflow, including AI\-assisted code review, automated test generation and AI\-augmented development, while keeping code quality, security and human oversight in place. * Design and build APIs and services end to end, from technical approach and API contract through implementation, testing and release. * Contribute to backend architecture across our C\#/.NET and Python services, keeping them modular, maintainable and testable. * Define clear, versioned API contracts that client teams on iOS, Android and desktop can consume easily. * Work closely with Product Management, UX and client engineers to take defined features from spec to shipped, raising technical tradeoffs and feasibility early. * Optimize service performance and scalability, including latency, throughput, database query efficiency, caching, concurrency and cloud cost. * Write and maintain automated unit, integration and contract tests for your services. * Drive CI/CD automation, release quality and deployment processes for containerized cloud services. * Ship behind feature flags with progressive rollout and kill switches, and validate new behavior with production telemetry before ramping up. * Own service health through observability, tracking SLOs, error rates, latency budgets and defect trends, and take part in on\-call and incident response. * Take part in code reviews and share knowledge with other engineers. * Evaluate new backend, cloud, AI and tooling technologies, and recommend adopting them where they would meaningfully improve the team's work. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field. * 8\+ years of professional backend software development experience, with deep, production\-level expertise in either C\#/.NET (ASP.NET Core) or Python (FastAPI/Django). * Proven experience designing and running backend architectures at scale: microservices or modular monoliths, event\-driven and asynchronous messaging (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS, Azure Service Bus), and distributed systems patterns. * Strong API design skills using REST, including versioning, pagination, idempotency, error handling and OpenAPI documentation. * Strong experience with relational and NoSQL data stores (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis), including schema design, indexing and query tuning. * Strong understanding of the concurrency model in your primary language (async/await and the Task Parallel Library in .NET, or asyncio in Python). * Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP), containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or equivalent). * At least one year of hands\-on, practical use of modern AI engineering tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.), with experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into backend services where relevant (agentic patterns, evals, and latency/cost/reliability tradeoffs). * Experience with architectural patterns such as Clean Architecture, Domain\-Driven Design, CQRS or hexagonal architecture. * Strong debugging, profiling and performance optimization skills with tools such as dotTrace/PerfView, py\-spy/cProfile and APM tracing. * Experience with automated testing (unit, integration, contract, load) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). * Experience instrumenting services with observability tools (e.g., Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana). * **Bonus:** experience with both C\# and Python. * **Bonus:** experience working with client engineering teams (iOS, Android, Electron/Angular) to design APIs that fit mobile and desktop needs. Soft Skills * Communicates clearly in writing and in person with engineering, product and design. * Works well with Product Management, UX and client teams, and builds agreement on scope and tradeoffs. * Shares knowledge readily and helps other engineers on the team grow. * Stays curious about new tools and techniques, especially in AI\-assisted development, and brings practical improvements to the team. **Additional Information** **We’ve Got You Covered** At Cricut, we take care of our people. Enjoy competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, a 401(k) match, generous PTO, tuition reimbursement, and a yearly lifestyle stipend to support your wellness and passions. You’ll also receive exclusive employee discounts—and best of all, you’ll be surrounded by some of the most talented, creative, and curious minds out there. **A Quick Note Before You Apply…** Cricut is in an exciting chapter of transformation. We’re evolving fast—refining our strategy, growing our teams, and raising the bar across everything we do. This is an incredible opportunity for the right kind of person—but it’s not for everyone. We’re looking for A\-players—people who thrive in dynamic environments, turn challenges into momentum, and consistently deliver their best work. If that sounds like you, read on. **Here’s what makes someone a great fit for this role (and for this moment at Cricut):** * You move with urgency. You don’t wait for perfect clarity to act—you start, learn, and adjust. * You set high standards. You take ownership, deliver quality, and hold yourself accountable. * You stay focused when things move fast. You prioritize what matters most and tune out the noise. * You collaborate like a pro. You elevate others, communicate clearly, and bring a low\-ego, high\-output energy. * You embrace AI as part of your toolkit. From idea exploration to data analysis and creative problem\-solving, you leverage AI to accelerate innovation and amplify impact—because technology and creativity go hand\-in\-hand here. **One More Thing (It’s a Big One)** This role is in\-office at least 4–5 days per week. We believe real collaboration, innovation, and culture are built face\-to\-face. If you’re energized by working alongside smart, kind, creative people—and love those hallway conversations that spark the next great idea—you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for a fully remote role, this may not be the right fit. But if you’re excited by challenge, purpose, and building something better—let’s make something amazing together. **Relocation Statement:** * This position is eligible for relocation assistance. **What to Do Next:** Please attach your resume, cover letter and/or include links to your portfolio or other social presence. If you want to show your super powers in other ways – include that information too. You can be sure that Cricut® is an employer who values individuality, equality and diversity, so tell us what you’re all about. If you are a Maker or a DIY enthusiast, whether you think you are a good one or not, we would love to hear about it when you send us your information. Cricut® is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. This position is contingent on successfully completing a Criminal Background Check upon hire. Cricut participates in E\-Verify.

CSS (SCSS/SASS), and vanilla JavaScript, plus basic Node.js where applicable * Proven ability to build applications and systems from scratch, not just modify existing platforms * Experience designing database schemas, writing optimized queries, and handling complex datasets in SQL/MySQL * Experience with e\-commerce platforms, shopping cart technologies, and payment service providers or gateways * code review workflows * Experience with automated testing practices and CI/CD deployment pipelines * Knowledge of email infrastructure: DNS, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce handling, and deliverability best practices **Knowledge, Skills, \& Character Required:** ============================================= * Is a consistent witness for Jesus Christ; maintains a courteous, Christ\-like attitude in * jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer, Frontier Agentic AI (Remote)
jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** CrowdStrike is seeking a Distinguished Engineer to research, define, and build the future of cybersecurity AI within our Cybersecurity Superintelligence Lab. This role brings together frontier AI research, deep cybersecurity expertise, and large\-scale systems engineering. The mandate is broad: understand where AI is going, identify new approaches to cybersecurity, and build systems that fundamentally improve how defenders operate. You will build against what is possible today while anticipating what advances in models and agentic systems could make possible over the next 12\-24 months. That means thinking about the entire application and the systems behind it, from models and agents to security data, tools, and execution environments. The work may span autonomous investigation, threat hunting, adversary simulation, detection, response, and remediation. Some of the most important use cases have yet to be defined. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be one of the senior technical leaders of the Lab. You will make original technical contributions while setting direction for teams working on these problems. You will identify important research questions, develop new approaches, build prototypes, establish rigorous evaluations, and help turn successful research into capabilities that operate at CrowdStrike scale. **What You'll Do:** * Define the future of cybersecurity AI. Track advances at the frontier of AI and determine what they make possible for cybersecurity. Identify new capabilities and use cases early, with a particular focus on transforming how defenders operate. Set the research directions and technical approaches required to pursue them. * Invent and build new cybersecurity AI systems. Design end\-to\-end applications that reason across security context, use tools, coordinate, and execute complex security tasks. Determine how models, agents, security telemetry, and execution environments should work together to enable new capabilities. * Develop systems that improve through experience. Use investigations, adversary behavior, simulations, and expert feedback to improve system behavior. Explore how offensive validation and defensive outcomes can generate better evidence, evaluations, and training signals. Work directly with threat researchers, incident responders, red teamers, and other security experts to keep the research grounded in real\-world defense. * Establish rigorous evaluations. Build benchmarks, cyber environments, and evaluation harnesses that expose capabilities and failure modes. Measure security efficacy, reliability, performance, and cost. * Set technical direction across the Lab. Lead consequential research and architecture decisions across teams. Work directly on hard technical problems, mentor senior researchers and engineers, and drive alignment through prototypes, experiments, and evidence. * Turn research breakthroughs into real systems. Carry promising work beyond demonstrations and solve the technical problems required to operate against high\-volume security data and adaptive adversaries at CrowdStrike scale. * Contribute to the broader technical community. Represent CrowdStrike through research publications, open\-source contributions, technical collaborations, and engagement with the AI and cybersecurity research communities. **What You'll Need:** * PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Neuroscience, or a related quantitative field. * A sustained record of original work at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, including research or systems that introduced new capabilities, approaches, or applications. * Deep cybersecurity expertise developed t ools, data, and execution environments. * Strong applied research instincts and quantitative rigor. You can formulate hypotheses, design meaningful experiments, establish credible baselines, and follow the evidence. * Experience taking sophisticated ML or AI systems from research prototypes to real\-world deployment. * Demonstrated technical leadership across teams, including setting research and engineering direction, mentoring senior technical talent, and influencing major decisions through technical depth and evidence. * Research or engineering experience with autonomous or multi\-agent systems, long\-horizon reasoning, adversary simulation, or closed\-loop security systems. * Experience with adversarial learning, reinforcement learning, model post\-training, synthetic data, or other methods for improving AI systems through interaction and feedback. * Experience building AI systems for high\-volume, latency\-sensitive cybersecurity environments. * Experience architecting and building extensible AI or agentic platforms that enable teams to develop, evaluate, optimize, and deploy sophisticated AI applications at scale. * Contributions to influential research, open\-source software, or technical communities spanning AI and cybersecurity. \#LI\-AM1 **Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:** * Market leader in compensation and equity awards * Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs * Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge * Paid parental and adoption leaves * Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role * Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections * Vibrant office culture with world class amenities * Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Product
jobs.description: **About Decagon** Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences. Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel. We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others. We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team. **About the Team** Product Engineering at Decagon builds all aspects of the platform our customers use to create, operate, and improve their AI agents. We turn work that currently requires an engineer into product that a CX team can run themselves. This team is core to how Decagon scales. The frameworks we build support every agent we have in production, each with its own workflows, data, and constraints. We build the agents too, and that’s what keeps the platform honest: a failure mode we debug in production becomes a guardrail, an eval, or a piece of tooling that catches it everywhere. Our agents run for companies like Hertz, American Airlines, and Notion across chat, voice, email, and SMS. **About the Role** You’ll design and build the systems that let customers configure, train, test, and monitor sophisticated AI agents with confidence. That means strong engineering underneath, and abstractions on top that hold up across different use cases without forking per customer. You’ll work day to day with product and design: joining discovery, defining requirements, reviewing designs, and iterating through launch. You’ll stay close enough to customers to understand their use cases in depth and to ensure what you’re building is actually right for them. Engineers here own features end to end, from technical architecture through deployment and the iteration after it. **In this role, you will** * Eliminate manual work by building self\-serve functionality for agent configuration, training, and deployment * Design configuration abstractions that balance power and simplicity, handling diverse enterprise use cases while staying usable by non\-technical teams * Build AI\-powered tooling that lets CX and ops teams create and manage complex agent workflows without writing code * Build monitoring, tracing, and analytics that surface actionable signal, so customers can see where an agent is failing and why * Handle agentic systems at scale; your work will touch critical flows for Fortune 100 companies. * Run evaluations on new text and voice models, then integrate the ones that win into production traffic **Your background and skillset look something like this** * 4\+ years building software products, with strong product thinking * Proficient in Python, comfortable working across the entire stack * Experience translating complex technical capabilities into simple, usable interfaces * Complex systems instincts, including asynchronous programming and the failure modes that only appear at scale * A high degree of comfort debugging system failures in deep technology stacks, using whatever tool gets you to the answer * A knack for turning customer asks into clear, well\-scoped product and technical specs * Judgment about when to ship fast and when to slow down and build it correctly **Even better** * Background with LLMs, prompt engineering, evals, or AI agent systems * Experience building developer tools, APIs, platforms, or internal tools that became customer\-facing * Experience with observability, data visualization, or analytics products * Experience building security\-sensitive product systems, such as authentication and data access controls * Work with multi\-modal or voice models **Compensation** $200K – $400K \+ Offers Equity This range reflects the expected compensation for this role. Compensation within the range is determined based on experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities, with flexibility for candidates who demonstrate exceptional impact. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity. Final compensation may vary based on location within the United States. **Benefits** We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees: * Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family * Life Insurance and Disability Benefits * Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension) * Parental Leave * Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot * Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance * Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best * Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave) *These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K

models, including prompt/context design, tool/function calling, evaluation, and production integration; and 2\+ years implementing retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG)/retrieval, including document
