State Transfer (REST), GraphQL, event\-driven capabilities, microservices, and middleware; and 2\+ years of development operations (DevOps) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) experience, including continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD), infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform/CloudFormation, Docker/Kubernetes, observability, and monitoring.** * **2\+ years leading security/compliance efforts, including enterprise security controls\-identity and access management (IAM), encryption, secrets, and audit logging\-and data/privacy controls\-personally identifiable information (PII), retention, and access controls.** * **Ability to travel 0\-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.** * **Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.** **Preferred:** * **Master's or doctoral degree and/or cloud and artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) certifications.** * **2\+ years of experience with Human Capital platforms and integrations, including Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Salesforce, and human resources (HR) data domains.** * **2\+ years of experience operationalizing large language model operations (LLMOps) and machine learning operations (MLOps) capabilities, Controls (SOC) 2, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), or the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).** **The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range jobs.description: **Job Requirements** "We Power the Magic!" That's our motto at Disney Experiences Technology (DXT). Our team creates world\-class immersive digital experiences for the Company's premier vacation brands, including Disney's Parks \& Resorts. We are responsible for the end\-to\-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology and digital\-led initiatives across Food \& Beverage, and Merchandise lines of business. This role sits within the Retail \& Restaurant Technology organization and supports the Point of Sale (POS) platform — the system that powers every merchandise and dining transaction across our parks and resorts. Our platform is a large\-scale, distributed, event\-driven system. We work with a polyglot stack (PHP, Go, Python, Java) that we are actively modernizing, and we need engineers who embrace the platform as it is while helping shape what it becomes. The main client of our services is the POS terminal itself — an Android\-based hardware device used by thousands of Cast Members every day — so reliability, performance, and thoughtful API design directly impact the Guest and Cast experience. The Lead Software Engineer will report to the Manager, Software Engineering. jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ As a Lead Software Engineer on the Data Protection team, you'll be a key player in building the cryptographic foundation for Docusign's global infrastructure. You'll drive the engineering for our enterprise key management platform \- owning the systems that enable customers to control their own encryption keys and extending cryptographic protection across our data stores and services. Looking ahead, you'll help define how key management and cryptographic controls evolve alongside Docusign's platform \- ensuring our data protection posture stays ahead of industry standards and enterprise customer expectations. Our team is passionate about delivering high\-quality, fully\-tested code to ensure the level of security and reliability our customers depend on. This is a hands\-on role where you'll help drive technical direction, secure our platform, and directly enable Docusign's Intelligent Agreement Management by delivering trusted data protection solutions to enterprise customers. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Sr. Manager, Software Engineering. **Responsibility** * Design and build cryptographic key management systems that support the full key lifecycle generation, distribution, rotation, revocation, and expiry across cloud environments at enterprise scale * Build and maintain operational tooling for the health, observability, and reliability of cryptographic services and key integrations * Drive adoption of encryption best practices across Docusign's platform, establishing and evolving standards for data\-at\-rest and data\-in\-transit protection * Collaborate with engineering teams across the company to ensure their systems correctly support data protection requirements \- advising on encryption patterns, key management constraints, and data isolation boundaries * Contribute to threat modeling and security design reviews for new platform initiatives, identifying cryptographic and data protection risks early in the development lifecycle * Develop high\-quality, ship\-ready code covered by a full test suite * Conduct design and code reviews with a focus on security and availability not just coding to a spec **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * 12\+ years of hands\-on development experience in C\# or other object\-oriented languages * 12\+ years of software engineering experience in high\-scale distributed systems * Experience with cloud Key Management Services (KMS) AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP Cloud KMS, or equivalent \- including key lifecycle management (rotation, revocation, expiry) and cross\-tenant or cross\-account key access patterns * Experience with encryption fundamentals key wrapping (DEK/KEK model), asymmetric key operations, and cryptographic key lifecycle management * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent experience **Preferred** * Experience with .NET microservice architecture (C\#) in a high\-scale production environment * Hands\-on experience with Azure Key Vault RBAC authorization model, Managed Identity integration, Encryption Scopes, and CMK\-enabled data services * Experience with cloud infrastructure provisioning at scale \- IaC tooling (Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent), per\-tenant resource automation, and multi\-region deployments * Experience building monitoring and alerting for cryptographic services, including key access health and resource state observability * Experience building large\-scale, highly available, and reliable applications * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices * Strong organizational, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data - Experimentation
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ The Decision Systems team helps DoorDash teams make faster, more rigorous, and more trustworthy decisions. We build the analytical systems, statistical methods, and product experiences that power experimentation, causal inference, rollout analysis, metric interpretation, and business impact measurement across DoorDash's three\-sided marketplace. Curie is DoorDash's experiment analysis product within Decision Systems. It sits at the center of how teams move from hypothesis to analysis to confident action, helping decision makers understand experiments, rollouts, metric movements, and marketplace impact while preserving scientific rigor, velocity, trust, and interpretability. Our work spans experimentation platforms, causal inference, variance reduction, switchback experimentation, metric systems, and AI\-assisted analysis workflows. We partner closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and operators across DoorDash to translate advanced methods into reliable, scalable systems that improve decision quality and product velocity. Some of the work done in the team was published in articles such as: Design\-Aware Variance Reduction for Switchback Experiments: A Comparative Study, Power\-Optimal Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments, CUPED on Steroids: Multivariate Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Staff Applied Scientist to provide scientific leadership for DoorDash's Experimentation Platform. In this role, you will define and advance the statistical, causal inference, machine learning, and AI capabilities that power high\-quality decision\-making across DoorDash. You will work on challenging problems at the intersection of experimentation, marketplace dynamics, machine learning, and product engineering. Your work will shape how DoorDash teams design experiments, analyze results, interpret noisy marketplace outcomes, and make faster, more trustworthy decisions. This is a high\-leverage role for a scientist who enjoys both deep technical work and broad cross\-functional influence—partnering with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and operators to translate cutting\-edge methods into reliable platform capabilities used across the company. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will...** ------------------------------------------------------------- * Set the scientific direction for Curie and shape the Decision Systems roadmap with engineering and product partners, identifying where better science, tooling, or automation can materially improve decision quality and velocity. * Own the statistical contract for experiment analysis, including how metrics, populations, exposure windows, covariates, ratio metrics, and edge cases are defined. * Ensure production systems faithfully implement those contracts by reviewing analytical SQL, validating statistical parity, and raising the bar for correctness across engine migrations. * Develop and productionize advanced methods such as CUPED/CUPAC, ratio\-metric and delta\-method inference, sequential testing, heterogeneous jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agentic AI New
jobs.description: **Our Why At Dotmatics** At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision\-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian. **We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.** We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best\-of\-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi\-dimensional decision\-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. **Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics** Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote\-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud\-based scientific research R\&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. **We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.** **What do we need** We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Software Engineer (Agentic AI), to build the AI agent at the core of Dotmatics Luma platform. You will own the agent end to end: how it reasons, which tools it uses, what it remembers, how it recovers from failure, and how we know it is working. You will work in a small, high\-trust engineering team alongside Product, scientists, and the wider Dotmatics organisation. This is also an AI\-native engineering role. Your success won’t be measured by how many lines of code you write. It will come from how well you decompose work for coding agents, give them the right context, tools, and constraints, verify their output with tests and review, and ship production software faster than a traditional senior engineer without lowering the quality bar. Coding agents are your default path for implementation, and you stay accountable for architecture, correctness, security, and review. We want someone who thinks like the engineers who build frontier AI products: rigorous about quality, curious about how agents fail, and quick to adapt as models improve. You use AI tools daily to build AI tools, and you ship agents that work in production, not just in demos. **In this role you will get to** * Develop the agent itself: the loop, harness, and control flow connecting the model, tools, and state, including subagents, long\-running tasks, checkpointing, and recovery. * Practice context engineering: decide what goes into the context window, when to compact or summarize, and how to keep the agent coherent over long\-running experiments. * Design tools for the agent, with clear interfaces and descriptions, covering instrument orchestration, scheduling, data capture, and developer tooling such as GitHub, repositories, CI/CD, and workflows. * Give the agent memory and state persistence so it learns from and builds on earlier work. * Implement permissions and sandboxing that define what the agent can do on its own, what needs human approval, and how mistakes are contained. * Defend the agent against prompt injection and untrusted content, with auditability and data isolation suited to regulated environments. * Evaluate the agent end\-to\-end on real multi\-step tasks, then debug its behavior by reading traces and finding root causes, fixing the harness, tools, or prompts to improve reliability, tool\-use accuracy, cost, and latency. * Adapt the harness as models improve, and remove scaffolding that is no longer needed. * Run an AI\-first development loop (scope, plan, delegate to coding agents, verify, ship), preferring agent execution over hand\-writing whenever quality holds, and build and maintain the team's agent harness for development itself (project memory, skills, hooks, MCP, CI checks) so agents can safely do bounded engineering work. * Measure and improve that workflow through throughput, defect rate, and review cost, and coach others on AI\-native practices to raise the team's bar for agent\-driven delivery * Set up the architecture and infrastructu around the agent in Python, Node.js/TypeScript, and React, including streaming output and extension points such as MCP **We are looking for people who** have around 10 years of experience in software engineering, including hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered agents in production. Ideally you will have a degree or higher education in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, and an interest in life sciences, lab instrumentation, or automation. **The Key Skills we are looking for:** * AI\-native engineering: autonomous coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent) as the primary way you build. * Production agents: at least one LLM\-powered agent shipped to real users, handling multi\-step tool use, error recovery, and long\-running tasks. * Context engineering, memory, and retrieval: a long\-running LLM application where you can explain what went into the window, when it was compacted, and how coherence and retrieval quality (RAG, vector indexes, reranking) were measured. * Agent security: permissions, sandboxing, human approval gates, prompt injection defenses, and audit logging, tested against adversarial inputs. * Tool and API design for models: tools or MCP servers built for model use, with tool\-selection and call accuracy measured. * Production engineering: Python with type checking, automated tests, and packaging in CI, plus Node.js/TypeScript and React services and interfaces, including streaming output, with monitoring, tracing, and managed configuration and secrets. **You may also have:** * Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, or building custom harnesses from scratch. * Working knowledge of Databricks and BI tools (Sigma, Power BI, Spotfire). * Observability for LLM systems (tracing, cost and latency monitoring). * Fine\-tuning, prompt optimization, or model evaluation experience. * Authored skills, hooks, or MCP servers that made agent\-driven delivery repeatable for a team. **We are open to speaking to candidates with more or less experience than listed** **The compensation for different levels can be discussed with your recruiter** **Total Rewards** Dotmatics utilises a national market\-based approach to base pay benchmarking and pay band development. The candidate's final starting pay is based on job\-related skills, experience, job specific qualifications \& location. In addition to base salary, Dotmatics has implemented a total rewards strategy, which is the combination of compensation, benefits and recognition. ***Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.*** **Other Total Rewards Offered** * Medical, Dental, Vision, Insurance * Health Spending Accounts * Wellness Benefits (Mental Health Apps and Fitness Perks) * Company\-paid Life and Disability Insurance * 401k Retirement Plan (with 4% company match; immediate vesting) * Flexible Time off Plan (for US exempt employees) This is the range that we, in good faith, believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. Base Pay Range $124,000 \- $168,000 USD Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. **Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.**

jobs.description: **Job Description** We are seeking a Broadcast Media Systems Software Engineer with a strong focus on data streaming and real\-time processing platforms to help design, build, and operate scalable, high\-throughput, low\-latency systems. This role will work on distributed systems that ingest, process, and deliver streaming data used for analytics, machine learning, monitoring, and mission\-critical applications. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, platform engineers, product teams, and infrastructure to ensure reliability, performance, and scalability across streaming pipelines. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain scalable data streaming pipelines * Develop and operate transport and broadcast media related architectures * Implement custom transport logic and socket architectures to handle high\-throughput packet and frame\-level media streams * Optimize systems for throughput, latency, and resource efficiency * Participate in capacity planning and performance tuning * Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and metrics for streaming applications * Integrate and customize open\-source media frameworks including FFmpeg, GStreamer, and TSDuck into proprietary streaming ecosystems. * Implement low\-level wrappers and APIs using C, C\+\+, or Rust to interface directly with core networking and hardware\-accelerated video codecs. * Ensure strict stream compliance, packet ordering, fault tolerance, and frame\-accurate timing across all linear playout systems. * Optimize media software for CPU cache locality, minimal memory allocation, zero\-copy data paths, and overall resource efficiency. * Implement robust monitoring, logging, and metrics specifically tailored for packet\-level streaming health, jitter, and transport stream analytics. * Debug production issues related to packet loss, latency spikes, frame corruption, backpressure, or clock drift. * Support on\-call rotations and incident response for critical data systems * Collaborate with broadcast engineering teams to build, integrate, and test streaming, MAMs, playout, automations, and graphics systems. * Collaborate with product, analytics, and ML teams to support new use cases * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code * Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions * Contribute to documentation and engineering best practices **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Systems Programming: 2\+ years of hands\-on experience programming real\-time applications at the Low\-Level / Packet Level using C, C\+\+, or Rust. * Must be highly comfortable with manual memory management, pointer manipulation, and multi\-threaded optimizations. * Strong experience in a modern concurrency language like Go or Python for stream orchestration, tooling, and control\-plane API development. * Network Protocols: Deep, foundational understanding of UDP and TCP/IP networking mechanics. Direct experience managing socket programming, custom congestion control, packet pacing, and error correction techniques (ARQ / selective retransmission). * Media Transport: Proven experience with broadcast and linear video workflows, including media containers and multiplexing (specifically MPEG\-TS wrappers). * Experience building custom stream troubleshooting, diagnostic, or real\-time monitoring software. * Codecs: Codec\-agnostic architecture mindset with low\-level implementation knowledge of H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, and emerging standards like AV1\. * Automation \& Scripting: Strong scripting capabilities in Python or Bash for stream orchestration, pipeline automation, and local\-first systems management. **Preferred Qualifications** * Direct development experience with libsrt, librist, RTMP, or similar APIs. * Deep familiarity with open\-source media frameworks like FFmpeg, Astreamer, GStreamer, TSDuck and low level packet streaming tools. * Experience using network analysis tools to debug packet loss, jitter, clock drift, and MTU issues on live networks. * Familiarity with broader broadcast media components, including automation protocols, digital playout systems, on\-air graphics engines, and Media Asset Management (MAM) platforms. * Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or Azure specifically regarding networking components (firewall traversal, listener/caller architecture, and high\-bandwidth ingress). * Lightweight containerization experience or portable streaming endpoints or edge\-compute tools. * Knowledge of serialization formats (like Protobuf or JSON) strictly for control\-plane APIs and performance telemetry aggregation.

jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **This role is intended for candidates based in Austin, TX** ============================================================ **Introduction to the Team** Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. The Software Development Engineer II position is part of the Consumer Payments team within Expedia Global Payments, under the Book\-to\-Trip division. This team builds and maintains critical systems that power backend APIs for consumer and B2B payment processing, administrative tools for payment configuration, and support for a variety of payment methods across the platform. Our services are designed with security, scalability, and availability in mind, supporting credit card processing and payment routing at global scale. As an engineer on this team, you'll apply your passion for backend development, cloud computing, and modern engineering practices to solve real\-world challenges that impact millions of travelers and partners worldwide. We are looking for an engineer who demonstrates strong ownership, follows through on commitments, and takes pride in building reliable systems that perform well in production. **In this role, you will:** * Design, build, and maintain scalable backend payment services that support Expedia’s global travel platform * Apply software design principles, data structures and/or design patterns and computer science fundamentals to write code that is clean, maintainable, optimized, modular with good naming conventions * Implement secure data handling practices to protect payment information and meet compliance standards * Recommend and apply architectural patterns or GenAI capabilities to improve system design and innovation * Enhance service reliability through observability, automation, and continuous operational improvements Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-impact features aligned with Expedia’s strategic goals * **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or Master's in a related technical field, or equivalent related professional experience * 2\+ years of experience in backend software development, working with cloud\-based and distributed systems at scale * Proficiency in **Java or Kotlin** , with hands\-on experience integrating services with relational and NoSQL databases Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure/test automation, and delivering features in Agile development environments * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience working on payment platforms or implementing backend services leveraging GenAI technologies * Experience contributing to multiple multi\-quarter, cross\-team projects * Experience supporting complex distributed systems in production through monitoring, debugging, incident resolution, and root\-cause analysis * Demonstrated experience designing and deploying scalable services on AWS A Master's degree in a related technical field * Please note that **this role is only available in Austin, TX** . We follow a flexible work model, which requires employees to be in the office at least three days a week. We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this role. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $190,500\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.\&\#xa; Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation . **About Expedia Group** Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. jobs.title: Junior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Flexi Software is hiring Junior and entry\-level Full\-Stack Software Engineers to help build the next generation of our platform. You will work across C\# services and modern web front ends built with Node.js, React, and Next.js, backed by Microsoft SQL Server, and you will build, test, and deliver enterprise\-grade software for financial institutions. We are looking for engineers who embrace an AI\-empowered software development lifecycle. At Flexi, AI is part of how we design, code, review, test, and document. You will work with agentic tools every day, and you will learn to direct them with good judgment, verify what they produce, and hold the result to the standards our banking, insurance, and financial services customers depend on. Your primary focus will be delivering our next\-generation web platform. On a limited basis, you may also work on Flexi's legacy Windows desktop solutions in C\+\+ and C\#, which gives you broad exposure to how enterprise software evolves. This role is a strong starting point for an early\-career engineer who wants to grow quickly, learn from experienced engineers, and ship real software at scale. This is a hybrid position, working in person with the team in our Atlanta, GA office. **About Flexi** Flexi Software has been a trusted provider of accounting solutions for over 30 years, offering both cloud\-based and on\-premise software purpose\-built for organizations with the most complex accounting requirements — multi\-entity and intercompany accounting at scale. Our comprehensive suite includes modules like General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing, Fixed Asset Management, Project Accounting, Workflow Automation, Financial Reporting, and Budget Software. Serving industries including banking, insurance, financial services, credit unions, healthcare, and business process outsourcing, Flexi is renowned for its robust features, flexible deployment options, and exceptional customer support. In January 2025, Flexi was acquired by Quality Standard, a permanent capital holding company that acquires and grows fintech and govtech software businesses with a long\-term ownership mindset. Quality Standard is actively investing in Flexi's people, product, and operations. Flexi's office is located in Atlanta, GA. Quality Standard is headquartered in New York, NY. **Roles and Responsibilities** * Build, test, and deliver full\-stack features for Flexi's next\-generation platform, working across C\# back\-end services and APIs and Node.js, React, and Next.js front ends * Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code, including unit and integration tests, as part of every change you ship * Work with Microsoft SQL Server: write queries and stored procedures, design tables, and learn to tune for application and database performance * Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows daily across design, coding, code review, testing, and documentation, and learn to direct them effectively * Review and verify AI\-generated code with care, owning correctness, security, and quality for everything you commit * Take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback, to build skill and uphold team standards * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release practices so changes move to production safely and often * Build with the security, reliability, and data integrity expected of enterprise financial software, including input validation, error handling, and audit\-friendly design * Investigate and resolve defects, tracing issues across the front end, services, and database * Write and maintain technical documentation, including API documentation and developer notes * Partner with Product, QA, and senior engineers to turn requirements into shipped customer\-facing software * Contribute on a limited basis to Flexi's legacy Windows desktop solutions in C\+\+ and C\#, while next\-generation web platform delivery remains your primary focus, and learn how the new platform integrates with these existing products and our DevOps environment * Grow your skills through mentorship, pairing, and regular feedback, and share what you learn about AI\-assisted development with the team Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent practical experience, such as a bootcamp, internship, or substantial project work * 0–3 years of professional software development experience; internships and strong personal or academic projects count * Working knowledge of C\# and the .NET platform, including object\-oriented programming fundamentals, and a willingness to work in legacy C\+\+ and C\# Windows desktop code on a limited basis * Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with hands\-on experience building applications in React * Experience or coursework with Node.js and Next.js, including routing, server\-side rendering, and API routes * Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, with exposure to Microsoft SQL Server preferred * Familiarity with building and consuming REST APIs * Experience with Git and a collaborative, pull\-request\-based workflow * Active, hands\-on use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools in your own work, with a clear sense of when to trust their output and when to question it * A solid grasp of software testing fundamentals, including writing unit tests * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail * Clear written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to ask good questions and take feedback well **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, or Web API development * Experience with Vite, modern build tooling, and component libraries or design systems * Experience delivering web applications in a B2B software environment using modern AI\-accelerated tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, including prompt and context engineering for coding tasks * Exposure to automated testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, Jest, Playwright, or Cypress * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and containerization * Exposure to AWS or Azure cloud platforms * Interest in or exposure to secure coding practices, including OWASP guidance * Experience with ERP, accounting, financial, or other enterprise systems of record, especially B2B enterprise software, and prior experience in the financial services industry or financial accounting **Personal Characteristics** * AI\-curious and AI\-forward; you actively use AI tools in your own work, enjoy experimenting with agentic workflows, and share what works * Rigorous about quality; you treat AI output as a draft to be verified, not a result to be trusted blindly * A builder; you like turning an idea into working software and seeing it used * Eager to learn; you ask questions, seek feedback, and improve quickly * Hands\-on and persistent; you stay with a hard bug until you understand the cause * Security\- and detail\-minded; you understand that accuracy and data integrity matter in financial software * Collaborative and low ego; you work well with engineers, QA, and Product * High integrity and sound judgment; trusted with sensitive customer and product information * Positive attitude and sense of humor; work is way more fun with people you enjoy! **What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months** * Fully onboarded to Flexi's codebase, tooling, and AI\-assisted development workflow, and contributing confidently * Shipping production\-ready features and fixes across the C\# back end, SQL Server, and the React/Next.js front end * Delivering well\-tested work that passes review with steadily fewer corrections * Using AI tools effectively and responsibly, with changes that are verified, secure, and understood * Contributing meaningfully to code reviews, tests, and documentation * Understanding how the new platform fits with Flexi's existing C\+\+/C\# Windows desktop products and delivery pipeline, and contributing to them when needed * Developing a clear growth plan with your manager and mentor, with growing independence on well\-defined tasks Flexi provides excellent benefits including paid holidays and paid time off, a 401(k) Plan with company match, health and dental insurance, life and disability insurance, and a vision discount plan. **Location:** Hybrid • Atlanta, GA area only Only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Any offer of employment will be contingent upon positive criminal background check. No phone calls, please. Principals Only. Drug\-free workplace. M/F/V/H EEO

jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Fieldpiece** is a privately held, global leader in professional HVACR tools and test instruments. We're known for developing innovative products that technicians rely on every day \- and for investing in our people, our technology, and our future. Named***one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years***, we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact while growing their careers. We're looking for a **Senior AI Solutions Engineer** to help us turn the potential of AI into practical solutions that help teams to increase their efficiency, speed, and accuracy in their everyday jobs. This is a unique opportunity to become our first dedicated AI engineering hire and help shape how AI and automation are used across the organization. You'll partner with teams throughout the business—from Sales, Marketing, Finance, and HR to Product Development, Supply Chain, Operations, Customer Experience, and IT—to understand how they work, identify opportunities for improvement, and build solutions that deliver measurable value. This position is in our Park City, UT office with an exciting move to Heber City, UT in 2027\. This role follows a hybrid work schedule, with employees typically working onsite three days per week. Additional in\-office days may be required from time to time for onboarding, training, team meetings, project collaboration, or other business needs.**Why This Role?*** This isn't a role where you'll spend your time simply evaluating AI tools or developing proofs of concept that never make it into production. You'll sit down with business teams, understand what they're trying to accomplish and where their processes are slowing them down, translate those needs into technical requirements, determine the right solution, and then build, deploy, and improve it. * The projects will vary widely. One may involve automating a manual workflow; another could involve creating an AI agent, improving access to company knowledge, connecting AI to an enterprise system, or building a decision\-support application. The common thread is using technology to solve meaningful business problems. * We're technology agnostic and want someone who can choose the right solution for the problem rather than force every problem into the same technology stack. That said, experience within the Microsoft ecosystem—particularly Dynamics 365 Business Central, Azure, Copilot, Power Platform, Fabric, Dataverse, and Microsoft 365—is highly valuable in our environment. **What You'll Do*** Partner with teams across Fieldpiece to understand their workflows, pain points, and business needs and identify opportunities where AI, automation, or better technology can make a meaningful difference. * Take business requirements from concept to solution—designing, developing, implementing, and supporting production\-ready applications and automations. * Build AI agents, copilots, workflow automations, decision\-support tools, and other practical AI\-enabled solutions. * Develop applications using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise knowledge systems, APIs, and agentic workflows. * Connect AI solutions with ERP, CRM, PLM, customer support, analytics, knowledge management, productivity, and other enterprise platforms. * Reengineer processes to improve speed, accuracy, quality, service, cost, revenue enablement, and employee productivity. * Establish testing and evaluation approaches to ensure solutions are accurate, reliable, secure, scalable, and effective. * Work closely with Information Systems, business leaders, data owners, and security stakeholders to implement appropriate governance and controls. * Help users successfully adopt new AI tools and continuously improve solutions based on feedback and results. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and make practical recommendations based on business value, implementation requirements, cost, risk, and scalability. * Bachelor’s degree in CS, AI, or related fields. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production applications. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building solutions using modern AI technologies, including large language models. * Experience taking ambiguous business problems and translating them into practical technical solutions. * Hands\-on experience with prompt design, retrieval architectures, AI application testing, and model/system evaluation. Experience building AI agents, multi\-agent systems, tool\-using agents, RAG solutions, or complex agentic workflows. * Experience integrating APIs, cloud services, enterprise applications, and data sources. * Strong proficiency in Python or another modern language used for AI application development. * Experience with data engineering, analytics, BI, MLOps/LLMOps, observability, or cloud deployment. * Experience with source control, testing, deployment, monitoring, and modern software delivery practices. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to work directly with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders and explain complex technical decisions in business terms. * A practical, curious mindset \- you enjoy learning how a business works, asking the right questions, and figuring out how technology can make it better. **Even Better If You Have*** Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or integrating solutions with ERP systems, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Fabric, or Dataverse. * Experience working in a product, manufacturing, distribution, or field\-service environment. * Exposure to Lean, continuous improvement, or business process reengineering. **Why You'll Enjoy Working at Fieldpiece*** As a privately held company, we invest for the long term—in our people, our products, and our future. That means we can focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and building lasting careers rather than chasing short\-term results. * Make a meaningful impact with a company where your ideas are heard, your expertise is valued, and your contributions help shape the future of our products and business. **Benefits \& Perks**We believe great work starts with supporting our employees. That's why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to promote your health, financial well\-being, work\-life balance, and professional growth.* Competitive base salary with annual bonus opportunity * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting * Generous paid time off and paid holidays * Hire to Retire philosophy \- Individual Development Plans for everyone and a commitment to support career development * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Health Savings Accounts (HSA), and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Music program – music rooms in all US offices with onsite guitar, piano, and voice lessons in California (classes can be streamed for other offices) * Recognition programs, launch parties and team building events to share successes **Our Culture** At Fieldpiece, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers every day. We use the TURTL acronym to show that we believe in:* **TRIBE** – We collaborate, support one another, and win as a team. * **Upfront Homework** – We come prepared, begin with the end in mind and address obstacles with creativity, grit and tenacity. * **Right Stuff** – We deliver innovative solutions by seeing through the eyes of our customers and use purposeful critical thinking to lead to greatness. * **Trust** – We build strong relationships through credibility, accountability and transparency. * **Lean** – We embrace curiosity, continuous improvement, learning from failures and delivering results. * **No Ego –** We leave titles and egos at the door, value the best ideas regardless of where they come from, and work together with humility, openness, and mutual respect. At Fieldpiece, we're building more than innovative products \- we're building careers. If you're looking for a place where your work matters and your contributions are recognized, we'd love to meet you. *EOE AA M/F/Veteran/Disability*

jobs.title: AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: The **AI \& Automation Engineer** is a hands\-on technical role responsible for designing, building, deploying, and supporting AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities, and automation solutions on Company\-approved AI platforms. At this time, fully\-remote is not available. Kansas City or Park City preferred.** **What you will do:****Solution Design and Development*** Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Foundry (topics, actions, tools, connected agents, knowledge sources) and publish them to approved channels such as Microsoft Teams. * Build the Power Platform components behind AI use cases: Power Automate flows, Dataverse data models and security roles, model\-driven and canvas apps, AI Builder prompts, and Adaptive Card review experiences in Teams. * Integrate agents and flows with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data platform, Microsoft 365\) using connectors, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool connections. * Move prototypes into production through environment strategy, solution packaging and application lifecycle management (ALM), publishing, and release validation. Assist with evaluating the cost of proposed solutions. * Write supporting code (Python, PowerShell, C\#, or JSON) where low\-code tooling falls short and use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and legacy code modernization. **AI Platform and Knowledge Engineering*** Deploy and manage Azure AI Foundry projects, model deployments, and agents using Company\-owned Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Cosmos DB so source data and vector indexes remain within the Company's tenant. * Build retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines (ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, vector and hybrid search) as reusable knowledge and context layers shared by multiple agents and automations. * Configure network isolation and identity for AI workloads, including private endpoints, private DNS, managed identities, and role\-based access control (RBAC), and troubleshoot connectivity and authorization failures across platform boundaries. * Write system prompts and agent instructions, implements tool calling and orchestration, and run evaluations (test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, regression tests) before and after each release. **Security, Governance, and Responsible AI*** Build every solution in accordance with Company security and data protection requirements, including least\-privilege identities, scoped security roles, Entra ID app registrations, Power Platform data loss prevention (DLP) policies, sensitivity label requirements, and vendor and customer confidentiality obligations. * Verify each agent’s authentication model, including end\-user, maker, and agent\-author credentials, to ensure the agent returns only information the requesting user is authorized to access. Apply content\-safety controls, input and output validation, and human review for consequential actions. * Support the AI intake and review process with technical assessments, help identify and remediate unsanctioned AI usage, and support Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness, including permissions and oversharing remediation. **Operations, Support, and Enablement*** Monitor delivered solutions for accuracy, performance, usage, security, cost, and continued fit with the business need; track licensing, token, credit, and capacity consumption and recommended actions to control spend. * Provide third\-tier support and root\-cause analysis for production AI and automation solutions, including occasional after\-hours work for urgent issues or production automation failures. * Maintain documentation for each solution (business owner, purpose, architecture, data sources, access model, prompts, testing notes, support owner, change history, retirement criteria) and follow Company change, release, and lifecycle practices. * Deliver demos and technical training on approved AI tools, mentor citizen developers and IT colleagues on approved patterns and review their work for security and supportability before production. * Communicate the status, risks, dependencies, and expected business value of assigned use cases to the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI and business stakeholders. **Our ideal candidate:*** Strong understanding of generative AI, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, automation, low\-code/no\-code development, and practical business process improvement. * Hands\-on experience with Micr ate, Power Apps, Dataverse, AI Builder), Fabric, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. * Working knowledge of Azure networking, Entra ID, managed identities, and role\-based access control as they apply to AI workloads. * Proficiency in at least one language (Python, PowerShell, C\#, or TypeScript), REST APIs, JSON, and Git. * Strong knowledge of data privacy, security, access controls, responsible AI practices, and change management. * Ability to diagnose problems across platform boundaries using logs, run histories, and vendor documentation, and to explain technical designs in plain language to leaders at all levels. * Must be well\-organized, practical, collaborative, and pay close attention to detail. * Ability to drive and valid driver’s license required. **Education and Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field is required. * Three years of proven experience in application development, automation, data, or related information technology work, including one year of experience building and deploying production generative AI solutions such as agents, RAG solutions, or LLM\-based automations. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI Foundry required. * Experience with Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, and ERP or CRM integration (Dynamics 365 or similar) preferred. * Microsoft AI\-102, PL\-400, or AZ\-204 certification preferred. **Physical Demands** (The physical demands described here must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Regularly required to sit, see, speak and hear —frequent and regular use of hands and fingers to handle or feel. Recurring close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Constantly use hands and fingers to perform computer keyboard work. The ability to drive, and availability and capability to travel for business purposes. **Work Environment** (The work environment characteristics described here represent those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Perform most of the work in a relaxed environment but may be exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Encounter different temperatures while driving and getting in and out of a vehicle. Encounter different climates when traveling. **What We Can Offer You:*** Competitive pay to recognize your valuable contribution * 401(k) with matching * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans * Basic Life \& AD\&D, short\-term disability, \& and long\-term disability * Wellness programs to focus on building healthy habits while earning prizes and cash bonuses throughout the year * Holiday, PTO, and Parental Leave, promoting work\-life balance and personal growth * Casual dress attire * Family\-owned company where you’re more than just another employee Foley Industries – Foley Equipment, Foley Power Solutions, Foley Rental, and SITECH Central – proudly stands at the forefront of progress, serving customers in Kansas and Western Missouri for over nine decades. control reviews and ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal design standards and agency requirements. * Coordinate with clients, regulatory agencies, utility companies, and other guidance, and supporting professional growth. * Collaborate with department leadership on strategic planning, resource allocation, and operational improvements. * Participate in project interviews, coordination as required. * Monitor project financial performance and implement corrective actions when necessary to maintain project profitability. * Stay current with evolving transportation design standards, regulations, and industry best practices. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related field. * Professional Engineer (PE) license in the State of New Jersey required. * 12\+ years of progressive transportation engineering experience with increasing project management responsibilities. * Demonstrated experience managing roadway, highway, traffic, intersection, and transportation improvement projects. * Strong knowledge of NJDOT, PennDOT, county, and municipal transportation design standards and procedures. * Proficiency with AutoCAD Civil 3D activities. * Strong leadership skills with experience mentoring and managing engineering staff. * Knowledge of traffic engineering principles and transportation planning concepts preferred. * Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). * Active participation in professional organizations such as ASCE, ACEC, ITE, or similar. * Experience managing NJDOT and/or PennDOT projects. * Existing relationships with transportation agencies, counties, municipalities, and industry stakeholders throughout New Jersey and Pennsylvania. * Experience serving as Engineer of Record on transportation infrastructure projects. * Experience with Complete Streets, Vision Zero, pedestrian and bicycle facilities, traffic calming, and roadway safety improvement projects. **Additional Information** * Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available for this position. * Relocation jobs.description: **Job Description** **On\-site:** This role is categorized as onsite. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Wallace Battery Cell Innovation Center in Warren, Michigan on a full\-time basis. At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human\-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next\-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale. **The Role:** This role is an exciting opportunity to join the Advanced Battery Cell Engineering team at the Wallace Battery Cell Innovation Center (WBCIC). The WBCIC is GM’s engineering and pilot\-development facility for designing, building, and validating next\-generation battery cells and manufacturing processes. The Senior Advanced Battery Cell Engineer will work with advanced battery chemistries and cell formats, contribute to cell and component design, and partner with build engineers, technicians, and cross\-functional teams to develop and mature next\-generation prismatic cell processes. The ideal candidate is passionate about automotive battery cell technologies, comfortable working directly on equipment and hardware, and able to move between hands\-on execution and technical leadership. You will be responsible for setting up and running trials, analyzing results, resolving issues, documenting learnings, and presenting recommendations to internal and external audiences. This is a hands\-on engineering role with work in our advanced laboratory and pilot\-manufacturing environments. You will work directly with cell\-assembly equipment, fixtures, tooling, materials, instrumentation, and automation to turn advanced cell concepts into repeatable processes. **What You'll Do:** * Lead advanced battery cell build process development projects, within blanking, stacking, welding, packaging, and related assembly operations, for next\-generation prismatic cells. * Plan, set up, run, and document cell builds, experiments, process trials, and equipment evaluations in laboratory, dry\-room, and pilot\-line environments. * Work directly with equipment, fixtures, tooling, controls, automation, materials, and instrumentation to troubleshoot issues and improve process performance. * Partner with technicians to establish practical work methods and ensure processes are safe, consistent, and repeatable. * Lead targeted development studies and trials to evaluate process parameters, material interactions, equipment performance, and the impact of cell build conditions on cell quality and performance. * Develop cell\-build strategies for new architectures, materials, and assembly concepts, emphasizing robustness, weld integrity, stack quality, dimensional control, and manufacturability. * Define development\-phase process requirements, engineering guidelines, work instructions, equipment concepts, tooling, controls, automation, and success criteria. * Build strategic project plans that support advanced cell engineering objectives, process maturation, equipment readiness, and the introduction of new cell build approaches. * Stay informed on emerging battery manufacturing technologies and industry trends in cell stacking, welding, automation, and advanced assembly, and apply relevant insights to internal development goals. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Vulnerability Management
jobs.description: About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot. Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States Overview: Securing the home for all developers starts with securing GitHub itself. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Vulnerability Management Engineering team, you’ll build and run the systems that find vulnerabilities across GitHub’s services and infrastructure, get each one to the team that owns it, and control how our code, packages, and container images are sourced and built. It’s backend and distributed systems work where the users are other engineers, and you’ll build deep expertise in vulnerability management and software supply chain security along the way. We are looking for creative problem solvers and diverse thinkers, people who care about culture as well as customers and features. We believe that how we do things is as important as what we do. Big vision, a common purpose, passion for quality, curiosity, dedication, and investment in fun and collaboration are what lead to great results. Great products reflect the teams that build them. Responsibilities: * Design, develop, test and ship high\-quality technical solutions that scale across multiple GitHub services. * Build the platform that collects security findings from container image, cloud, host, and code scanning, matches each finding to the team that owns it, and tracks remediation through risk scoring, SLAs, and exceptions. * Design and roll out software supply chain controls, such as authenticated package and container proxies that enforce policy, across GitHub Actions, Docker builds, and Dependabot, in a way teams can adopt without slowing down. * Build systems that meet compliance requirements such as FedRAMP, and evolve production services without breaking the APIs other teams rely on. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including service owners, platform engineering, cloud security, and compliance, to define and implement innovative solutions. * Provide technical leadership, mentorship, pairing opportunities, and code reviews to encourage the growth of others. * Own and advocate for the health and quality of the systems that the team builds, including participating in on\-call and first responder rotations. * Write architecture briefs and proposals, carry out code experiments, and build prototypes to learn how we can achieve planetary scale with our systems. * Become intimately familiar with the systems you build and take pride in writing maintainable code. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications** * 6\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python + OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python + OR Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 4\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python + OR Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 2\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python + OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. + OR equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * 2\+ years experience using general purpose and scripting languages (e.g., Go, Python, or a similar language). * 3\+ years experience with cloud environments and/or Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) concepts. Compensation Range: The base salary range for this job is USD $124,000\.00 \- USD $329,200\.00 /Yr. These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role. This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. GitHub Leadership Principles: **GitHub values** * Customer\-obsessed * Ship to learn * Growth mindset * Own the outcome * Better together * Diverse and inclusive **Manager fundamentals** * Model * Coach * Care **Leadership principles** * Create clarity * Generate energy * Deliver success Who We Are: GitHub is the world’s leading AI\-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open\-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open\-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub. Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote\-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms. Join us, and let’s change the world, together. EEO Statement: GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. jobs.title: Staff Solutions Architect, AI Subject Matter Expert
jobs.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.* **An overview of this role** ---------------------------- As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity. Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching. You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security \& Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self\-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI \& Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI\-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations. Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME\-engaged opportunities, product\-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations. * Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions. * Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product\-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform. * Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories. * Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post\-Sales Solutions Architects (Post\-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections. * Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post\-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post\-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption. * Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early\-access and design\-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content. * Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV ve sign\-off. * Hands\-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider. * The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting. * Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use. * Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering. * Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security. If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply. **About the team** ------------------ We're building our SME organization within GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, and we're distributed and all\-remote. **How GitLab will support you** ------------------------------- * Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being * Flexible Paid Time Off * Team Member Resource Groups * Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Growth and Development Fund * Parental leave * Home office support *The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our* *benefits* *and* *equity**.
