jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Enterprise Brain
jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. **About the Role:** Glean is seeking a few Machine Learning engineers who want to focus on a combination of Quality and traditional ML work to help us build the Enterprise Brain. The Enterprise Brain team is developing a suite of proactive AI products that aims to revolutionize enterprise workflows by proactively detecting and automating tasks for users \- thus unlocking true productivity. This is built on top of a deep user understanding and state of the art Enterprise graph. The project involves using both LLM and other advanced ML techniques, agent orchestration and cutting\-edge ranking techniques. **You will:** * Work on deeply challenging ML problems involving user understanding and task prediction. * Invent new LLM workflows and signals to improve reasoning, planning, and personalization. * Design and optimize reinforcement learning and fine\-tuning approaches to improve the quality of understanding, prediction and other agentic systems. * Lead development of scalable evaluation, benchmarking, and optimization loops. * Build and maintain robust ML pipelines for enterprise and knowledge graph construction. * Drive initiatives to measure, monitor, and improve data quality, model quality, and end\-to\-end system performance. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deeply understand customer pain points and deliver high\-quality, production\-ready ML solutions. * Mentor junior engineers or learn from experienced ones in a tight\-knit, high\-velocity environment. **About you:** * You bring 6\+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering. * You hold a BA/BS in computer science, math, sciences, or a related field. * You have a proven ability to design, build, and ship production\-ready models and systems. * You bring demonstrated expertise in ML evaluation, benchmarking, and data quality. * You are proficient in an ML framework of your choice, such as TensorFlow or PyTorch. * You thrive in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment, turning open\-ended customer and ML problems into clear priorities and production\-ready solutions. * You balance speed with quality, making pragmatic tradeoffs to deliver measurable progress without losing sight of production readiness. **Location:** * This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View office) **Compensation \& Benefits:** The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 \- $280,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time\-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long\-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. \#LI\-HYBRID **AI\-First Mindset at Glean:** At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our **Privacy Policy**. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our **Applicant Arbitration Agreement**.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Position:** Senior Software Engineer, Backend — Booking Platform \& APIs **Duration:** FTE **Shift:** Monday \- Friday / Standard **Annual Salary:** $190,000 to $210,000 **Location:** New York City, four days per week in the office. We are hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to lead the technical work and be the primary hands\-on builder for the client's API. In your first year, multiple distribution partners and an authorized AI agent should complete real bookings through the same versioned API. You will evolve a production Rails and Postgres booking system used by millions of guests. The hard work is keeping prices and inventory correct, preventing overselling, surviving retries and partial failures, and reconciling systems when they disagree. **Your ownership and team** You will own the API’s day\-to\-day technical roadmap and design decisions. In this hands\-on individual contributor role, you will write production code, lead focused designs, guide migrations, and operate what you build. You will partner with our Staff Engineer on foundational domain and architecture choices. You will be the primary builder, but you will not work alone. Other backend engineers will contribute and build supply, PMS, and POS connectors using the patterns you establish. Product, Partnerships, and hotel operations will work with you from requirements through production launch. **What you’ll do** * Build and launch the external client 's API. Define stable, versioned contracts for live pricing, availability, holds, booking creation, changes, and cancellations. * Make booking operations safe under real failures. Design idempotency, recovery, webhooks, and reconciliation for retries, timeouts, duplicates, and partial success. * Evolve the core booking domain. Create clear models and invariants for products, schedules, prices, inventory, holds, carts, and bookings. * Make the platform extensible. Prove that a new category such as events or food and beverage can use the shared booking model instead of requiring a separate system. * Own the architecture for supply, PMS, and POS integrations. Create reusable connector patterns so other engineers can add partners without reinventing failure handling and reconciliation. * Define the data contracts that keep inventory discoverable through OpenSearch. Search is supporting technology for this role, not its primary ownership area. * Operate what you build. Set reliability and latency targets, and add the tests, metrics, dashboards, alerts, tracing, and runbooks needed for a critical booking path. * Turn partner needs into durable platform capabilities, explain tradeoffs clearly, and raise the engineering bar through practical reviews and mentoring.. **Tech stack** * Backend: Ruby on Rails, Node.js * Data: Postgres, MongoDB * Search: OpenSearch * APIs and integrations: REST, OpenAPI, webhooks * Infrastructure and observability: AWS, Datadog * Testing: RSpec, Playwright **Who you are** We encourage candidates to apply even if they do not match every line below. * You have 6\+ years of software engineering experience, or a track record of equivalent impact. * You have designed transactional systems, built external APIs or integration platforms, and safely evolved data models in production. * You understand relational modeling, concurrency, consistency, asynchronous workflows, and distributed failures. * You turn complex business rules into clear boundaries, lifecycle states, contracts, and invariants. * You can lead an important system as its primary builder while collaborating on foundational decisions. * You care about correctness, testing, observability, and safe rollouts. * You communicate directly, listen well, and improve the work of engineers around you. Ruby on Rails experience is useful, but not required. Experience with marketplaces, reservations, inventory\-constrained commerce, public APIs, or third\-party booking systems is also helpful. We care most about your backend judgment, track record, and ability to learn. **What success looks like in 6–12 months** * Multiple distribution partners and an authorized AI agent complete real bookings through one reusable API. * The full booking lifecycle meets agreed targets for correctness, success rate, latency, overselling, recovery, and reconciliation. * Reusable contracts and connector patterns materially reduce the work required to onboard the next partner. * The shared booking model supports at least one new category without a separate booking system. As the API becomes a company\-wide platform, this role can grow toward Staff through demonstrated impact across the booking domain, integrations, and distribution. **Benefits** * Health, dental, and vision coverage, with contributing to monthly premiums * Stock options * 401(k) plan * Unlimited paid time off * Paid parental leave Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $190,000\.00 \- $210,000\.00 per year Experience: * backend/platform engineering: 6 years (Required) * transactional system design: 6 years (Required) * Ruby on Rails/Node/Postgres/AWS/Datadog/Redfis/Kafka: 6 years (Required) * external API and integration: 6 years (Required) Ability to Commute: * New York, NY 10040 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10040

jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in silicon design or architecture (e.g., logic design, power architecture, performance, or SoC design). * Experience with power design, power modeling, power architecture, or power reduction methodologies/techniques. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture. * Experience defining and implementing chip\-wide power management architectures and designs. * Experience in power modeling, measurement, and correlation across the pre\- and post\-silicon phases. * Understanding of modern power and thermal management techniques at both the silicon and system levels (including Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS), turboing, thermal management, and system\-level tradeoffs). * Ability to solve open\-ended power and performance problems under ambiguity. **About the job** ----------------- In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting\-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML\-driven systems. As part of the TPU power design team, you will play a pivotal part in improving the power efficiency of our TPUs. You will drive power efficiency for our TPU designs, starting from building power models to proposing novel power optimization techniques. You would possess a deep background in modeling and optimizing chip power, as well as have an understanding of system level power considerations and tradeoffs. As an ASIC Design Engineer, you will be part of a team developing ASICs used to accelerate computation in data centers. You will have dynamic, multi\-faceted responsibilities in areas such as project definition, design, and implementation. You will participate in the design, architecture, documentation, and implementation of the next generation of data center accelerators. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $163000 \- $236000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Contribute to design power modeling and drive convergence to power goals. * Investigate, specify, and deploy architectural and microarchitectural power optimization techniques. * Define best practices and methodologies to achieve low\-power designs. * Collaborate with cross\-functional software and system teams to create novel power management architectures to meet power goals. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- All Cost CentersResearch \& DevelopmentEngineering \& TechnologyEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $265\.2K – $331\.5K We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential. 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2\.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. **About Engineering at Headway** -------------------------------- Building a new mental healthcare system at Headway is only possible because of the scale and leverage that software can provide. The engineering team at Headway is a small but mighty team using technology to build that future (and have a fun time while doing it!). **About this role** ------------------- You'll lead the Infrastructure team — one of three teams in Engineering Foundations, alongside Agentic Engineering and Eddy, Headway's internal AI platform — that every other team at Headway builds on. You'll own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, LLM infrastructure (gateway, multi\-provider failover, per\-team rate limiting), the database platform, observability, and incident response, while hiring and growing a high\-performance team shipping at AI\-accelerated velocity. As AI dramatically increases code velocity across the org, our mandate is to make every change safe from the start and build systems that get safer as they get faster, working toward a model where routine infrastructure is self\-serve and the team spends the majority of its time on strategic platform work. That means owning the reliability, performance, and scalability of Mamba, Headway's FastAPI/Python monolith, and the AWS infrastructure it runs on. This is a technical leadership role: you'll set strategy and vision for the team, report to the Head of Engineering Foundations, and lead through credibility in design reviews and incident response, not through distance from the work. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **An engineering team:** hiring to a high bar into a growing team, developing engineers through the senior and staff levels, and running an effective on\-call rotation for a team the rest of engineering depends on. **The infrastructure platform:** a system every other Headway team builds on, and a roadmap spanning cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, LLM infrastructure, the data layer, and observability. **The shift from reactive to strategic:** driving the team's operating model toward self\-serve infrastructure, so the team spends more time on strategic platform work and less on routine support requests. **Blast\-radius reduction:** leading the architectural and deployment validation work that contains the scope and duration of incidents when they happen. **The org interface:** defining production readiness expectations for AI workloads, co\-owning container security and secrets management with the Security team, and making sure the platform is accessible and well\-understood by the product engineering teams that depend on it. **Principles that guide us:** ----------------------------- **Focus on the mission:** We view software as a means of effecting change in the world, not as an end unto itself. We write software to empower our patients and therapist to better solve the problems they're facing. **Ship small, learn fast:** We are building new and novel products and believe that we learn what our users need by quickly shipping and iteration **Everything is a product:** Whether it's our patient search experience or a developer productivity improvement, we tre  feel safe asking questions and discussing mistakes. **Who You Are** --------------- We're looking for experienced engineering team leaders and people managers who are relationship\-obsessed, drive results, and enable their teams to build for technical excellence. As a Senior Engineering Manager at Headway, you will work closely with Engineering Leadership, Security, and product engineering teams across the org to help shape the future of the engineering organization. You are an infrastructure leader who is as comfortable in a postmortem as you are in a planning doc. You know how to run a team that carries a support queue while still making progress on strategic platform work. You hold the technical bar yourself and earn credibility with the team through the quality of your judgment, not your title. * 5\-7\+ years of experience of engineering leadership experience, with experience leading infrastructure or platform teams. * 5\+ years of experience as a Software or Infrastructure Engineer, with enough depth to lead credibly in design reviews and incident response * You've personally led the shift from "infra team owns everything" to a self\-serve platform other engineers build on themselves — not just inherited or operated a system where that transition had already happened. * Experience managing the interface between a platform team and the product engineering teams that depend on it, including setting ownership boundaries and building self\-serve tooling * Comfortable managing through competing demands: a support queue, a strategic roadmap, an on\-call rotation, and fast\-moving external dependencies all at once * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure at scale (AWS), observability tooling (Datadog or similar), and deployment pipelines at companies where reliability is a product requirement. * You're personally hands\-on with AI coding tools day to day — not just driving your team's AI adoption as a program. Every candidate goes through a hands\-on AI coding interview as part of this loop * Experience owning a platform strategy and representing it to senior leadership: setting measurable goals for infrastructure work, and making the case for foundational investment in terms the business understands **Below are additional experiences we think help engineering managers succeed at Headway:** * You have led a team through a significant architectural transition, such as moving from a monolith toward service isolation, or from manual to automated operations * You have experience building or governing LLM infrastructure and AI platform primitives * You have experience in healthcare or another regulated environment We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. jobs.title: Data Operations Manager
jobs.description: Overview: **Overview:** HealthEdge is looking for a Data Operations Manager with a focus on data insights who thinks like an engineer, works like a scientist and communicates like a strategist. This hybrid role sits at the intersection of data platform engineering and ITSM\-aligned Problem Management – purpose\-built to expose the hidden toil, technical debt and repeat failure patterns that drain engineering capacity and impact payer customer availability across our integrated platform of solutions. You will leverage AI – including Claude and its supporting functions – to ingest disparate operational data sources, model failure trends and surface prioritized insights that drive permanent resolution rather than perpetual remediation. **WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** Production stability is a business imperative for health plans that depend on HealthEdge solutions to process claims, manage care and engage members. Repeat incidents, unresolved technical debt and untracked toil create invisible drag on engineering velocity – and visible risk to client uptime. This role exists to make the invisible visible, and to turn data\-driven findings into engineering action. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Operational Data Engineering** * Design, build and maintain pipelines that consolidate data from PagerDuty, Jira, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk and other operational sources into a unified analytical layer. * Develop and curate data models that identify repeat incidents, known error patterns, chronic alert noise and engineering toil consuming disproportionate remediation cycles. * Maintain data quality, lineage and governance standards across all ingested data to decision. * Develop automated reporting workflows that surface trending issues and emerging risk patterns without requiring manual aggregation cycles. * Support monthly ceremonies by providing jobs.title: Senior BI Analyst
jobs.description: Overview: **Overview:** We are looking for a self\-directed BI Analyst to join our growing HealthEdge Business Intelligence team. Your focus is on the analytical and visual layer: understanding what business teams need to decide, modeling the data into intuitive dashboards, and delivering a polished, usable experience that holds up to executive and operational scrutiny. package insights so non\-technical stakeholders can act on them without translation. * Maintain lightweight documentation describing what each dashboard answers, what it does not, and who owns the underlying data. **Collaboration with Data Engineering** * Partner with onshore and offshore data engineers to define and refine the analytics\-ready data sources that power dashboards. * Write your own SQL for ad\-hoc analysis, prototyping, and data validation; surface gaps, quality issues, or modeling changes back to the data engineering team. * Help prioritize the data engineering backlog by clearly articulating which new data, columns, or refresh frequencies are needed to unlock business value. **Quality, Iteration, and Continuous Improvement** * Validate dashboard numbers against source systems and surface discrepancies promptly. * Monitor usage and gather feedback from end users; retire or rework dashboards that are not earning their place. * Identify and propose opportunities to consolidate redundant reports, improve refresh cadence, or migrate legacy Tableau or Excel content into QuickSight (or vice versa) as the platform strategy evolves. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional experience building production BI dashboards in Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, Power BI, Looker, or comparable modern BI tooling — with at least one tool used at deep, hands\-on proficiency. * Demonstrated ability to design clean, usable dashboards with strong visual hierarchy, intentional use of color, and a clear point of view. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - LLM Observability
jobs.description: **What We’re Building** Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200\-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023! If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases. **Who We Are** We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers. **How We Work** We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1\. \#LI\-Remote#### **Little more about the team:** The team builds observability for AI in Honeycomb. We help customers see what their agents are doing, what those agents cost, and where errors happen. We also give them insight into individual conversations so they can debug them. We're bringing LLM and agent observability together, and we own both the data foundation and the product experiences built on top of it. You'll work in a small, cross\-functional group of engineers with a dedicated product manager and designer, shipping features customers use in production. If you want to define how people understand and debug AI systems, this is the team for you. #### **What you’ll do in the role:** * Own end\-to\-end development of AI observability capabilities, from ingestion to in\-product visualizations. * Architect and evolve the data model and infrastructure that let us observe agents and their ecosystems across the Honeycomb product. * Build systems that analyze and surface AI\-specific signals, such as cost, token usage, errors, and anomalies. * Collaborate with product and design partners to make sure what we build is usable, intuitive, and unlocks meaningful user workflows. * Teach best practices for exploring and understanding AI system behavior across conversations and workloads. * Iterate through fast feedback loops and experimentation, and share both wins and failures. #### **What you’ll bring to the role:** * Significant software engineering experience, with a record of shipping and owning features end to end. * Experience shipping customer\-facing features at a SaaS company, beyond internal tooling. * Full\-stack range, with proficiency in backend development (Go and/or Python) and frontend development (TypeScript and React). * A track record of working closely with product managers and designers. * Regular, hands\-on use of AI tools in your day\-to\-day engineering work. * Experience being on call. You'd join our rotation after about 90 days. * A track record of navigating ambiguity in a fast\-moving field where requirements shift and experimentation is a core part of the job. * Bonus: Experience building LLM or agent\-powered features in production. * Bonus: Hands\-on experience with observability tooling, such as OpenTelemetry. Base Salary based on level of experience $183,340 \- $206,000 USD **What you'll get when you join the Hive:** * A stake in our success \- generous equity with employee\-friendly stock program * It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are \- our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience * Time to recharge with unlimited PTO * A distributed\-first mindset and culture (really!) * Home office, co\-working, and internet stipend * Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents * Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood * Annual development allowance * And much more... **Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time.** Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work. **Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:** We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you: * All communications will come from an **@honeycomb.io** email address + We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—**never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo**. * Our recruiting process will **never** ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to: + Social security or tax identification numbers + Credit card numbers + Bank account information **Diversity \& Accommodations:** We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams. We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know. As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback. **Privacy Notice:** If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes. For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice. If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact privacy@honeycomb.io. Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer - Compute & Storage - Highrise AI
jobs.description: **About Highrise AI** Highrise AI is a GPU\-native infrastructure platform built for modern AI workloads. Designed for developers and enterprises operating in performance\-critical and security\-sensitive environments, Highrise delivers scalable GPU compute across dedicated clusters, managed cloud, and confidential environments. Highrise combines bare\-metal performance with full\-stack orchestration, API\-driven access, and hardware\-enforced isolation to support training, fine\-tuning, and production\-scale deployment of AI models. From reserved GPU capacity to enterprise\-grade confidential compute, Highrise provides flexible infrastructure models tailored to the needs of builders operating at scale. Beyond infrastructure, Highrise integrates disciplined operations, advanced automation, and on\-site engineering expertise to sustain high uptime and predictable performance across deployments. These capabilities extend beyond Highrise\-owned fleets: through managed services, Highrise also operates third\-party GPU hardware on behalf of customers and partners, applying the same operational standards to infrastructure it does not own. Highrise is a subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp., an energy infrastructure platform. Hut 8 integrates power, digital infrastructure, and compute at scale. Highrise serves as the compute and operations layer—designing, deploying, and operating next\-generation GPU clusters from commissioning through production. **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are seeking a mid\-level AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer to provide Tier 2 operational support for large\-scale GPU compute and storage platforms. This hands\-on role focuses on owning technical tickets, restoring service, investigating recurring issues, and maintaining reliable day\-to\-day operation of production AI clusters. Working closely with the NOC, on\-site data hall technicians, SRE teams, and senior infrastructure engineers, the engineer will troubleshoot Linux\-based compute nodes, GPU systems, storage services, and their supporting software. Complex or systemic issues will be escalated to Tier 3 engineering with clear diagnostics and supporting evidence. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Tier 2 Incident and Ticket Management** * Own and manage escalated incidents, service requests, and problem tickets from initial technical triage through resolution, escalation, or documented handoff. * Diagnose compute and storage faults using system logs, monitoring dashboards, management interfaces, and approved diagnostic tools. * Assess severity and customer impact; coordinate with the NOC and site teams to restore service within operational and SLA targets. * Produce clear troubleshooting records, timely ticket updates, shift handovers, and actionable Tier 3 or OEM escalations. **Compute and GPU Platform Operations** * Troubleshoot Linux servers, GPU health alerts, boot failures, firmware/driver issues, hardware faults, and resource availability problems. * Support node provisioning, reimaging, configuration changes, routine maintenance, and return\-to\-service validation using established automation and runbooks. * Investigate Kubernetes and Slurm node or workload failures, working with platform engineers when application or scheduler\-level escalation is required. * Perform first\-level analysis of connectivity or GPU communication symptoms and engage network or Tier 3 engineers for deeper fabric and performance investigation. **Storage Operations and Troubleshooting** * Monitor and troubleshoot distributed and high\-performance storage systems, including capacity, throughput, availability, and client connectivity. * Investigate filesystem mount failures, storage\-node or disk alerts, degraded services, and access or performance complaints. * Execute approved recovery, maintenance, and component replacement workflows with storage vendors and data hall technicians. * Support operational tasks across file, object, and block storage platforms as deployed at Highrise sites. **Operational Readiness and Continuous Improvement** * Assist with upgrades, planned maintenance, cluster expansions, and validation activities following established change controls. * Maintain accurate asset, configuration, and ticket records; jobs.title: AI/ML Lead
jobs.description: About ISACA: ISACA® (www.isaca.org) champions the global workforce advancing trust in technology. With a presence in more than 195 countries and with more than 230 chapters worldwide, ISACA offers resources tailored to every stage of members’ careers—helping them to thrive in a rapidly changing digital landscape, drive trusted innovation and ensure a more secure digital world. Through the ISACA Foundation, ISACA also expands IT and education career pathways, fostering opportunities to grow the next generation of technology professionals. Overview: The AI/ML Lead is a senior, hands\-on engineer and the first member of ISACA's AI implementation team, a new internal capability that will take on AI engineering work currently delivered by external vendors. Reporting to the VP, Application Engineering, and working within the platform architecture, standards, and governance set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture, Platforms \& Agentic Systems, this role builds and hardens the AI solutions that serve ISACA's members and business, both those in delivery today and those that emerge as ISACA's AI portfolio grows. The initial focus is ISACA's personalized member experience, a production RAG and knowledge graph\-based recommendation system that integrates ISACA's Body of Knowledge, certification details, workforce skills data, and member profile information. The majority of the role is spent implementing: writing production code, building data and retrieval pipelines, and operationalizing the engineering practices that keep AI systems reliable. Success is measured by production stability, the share of AI engineering work brought in\-house, and the implementation team's growing ability to deliver ISACA's current and future AI needs without vendor dependency. Responsibilities: **AI Platform Technical Contribution*** Provide hands\-on engineering for the development, integration, and production delivery of ISACA's AI solutions, beginning with the AI\-driven member experience, working within the platform architecture and standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture. Build and maintain core AI components, including knowledge graph ontology and configuration (Graphwise or a comparable enterprise knowledge graph platform), embedding and retrieval pipelines, recommendation logic, and LLM\-powered and agentic application components. Implement the APIs and service contracts that connect AI capabilities to ISACA's digital experiences and business systems. Ensure all components are built for reuse, long\-term internal ownership, and maintainability. **AI Vendor Oversight \& Insourcing*** Serve as the key internal technical counterpart to external AI development vendors and contractors. Participate in vendor architecture reviews and review vendor code and pull requests, evaluating AI solution designs, including RAG pipelines, knowledge graph implementation, and LLM integration, against ISACA's technical requirements and the engineering standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture. Define and maintain acceptance criteria for vendor deliverables, support production readiness validation, and surface technical risk or delivery misalignment to the Senior Director, AI Architecture, and IT leadership. Lead knowledge transfer so that vendor\-built components move to internal ownership on a planned timeline, progressively reducing vendor dependency. **AI Engineering Practices \& Operations*** Implement and operate MLOps and LLMOps practices in line with the platform standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture, including CI/CD for ML and LLM pipelines, model and prompt versioning, evaluation, monitoring, drift detection, and token cost tracking. Establish team\-level engineering practices, including code review, documentation, runbooks, and reusable components, that promote quality and consistency across the implementation team and sustain ISACA's AI solutions beyond any single initiative. Foster knowledge sharing so that expertise is built into the organization rather than held by individuals. Implement the security, responsible AI, and auditability controls defined by the Senior Director and Security within the AI solutions the team builds. **Data Infrastructure \& AI Data Enablement*** Build and maintain the data foundations that supply ISACA's AI solutions with reliable, well\-structured inputs. Implement ingestion and transformation pipelines from source systems such as CRM, third\-party content and learning platforms, and external workforce and market trend data. Implement data contracts with source\-system owners, plus data quality checks and monitoring aligned to the standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture. Identify and document gap ersecurity risk management, or professional certification ecosystems — sufficient to collaborate effectively with ISACA's internal subject\-matter experts and align AI outputs to organizational standards. * Experience with knowledge graph reasoning, or GraphRAG patterns relevant to professional knowledge and competency ontology use cases. * Familiarity with bias and fairness evaluation for AI\-driven recommendation systems, including output\-level testing for demographic or professional skew * Prior experience working in a non\-profit, professional association, standards body, or other mission\-driven organization is a plus. * Experience collaborating across hybrid delivery models including in\-house staff, contractors, and external development vendors. * Proficiency with Azure AI platforms, or equivalent services on AWS or GCP. Azure is the primary cloud platform for this role. * Familiarity with enterprise platforms commonly used in ISACA's ecosystem, such as Salesforce, Sitecore, and Microsoft Azure environments, is a plus. * Working familiarity with responsible AI principles and general awareness of relevant AI regulatory trends. **Certification and Licensing Preferred:*** Microsoft Certified: Azure AI App and Agent Developer Associate (AI\-103\) or MLOps Engineer Associate (AI\-300\); prior Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI\-102\) or Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP\-100\) also recognized * AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional or Machine Learning Engineer – Associate, or Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer **Competencies/Skills Required:*** Strong customer and member focus, with the ability to design and deliver AI systems that reflect ISACA’s commitment to professional excellence and digital trust * A senior hands\-on engineer who writes production code, reviews vendor work, and helps grow an internal implementation team. * Intellectual adaptability and continuous learning orientation; ability to rapidly develop fluency in new architectures and tools as they emerge. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking; ability to evaluate tradeoffs between innovation, delivery constraints, cost, and risk in early\-stage AI programs * Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to explain AI architecture decisions, technical risks, and engineering tradeoffs to technical and product stakeholders * Collaborative working style, with the ability to build alignment across engineering, product, data, and security teams without direct authority. * Self\-starter capable of operating autonomously in environments with evolving requirements and incomplete information * Commitment to ISACA’s mission, purpose, and values; cultural sensitivity and awareness appropriate for a global professional membership organization. This position may require periodic onsite attendance, either currently or in the future, based on business needs. Occasional travel may also be required to attend company\-sponsored events, meetings, all\-hands gatherings, training sessions, or other activities necessary to support the essential functions of the role. Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO): ISACA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: PNT Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description**: IS4S is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to support the development of embedded software for Assured Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (APNT) systems working on\-site in our Auburn, AL or Huntsville, AL location. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of navigation algorithms, sensor interfaces, platform integration, and software testing for resilient navigation solutions operating in challenging environments, including conditions where GPS/GNSS may be degraded, denied, or unavailable. This role offers the opportunity to work across the embedded software development lifecycle, from algorithm implementation and hardware interfacing to integration, testing, and performance evaluation. The ideal candidate has strong modern C\+\+ programming skills, experience developing software in Linux environments, and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable, and well\-tested software. **Key Responsibilities** Develop and maintain embedded software components for assured PNT systems using modern C\+\+. Implement and support navigation algorithms that process data from inertial sensors, GPS/GNSS receivers, clocks, and other navigation sources. Develop and maintain software interfaces to sensors, embedded hardware, and host platforms. Integrate software components with navigation hardware and platform systems, troubleshooting hardware/software interface issues. Develop and execute unit, integration, and system\-level tests to verify software functionality and performance. Analyze test results, investigate defects, and support debugging and performance optimization. Use Git\-based version control, automated build systems, and CI/CD pipelines to support software quality and repeatable development workflows. Collaborate with systems, hardware, and navigation engineers to develop, integrate, and demonstrate assured PNT capabilities. **Required Qualifications** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Experience developing software in modern C\+\+, including object\-oriented programming, standard library features, and sound software design practices. Experience developing, building, debugging, and testing software in a Linux environment. Proficiency with Git or an equivalent modern version control system, including branching, merging, and collaborative development workflows. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated software build, test, and integration processes. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. Ability to write clear, maintainable, and well\-documented software. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering team. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with embedded software development on Linux\-based platforms. Familiarity with navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, inertial navigation systems (INS), GPS/GNSS, or other PNT technologies. Experience interfacing with hardware using serial communications, Ethernet, SPI, I²C, CAN, or similar protocols. Experience with unit testing frameworks and software quality tools, such as static analysis, code coverage, and automated linting. Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI/CD. Familiarity with Python or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping, test automation, and data analysis. Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, embedded system integration, or field testing. **Benefits Summary:** Competitive salary with comprehensive health and wellness benefits Dynamic and collaborative work environment Employee ownership Medical, dental, and vision care plans Paid time\-off and parental leave programs Group term life insurance 401(k) retirement plan Tuition Assistance, Training, and education development offerings

jobs.title: IT Support & Systems Coordinator — Part-Time, Onsite
jobs.description: IT Support \& Systems Coordinator — Part\-Time, Onsite **Location:** Las Vegas, NV — Onsite **Department:** Information Technology **Position Type:** Part\-Time **Level:** Junior / Entry\-to\-Mid Level **Reports To:** Management / IT Manager Position Summary We are looking for a dependable and hands\-on **part\-time IT Support \& Systems Coordinator** to provide technology support for our office and employees. **This position requires working onsite at our Las Vegas office. Remote or hybrid work is not available.** The part\-time schedule and weekly hours will be discussed during the interview process. This position will be responsible for setting up new employees with computers, email accounts, company applications, iPads, and mobile phones, as well as troubleshooting everyday computer and technology issues. The ideal candidate should have good working knowledge of Microsoft products, Windows computers, Microsoft 365, email administration, mobile devices, printers, basic networking, and general office technology. Some basic knowledge of servers and network infrastructure is preferred. This is a hands\-on position for someone who enjoys solving problems, helping employees, and keeping company technology organized and operational. Key Responsibilities * Provide IT support to office staff and management during scheduled onsite hours. * Set up computers, laptops, monitors, printers, and other office equipment. * Set up new employees with company technology and system access. * Create and manage Microsoft 365 and company email accounts. * Configure Outlook, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and other Microsoft applications. * Reset passwords and troubleshoot employee login and access issues. * Set up and maintain company iPads, tablets, and mobile phones. * Install and configure company applications on computers and mobile devices. * Maintain an inventory of company computers, iPads, cell phones, chargers, and other IT equipment. * Issue equipment to employees and maintain records of who is responsible for each device. * Recover and reset company equipment when an employee leaves the company. * Troubleshoot Windows computer problems, software errors, internet connectivity, printers, scanners, and other office equipment. * Install software, updates, drivers, and security patches. * Assist employees with basic computer and technology questions. * Troubleshoot Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, VPN, and basic network connectivity issues. * Assist with company printers and network\-connected equipment. * Provide basic support for company servers and server\-related issues. * Assist senior IT vendors or outside IT providers when more advanced server or network work is required. * Maintain proper backups and help monitor company systems. * Help maintain antivirus, security software, and device protection. * Make sure company computers and devices remain updated and secure. * Help manage employee access to company systems and coordinate prompt removal of access when employees leave. * Maintain organized documentation of passwords, equipment, licenses, software subscriptions, and IT procedures using company\-approved secure systems. * Communicate with outside IT vendors, internet providers, phone providers, and software companies when technical support is required. * Help troubleshoot company phone systems and office telecommunications. * Maintain an organized IT storage area with spare computers, phones, cables, chargers, and equipment. * Coordinate unresolved or urgent issues with management and the outside IT provider to maintain continuity outside scheduled hours. Preferred Knowledge \& Experience Candidates should have working knowledge of: * Microsoft Windows 10/11 * Microsoft 365 * Microsoft Outlook * Microsoft Teams * OneDrive * SharePoint * Microsoft Entra ID / Azure Active Directory basics * Email account administration * Windows computer setup and troubleshooting * iPhone and iPad setup and support * Android devices * Printers and scanners * Wi\-Fi and basic networking * Routers, switches, and access points * Basic VPN troubleshooting * Basic cybersecurity practices * Antivirus and endpoint protection * Basic server administration or Windows Server knowledge * Computer hardware troubleshooting Knowledge of mobile\-device management (MDM) platforms such as Microsoft Intune is a plus. Qualifications * 1–3 years of IT support, help desk, desktop support, or similar experience preferred. * Ability to reliably work onsite at our Las Vegas office on an agreed part\-time schedule. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Comfortable working directly with employees who may have limited technical knowledge. * Good organizational skills. * Ability to manage multiple IT requests and prioritize urgent problems within scheduled working hours. * Ability to document equipment, accounts, passwords, licenses, and technical procedures accurately. * Professional and trustworthy when handling confidential company information. * Able to work independently and know when an issue needs to be escalated to a senior IT professional. * Good verbal and written communication skills. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is **hands\-on, responsive, organized, and willing to learn**. This person does not need to be a senior network engineer or server administrator. However, they should be comfortable handling the majority of everyday office technology problems without requiring outside IT support for every small issue. The right person should be able to walk into an employee’s office, identify the problem, troubleshoot it, and get the employee working again as quickly as possible. Examples of Daily Tasks A typical shift may include: * Setting up a computer and email for a newly hired employee. * Configuring a company iPhone or iPad. * Resetting an employee’s Microsoft 365 password. * Troubleshooting Outlook or Teams. * Fixing a printer connection. * Replacing or preparing a laptop. * Installing company software. * Troubleshooting an employee’s Wi\-Fi or network connection. * Checking why a computer cannot connect to a company application. * Helping with basic server or network issues. * Coordinating a more complicated problem with the company’s outside IT provider. * Updating the company’s inventory of computers, phones, and tablets. Position Goal The goal of this position is to keep our employees productive by making sure our computers, mobile devices, Microsoft systems, email, and office technology are properly set up, maintained, organized, and supported.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Applications Developer
jobs.description: About Knovo Knovo is an award\-winning retail branch design and architectural services firm. We specialize in 3D site surveys, architectural drawings, BIM coordination, digital installations, and data\-driven asset management that help brands design smarter, operate better, and deliver standout customer experiences. We're a fast\-moving, highly collaborative team that thrives on precision, creativity, innovation, and execution. We partner with leading retailers and financial institutions to deliver complex, data\-driven programs at scale. Technology and data are a big part of how we work, and we're continuing to invest in the platforms, automation and AI capabilities that connect our teams, projects and clients. If you're a hands\-on developer who enjoys solving real business problems, connecting systems, and turning ideas into practical applications that people actually use, this role is for you. ‍ The Role We are looking for a Senior Enterprise Applications Developer to help design and build the next generation of Knovo's enterprise and operations platform. This is a hands\-on development role for someone who enjoys understanding how a business actually works and turning those requirements into practical technology. You will work directly with our leadership and operations teams to help shape the technical approach and then build it, developing connected applications, workflows, integrations, automation and AI capabilities that improve how we manage projects and deliver work to our clients. Our current direction uses Quickbase as the operational backbone and system of record, with Microsoft technologies supporting areas such as AI, automation, identity, security, collaboration and reporting. This role will help bring these pieces together into a simple, secure and scalable platform. This isn't about introducing technology for the sake of technology. We're looking for someone who can understand the problem, recommend the right technical approach and then build it. ‍ Key Tasks and Responsibilities * Design, develop and continuously improve Knovo's enterprise and operations applications. * Develop and enhance our Quickbase environment, including project databases, workflows, relationships, interfaces, reporting and business logic. * Build integrations between Quickbase, Microsoft and other core platforms using APIs, connectors, middleware and automation tools. * Develop project workflows that connect projects, locations, tasks, milestones, deliverables, issues, assets, resources and other operational data. * Build automation using tools such as Power Automate to reduce manual work and move information between systems. * Help develop our Microsoft Copilot Studio and AI capabilities, including agents that can securely access project information, answer questions and perform approved actions. * Develop user\-friendly applications and interfaces for internal teams, with the ability to extend these capabilities to clients and partners over time. * Integrate SharePoint/Microsoft 365 for documents and collaboration and Power BI for operational, client and executive reporting. * Build security and permissions into applications from the beginning, including role\-based access, authentication, data segregation and auditability. * Work directly with business users to understand how projects actually operate, identify pain points and translate those needs into working solutions. * Test, troubleshoot and maintain applications and integrations to ensure they are reliable, accurate and scalable. * Evaluate new technologies and tools and help determine where they provide real value within our platform. What Success Looks Like You'll know you're making an impact when: * Our core project and operations workflows are connected through a reliable, easy\-to\-use platform. * Quickbase provides a clean and trusted operational backbone rather than a collection of disconnected applications and data. * Information moves between Quickbase, Microsoft and our other systems without unnecessary manual work. * Teams spend less time updating systems, searching for information and completing repetitive administrative tasks. * Employees can easily understand project status, priorities, risks and next steps. * AI and automation are being used in practical ways that improve how we work without compromising client data or security. * Applications are built with the security, reliability and scalability expected by the large enterprise clients we serve. * You can take a business problem from "here's what we need" to a working solution and continue improving it based on real\-world use. Qualifications What You'll Bring * Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software Development, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience developing business applications, enterprise applications or workflow\-based solutions, with demonstrated experience taking applications from concept through development and deployment. * Strong experience with APIs, REST integrations, JSON and connecting cloud\-based applications. * Experience with Quickbase development and administration is highly preferred; strong experience with comparable low\-code/database platforms will also be considered. * Experience with the Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Automate and ideally Power Apps and/or Copilot Studio. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments. * Experience with relational data structures and designing applications around connected business data. * Development experience with SQL and at least one general\-purpose programming language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or C\#. * Experience with AI/LLM integrations, AI agents or enterprise AI applications is a strong asset. * Understanding of application security, authentication, permissions, APIs and enterprise data protection. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to understand a business process and translate it into a practical technical solution. * Comfortable working directly with business users and explaining technical concepts in straightforward language. * Able to work independently, take ownership of solutions and move from concept through development, testing and deployment. * Curious and adaptable, with an interest in continually improving how technology can support the business. Benefits * Competitive salary * Health plan * 401(k) * Paid Time Off * Opportunities for growth and advancement Location This position is in the Hollywood, Florida office, with an opportunity for a hybrid work model (office and work from home) Pay: From $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hollywood, FL 33020

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e\-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience — rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971\. From initial design through go\-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients. **About the Role** The Software engineer II will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting KPI’s next generation Warehouse Execution Products and Platforms. Design and deliver solutions intelligent software, to orchestrate material handling automated equipment, AGVs/AMRs, robotics, etc. to fulfill warehouse operations. **Responsibilities** * Collaborate with Agile software teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support software platforms using Java and other platforms. * Partner with product managers, and deliver robust software products that orchestrate devices, robots, AGVs, AMRs and other equipment to automate the warehouse operations. * Participate in product backlog prioritization, story mapping, and story splitting activities. Translate simple to complex user stories into functional and actionable software. * Analyzing systems to identify bugs and ensure quality. * Presenting a solution to the technical team and business users. • Engage with our device and robotics partner ecosystem to align our product roadmap and direction. * Maintaining developed systems and upgrading tools to ensure they stay relevant and up to date. * Work directly with the customers to understand reported issues and schedule patches with fixes. **Requirements*** 8\+ Years of experience as a software engineer/ developer building Java and Spring Boot software applications and services. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science • 3\+ years’ experience in technologies such as Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, API Management. * 3 \+ years of experience RDBMS such as MS\-SQL, PostgreSQL. Must be skilled with writing and executing complex SQL queries and understanding relational databases. * 3\+ years of experience with defining, developing and implementing RESTful APIs with JSON. * Experience integrating with automated hardware, Robotics, IoT systems. * Experienced with Git, Unit / Test automation, Cl/CD platforms to build and release code. * Experience with BPMN, Camunda or similar Workflow Manager Platforms. * Familiar with cloud technology including Event Streaming, PaaS services, Cloud\-Native patterns. * Professional demeanor and the ability to communicate complex technical information in a clear and tactful manner. * Ability to mentor Guide team members toward best solutions for the problem at hand. * Regular travel to KPI COEs or customer sites (up to 15%) required as necessary. **Benefits** **What we Offer:** * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Health Care Concierge Service * 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre\-tax \& Roth) * Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability \& Long\-Term Disability * Voluntary Life \& AD\&D Insurance * Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness \& Hospital Indemnity Insurance * Pet Insurance * Milk Stork Program * Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& 10 Holidays) * Training \& Development **Why KPI Solutions?** At KPI Solutions, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting role—it’s an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance. *KPI Solutions provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by states, federal, or local law.*

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Leader
jobs.description: Are you ready to move your career forward and help shape our company’s and customers’ futures? If you aspire to challenge yourself, work with the best in the industry and join a successful team where you can make a meaningful contribution, then we invite you to join us at Ketjen Corporation, a provider of advanced catalyst solutions to leading producers in the petrochemical, refining, and specialty chemicals industries. Together, we can create a legacy marked by innovation, excitement, and energy. JOB DESCRIPTION Ketjen is seeking a Continuous Improvement Leader to advance operational excellence, productivity, and continuous improvement across the global organization. Reporting to the Senior Continuous Improvement Manager, this role will partner with leaders and cross\-functional teams to identify, prioritize, execute, and sustain high\-impact improvement initiatives. The successful candidate will lead projects from concept through implementation, deliver measurable business results, and help embed continuous improvement into the way Ketjen operates. KEY JOB DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES • Lead the identification, prioritization, and execution of Continuous Improvement initiatives that deliver measurable improvements in safety, productivity, cost, jobs.title: Sr. Specialist, Information Security
jobs.description: LG Energy Solution Michigan Inc. (LGESMI) develops and manufactures large lithium\-ion polymer batteries and packs for electric vehicle (EV) and energy storage applications. Come join the leader in advanced EV batteries! www.lgenergymi.com **Summary:** We are seeking an experienced Senior Security Specialist with a strong IT infrastructure background to help protect, secure, and continuously improve our organization's enterprise technology environment. This role combines hands\-on infrastructure knowledge with broad cybersecurity expertise across systems, networks, endpoints, identity and access management, cloud services, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and incident response. The Senior Security Specialist will work closely with IT infrastructure, networking, and business stakeholders to identify security risks, implement effective security controls, drive remediation efforts, and ensure security is integrated into technology operations and projects. The ideal candidate understands how enterprise infrastructure is designed, deployed, maintained, and supported and can apply that knowledge to identify vulnerabilities, strengthen security configurations, and develop practical solutions that protect critical systems without unnecessarily disrupting business operations. This position requires a proactive, technically strong security professional who can work independently, lead security initiatives, influence technical decisions, and serve as a trusted resource for enterprise security matters. **Responsibilities:** * **Enterprise Security and Infrastructure Protection** + Develop, implement, and maintain security controls that protect enterprise infrastructure, systems, networks, endpoints, and cloud environments. + Assess infrastructure configurations and identify security weaknesses, misconfigurations, and opportunities to reduce the organization's attack surface. + Establish and promote secure configuration standards, system hardening practices, and infrastructure security baselines. + Evaluate technology designs and infrastructure changes to ensure appropriate security controls are implemented. + Provide technical guidance on security best practices, infrastructure protection, and risk mitigation. * **Vulnerability and Risk Management** + Manage and coordinate vulnerability identification, assessment, prioritization, remediation, and validation across the enterprise. + Analyze vulnerability scan results and prioritize findings based on severity, exploitability, asset criticality, exposure, and business impact. + Work with system administrators, network engineers, and cloud teams to drive timely remediation. + Track remediation activities, document exceptions, and communicate outstanding risks to appropriate stakeholders. + Identify recurring security issues and recommend sustainable corrective actions. + Provide reporting on vulnerability trends, remediation performance, and overall infrastructure risk. * **Security Operations and Incident Response** + Investigate security alerts and suspicious activity involving enterprise systems, endpoints, identities, networks, and cloud resources. + Collaborate with security operations teams to investigate, contain, remediate, and document security incidents. + Support the use and continuous improvement of SIEM, EDR/XDR, logging, and threat detection capabilities. + Analyze security events, authentication anomalies, malware detections, unauthorized changes, and indicators of compromise. + Assist with incident response planning, root\-cause analysis, recovery activities, and post\-incident improvements. + Identify opportunities to improve detection coverage, response procedures, and security monitoring across infrastructure environments. + Coordinate technical remediation efforts with infrastructure and application support teams following security incidents. * **Network, Endpoint, and Systems Security** + Support endpoint and server protection through EDR/XDR, antivirus, device compliance, and security configuration management. + Identify unnecessary services, exposed ports, insecure protocols, and configuration issues that introduce risk. + Promote secure administration practices and protection of critical infrastructure assets. + Collaborate with technical teams to improve resilience, system integrity, and security visibility. * **Security Governance, Compliance, and Risk Reduction** + Support security assessments, internal audits, compliance reviews, and technical control evaluations. + Apply recognized security frameworks and practices, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, and ISO 27001, as applicable. + Maintain security standards, technical procedures, risk documentation, remediation records, and exception approvals. + Provide technical evidence and support for internal and external audits. + Assist in evaluating security risks associated with new technologies, vendors, infrastructure changes, and business initiatives. + Communicate technical risks and recommended corrective actions in a clear, actionable manner. + Contribute to continuous improvement of enterprise security policies, standards, and operating procedures. * **Technical Leadership and Collaboration** + Serve as a senior technical resource for infrastructure security and enterprise cybersecurity matters. + Lead or coordinate security remediation efforts and infrastructure security improvement initiatives. + Build strong working relationships with IT operations, networking, cloud engineering, application support, and business stakeholders. + Provide guidance to technical teams on security requirements, implementation approaches, and remediation strategies. + Communicate priorities, risks, and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences. + Develop and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge\-sharing materials. + Promote a security\-conscious culture and help integrate security into everyday IT operations. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 5–8 years of experience in IT infrastructure, information security, cybersecurity engineering, systems administration, network engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, including Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, networking, virtualization, and hybrid cloud environments. * Demonstrated experience implementing or supporting enterprise security controls. * Experience with vulnerability management, security remediation, patch management, and infrastructure hardening. * Working knowledge of network security, endpoint protection, identity security, authentication, and access management. * Familiarity with security monitoring, incident response, logging, and security investigation processes. * Understanding of security risk management, technical control assessments, and security best practices. * Ability to collaborate with infrastructure teams to implement security improvements. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive technical issues through resolution. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with security platforms such as Splunk, Tenable, EDR, NAC, DLP or comparable technologies. * Experience supporting enterprise security initiatives, technical risk assessments, audits, and compliance programs. * Knowledge of incident response, threat detection, threat hunting, and forensic investigation principles. * Experience with security frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800\-53, CIS Controls, or ISO 27001\. * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, Security\+, CySA\+, or other Infrastructure and Security related certification. * Language: Korean Preferred (Optional). **Skills** * Enterprise infrastructure and security expertise. * Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills. * Risk\-based prioritization and sound security judgment. * Ability to translate security requirements into practical technical solutions. * Ownership and accountability for remediation outcomes. * Cross\-functional communication and collaboration. * Technical leadership and independent problem\-solving. * Commitment to continuous improvement and professional development. **Benefits Overview** * 100% employer\-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision premiums for you and your family * 100% employer\-paid disability and life insurance * Generous Paid Time Off / Holidays * Opportunity to grow in a diverse work environment with a global company * 401k Retirement savings and planning with a generous company match **LGESMI is an Equal Opportunity employer that values the diversity of its workforce. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes.
