As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data\-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives. Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives. **Work Schedule** This is a full‑time, exempt (salaried) position assigned to a First Shift schedule, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. in EDT time zone. maintain deep understanding of system architecture. * Advocate for and implement engineering best practices while balancing pragmatism and business needs. * Identify and champion foundational improvements, workflow optimizations, and new technologies with significant impact. * Contribute to product and technical roadmaps, team workflows, and strategic planning. * Break down large, complex projects into manageable deliverables across multiple platforms. * Communicate clearly about technical decisions and project status; foster a positive, collaborative team environment. * Mentor peers by sharing knowledge and promoting continuous improvement. * Design, implement, and evolve major features and services within the LIMS ecosystem. * Collaborate with lab operations, automation engineers, and scientific stakeholders to ensure software solutions address complex lab workflow needs. * Develop full\-stack applications and APIs that support key lab functions such as specimen tracking, assay execution, batch management, and robotic integration. * Shape the future of our LIMS software systems by identifying architectural improvements and scaling strategies aligned with business priorities. * Contribute to foundational engineering efforts that simplify integration across lab workflows and support long\-term platform stability. * Participate in the team’s on\-call rotation to ensure system reliability and business continuity during genetic testing operations. * Support peer development through mentorship, thoughtful code reviews, and contributions to technical standards and best practices. * Provide clear technical direction and communicate trade\-offs and priorities with stakeholders across functions. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ LakeFusion is seeking a **Software Engineer \- Backend** to build and scale our real\-time API to enterprise production workloads. This is a deeply technical role focused on building resilient, fault\-tolerant, high\-throughput distributed systems that bridge enterprise backends with high\-performance Python microservices and data lakehouse platforms. A critical dimension of this role: we ship into customer environments. You won't just write code that works on our infrastructure — you'll build systems robust enough to run across Azure, AWS, and customer\-managed Kubernetes clusters where you don't control the network, the identity provider, the observability stack, or the operator. That requires a particular kind of engineering discipline: defensive design, strong observability, minimal environmental assumptions, and thorough testing under failure conditions. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Scale the real\-time API: Own the architecture and implementation of our high\-throughput, low\-latency API built in Python/FastAPI and deployed on Kubernetes. * Maintain enterprise core: Develop and maintain core enterprise backends using .NET / C\#, ensuring seamless interoperability between .NET services, FastAPI microservices, and NoSQL datastores. * Build for resilience and fault tolerance: Design for graceful degradation under upstream failures, rate limits, partial outages, and retry storms. Eliminate silent failure modes. * Engineer for autoscaling: Tune Kubernetes autoscaling behavior (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler) to handle bursty production workloads across diverse customer environments. * Optimize NoSQL data stores: Architect and optimize MongoDB collections, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies, and asynchronous database connections for low\-latency queries. * Build streaming integrations: Develop streaming pipelines and background execution workflows that sync data between service, transactional, and analytical layers. * Integrate Lakehouse analytics: Connect backend APIs with Databricks compute, Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog to expose real\-time analytics and data pipelines to downstream consumers. * Design for portability: Architect services that ship into customer environments and work reliably without serverless dependencies, with customer\-controlled identity, restricted network egress, and varied observability stacks. * Own performance: Profile, benchmark, and optimize for latency and throughput. Understand and tune the full stack — from FastAPI event loops and .NET memory management through connection pooling, caching, and downstream service calls. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 2\+ years of backend engineering experience building production\-grade services and microservices. * 2\+ years of deep Python expertise, with hands\-on mastery of FastAPI, ASGI server tuning (uvloop/Uvicorn), async event loops (asyncio), Pydantic, and performance profiling. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in .NET Core / .NET 6\+ (C\#), building RESTful APIs, Dependency Injection architectures, Entity Framework Core, and enterprise backend components. * 2\+ years of experience working with MongoDB, including schema design, aggregation pipelines, index tuning, and asynchronous drivers (Motor, PyMongo). * Strong Kubernetes experience, particularly around autoscaling (HPA, KEDA), resource allocation, containerization (Docker), and production deployment patterns. * Resilience and fault\-tolerance engineering: circuit breakers, retries with backoff and jitter, bulkheads, timeouts, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns. * Deployment portability experience: you understand how to write software that runs in environments you don't control and can adapt to restricted network egress and custom identity providers. * Strong observability instincts: structured logging, metrics, tracing (OpenTelemetry), and the discipline to make systems debuggable from the outside. * Excellent technical communication, with experience collaborating across distributed engineering teams. **Nice\-to\-have** ------------------ * Databricks experience: Familiarity with Databricks Connect, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, or MLflow integrations. * Experience with event\-driven architectures and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS EventBridge). * Experience deploying into enterprise customer environments with strict security/compliance constraints (customer\-managed identity, private networking, private endpoints). * Experience with dual\-paradigm data access patterns bridging SQL and NoSQL/Document databases. **About LakeFusion** -------------------- LakeFusion is the modern Master Data Management (MDM) company. Global enterprises across industries ranging from retail to manufacturing and financial services rely on the LakeFusion platform to unify, govern, and deliver trusted data entities such as customers, products, suppliers, and employees. Built natively on the Databricks Lakehouse, LakeFusion creates a single source of truth that powers analytics and AI. LakeFusion enables organizations worldwide to accelerate innovation with trusted and governed data.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Lakeview IT is passionate about delivering high\-quality products and services to our customers. Our technology operations team is committed to ensuring reliable, scalable, and high\-performing services for our clients. We're looking for a talented and motivated **Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)** to join our dynamic team and help us continue to build and maintain a world\-class infrastructure. As a **Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)**, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, reliability, and scalability of our production systems. You will work closely with development, engineering, infrastructure, and operations teams to design and implement solutions that improve system performance, reduce downtime, and automate repetitive tasks. The SRE role is a hybrid of systems engineering and operations engineering, where you’ll enhance operational processes, monitoring systems, and tooling to provide a seamless experience for our customers. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in system administration, network management, and a keen interest in implementing new technologies to improve overall operational efficiency. This is a fully remote position that offers a competitive salary range of $117,000 to $150,000, plus an annual bonus. You'll also receive our excellent benefits package, which includes medical coverage starting on day one and a company\-matched 401(k). Compensation may vary based on experience, location, and other job\-related factors. Responsibilities: * Monitor all systems and infrastructure for the highest level of availability and proactively identify and resolve incidents before they impact operations. * Respond to incidents and outages in a timely and effective manner and serve as backup Incident Manager during outages. * Collaborate with other teams and vendors to diagnose and resolve complex hardware, software, and application performance issues. * Document incident details and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence. * Build, tune, and maintain monitoring, alerting, and dashboards in New Relic across applications and infrastructure. * Ensure alerts are actionable by defining ownership, response steps, and thresholds, and reduce alert noise over time. * Support alert integrations that route into Jira Service Management so that alerts arrive as workable tickets. * Perform and monitor backup, restore, and data\-protection operations in Commvault, including job monitoring and failure remediation. * Validate recoverability through periodic restore testing, and report on backup health and coverage gaps. * Operate and support workloads in Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services, including compute, storage, networking, and identity services. * Perform routine maintenance tasks, including monitoring, patching, vulnerability remediation, and backups. * Optimize system performance and resource utilization on premises and in the cloud. * Develop and maintain automation scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to streamline repetitive tasks and system administration. * Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of IT processes, runbooks, configurations, and troubleshooting procedures. Qualifications: * Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python). * Knowledge of networking concepts and protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP). * Experience with virtualization technologies such as Azure VDI * Experience with IT service management frameworks. * Extensive expertise in the Windows operating system. * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Preferred Qualifications:* 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience in site reliability engineering, systems engineering, or production operations roles. * Strong understanding of IT infrastructure components, including servers, networks, and storage. * Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms, specifically Microsoft Azure and AWS. * Hands\-on experience with New Relic monitoring and alerting tools. * Working experience with Commvault enterprise backup and data protection Lakeview is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All aspects of consideration for employment and employment with the Company are governed on the basis of merit, competence, and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. *\#LI\-Remote*

jobs.description: ### **About Lantern** Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com. Lantern is a specialty care navigation company connecting more than 10 million members with the highest\-quality surgery, oncology, and infusion therapy providers. Our curated Network of Excellence delivers 55%\+ cost savings versus average health plan rates while maintaining a surgical complication rate below 1%. We were ranked \#3 on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2026 in healthcare. We are transforming from a technology\-enabled health services company into a Health AI company, where technology and AI sit at the forefront of everything we build. Engineering is a strategy maker, not an order taker. If you want your code to change how specialty care is delivered at scale, this is the team. We ship fast through automation and testing, never by cutting corners, because quality and reliability are non\-negotiable in healthcare. **Location:** Hybrid \- at least 3 days/wk in our Dallas, TX or Vancouver, BC Canada offices **What You Will Own** * Design, build, and operate full\-stack features end\-to\-end across React front ends and Python or .NET back\-end services. * Model and query relational data in PostgreSQL or SQL Server, with a focus on correctness, performance, and data quality. * Build and run services on Azure, provisioned and managed as code with Terraform. * Embed AI into the products you build, integrating LLM and AI capabilities into member and provider experiences and internal tooling. * Work with our data platform (Databricks) and engineering partners to treat data as a first\-class strategic asset with automated PHI governance. * Lead technical design and code reviews, and raise the quality bar through testing, observability, and CI/CD automation. * Break large problems into incremental deliverables, shipping a first useful increment within four weeks. * Partner directly with product, design, and clinical stakeholders as an equal owner of product decisions. * Uphold security and HIPAA/PHI obligations by design, building safe\-by\-default systems rather than treating security as a gate. **What You Bring** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production web applications. * Strong front\-end skills with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. * Strong back\-end skills in Python or .NET (C\#), including designing and consuming REST and event\-driven APIs. * Solid relational database experience with PostgreSQL or SQL Server, including schema design and query optimization. * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating workloads on Azure. * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with Terraform. * Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS). * Demonstrated AI curiosity and fluency: you use AI tools in your daily work and are eager to build AI\-powered features. * A track record of owning work end\-to\-end and delivering incrementally in a fast\-moving environment. **Strong Candidates Will Also Have** * Experience building AI or LLM\-powered product features in production. * Experience with data platforms such as Databricks, and with data pipelines feeding analytics or ML. * Experience in healthcare, or another regulated domain, handling sensitive data such as PHI under HIPAA. * Full comfort across both Python and .NET, and both PostgreSQL and SQL Server. * A habit of mentoring peers and elevating team standards without formal authority. **Benefits**: * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability * Life Insurance * 401k with company match * Flexible Paid Time Off * Paid Parental Leave **About You:** * You use **LOGIC** in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. You focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast\-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small \& big wins. * **INCLUSION** is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** We're building a talent\-dense, high\-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety\-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer\-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems. This is a high\-priority individual contributor role for an engineer who has built safety interventions within the development and deployment of frontier models and wants to apply that experience to scientific models, agents, tools and laboratory\-connected workflows. You will work with domain scientists, risk researchers, evaluators and engineering teams to turn risk findings and policy requirements into effective interventions. findings into concrete mitigation designs and testable requirements. * Develop and implement safeguards suited to the problem, potentially spanning model training, classifiers, monitoring, access controls and runtime interventions. * Build experiments that measure risk reduction, robustness and effects on legitimate scientific use, alongside practical performance constraints. * Use adversarial findings and observed failures to improve safeguards, working closely with automated\-safety and scientific evaluation researchers. * Work directly with model\-training, post\-training, inference and platform teams to integrate mitigations into model development, release evaluation and large\-scale serving systems, with appropriate instrumentation and reproducible testing. * Investigate regressions, distribution shifts and emerging misuse patterns, and use the evidence to guide further development. **What You'll Need to Succeed** * Hands\-on experience developing and validating safety interventions for frontier models within training, post\-training or large\-scale inference systems, with contributions to model development or release cycles. * Depth in at least one relevant area, such as safety post\-training, model\-level classifiers, safeguards integrated into inference, or abuse monitoring and enforcement across a model\-serving platform. * Experience working directly with model\-development or safeguards teams, using access appropriate to the intervention—such as training pipelines, model internals, inference infrastructure or systematic evaluation access—to investigate failures and implement improvements. * Strong research\-engineering skills and the ability to move from an ambiguous problem to working, maintainable implementations. * Sound experimental judgment, including an ability to assess robustness, interpret imperfect metrics and reason about competing objectives. * The ability to collaborate across research and engineering teams, explain technical trade\-offs and take ownership of complex individual contributions. **Bonus Points For** * Experience with scientific models, scientific software or laboratory\-connected systems. * Safety work involving tool\-using agents, multi\-step workflows or high\-consequence misuse. * Experience connecting expert\-generated evidence and policy requirements to training data, evaluation criteria or operational controls. **About LILA** Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. jobs.title: Staff / Principal Security Engineer, AI Safety and Security
jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** Lila is developing AI systems for scientific discovery, connecting advanced models with scientific tools and automated laboratories. As these systems become more capable, we need to understand how they could be misused or compromised, which protections matter most, and how to establish that those protections work together. We're hiring an experienced security practitioner to lead this work at the boundary between AI safety and security. You will investigate real systems, develop threat models, test important assumptions and recommend the protections needed for particular capabilities and deployments. Your work will address both dangerous misuse and the protection of sensitive models, data and research. This is an opportunity to help shape a developing area of AI safety through security practice. You will combine technical investigation with careful analysis and clear writing, working closely with our established Security team, researchers and engineers to turn findings into implemented improvements. You will bring security depth and develop your understanding of model capabilities, evaluations and safeguards through that work. Prior experience in AI safety is welcome, but not required. **What You'll Be Building** * **Threat\-model consequential systems and capabilities.** Investigate how dangerous misuse or compromise could occur across models, deployed services and scientific workflows. Identify the relevant actors, access routes and failure paths, and the protections that could interrupt them. * **Test the assumptions behind our defenses.** Examine architectures, code, configurations and operational evidence. Run focused adversarial tests, build prototypes and investigate weaknesses, including situations where several protections depend on the same underlying system. * **Shape the protections needed for safe deployment.** Turn dangerous\-capability assessments into concrete security requirements. Assess how compromise of models, sensitive assets or supporting systems changes the safety assessment, drawing on personnel, physical and other security specialists where relevant. * **Make evidence\-based recommendations.** Define what evidence would demonstrate that important controls and safeguards work together. Combine findings from model evaluations and security testing, explain the remaining uncertainty, and recommend improvements or conditions for use. * **Carry findings through to practical improvements.** Work with Security, Safety and engineering owners to prioritize changes, specify acceptance criteria and verify the results. Make clear recommendations about which gaps require attention first and why. * **Anticipate what more capable systems will require.** Identify where changes in capability, access or deployment call for stronger protections. Help teams plan security work with long lead times, and update assessments as systems change or new evidence emerges. * **Develop methods that others can use.** Turn your investigations into clear threat models, assessment methods and technical guidance. Help Safety and Security colleagues apply the approach to new problems and build a shared understanding of the evidence behind decisions. **What You'll Need to Succeed** * **Substantial hands\-on security experience and deep expertise in at least one relevant discipline**, such as security architecture, application or infrastructure security, offensive security, or incident response. You can reason across disciplines and identify when specialist judgment is needed. * **A record of resolving consequential security problems.** You have investigated ambiguous risks, challenged designs and followed improvements through to validation, including work involving several teams. * **Strong technical judgment.** You can examine unfamiliar systems, scrutinize code and configurations where relevant, and use technical investigation or testing to distinguish plausible claims from demonstrated protection. * **Curiosity about AI safety and scientific systems.** You want to understand how model capabilities and safeguards are evaluated, can learn unfamiliar domains quickly, and reason carefully when evidence is incomplete. * **Clear writing and effective collaboration.** You can explain a technical argument precisely, work through disagreements with specialists and turn a complex investigation into an actionable recommendation. **Bonus Points For** * Securing ML infrastructure, model assets, research environments or AI agents. * Evaluating safeguards, adversarial robustness or defenses against sophisticated threats. * Translating risk assessments into technical requirements, assurance evidence or deployment decisions. * Working in scientific or other environments where digital access can have significant real\-world consequences. We value demonstrated security depth, sound judgment and the ability to learn. A research PhD or experience in every security discipline is not required. Your early work will help establish how Lila combines safety and security evidence to make concrete decisions about its systems. **About LILA** Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. Leverages factory data to develop statistical process control approaches and integrates reporting and data analytics solutions for continuous improvement. Provides input to product design regarding design concepts and specification requirements to best utilize equipment and manufacturing techniques. Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice. **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * STEM Degree (Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering preferred) * Military aircraft assembly experience (fighters preferred) * 5\+ years floor support experience in a production engineering, quality engineering, production operations, or project engineering role * Root Cause and Corrective Action experience * Demonstrated ability to drive build and production issues to closure **Desired Skills** ------------------ * Experience and understanding of standard tools for fastener installation * Electrical harness routing and installation experience * Composites structure experience * Team facilitation skills and effective use of Lean Six Sigma tools; Green or Black Belt certification is a plus * Manufacturing Readiness Level (MRL) knowledge/experience * Determinant assembly build experience * Fuel systems experience * Tank sealing experience **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $85300\.00 \- $158300\.00 At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer. **Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10\), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability, and Long\-Term Disability. * Annual short\-term and/or long\-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics. * For (Washington state applicants only) Non\-represented full\-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6\.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

jobs.title: Senior Technology Project Manager – Banking Systems
jobs.description: Luminate Bank is redefining what modern banking can be. In just five years under its current leadership, the company has grown from a $62 million community bank into a $500 million financial institution, the fastest\-growing state\-chartered bank, while building one of the fastest\-growing mortgage platforms in the country. The momentum has been extraordinary: * Grew bank assets from $62 million to $500 million in five years\- the fastest\-growing state\-chartered bank * Ranked a 2026 Top Workplace in Minnesota by the Star Tribune and \#1 among large companies in Colorado Top Workplaces 2026 * Named a 2026 Top Workplaces Culture Excellence winner in eight categories and a Top Workplace nationally in Financial Services * Surpassed $4 billion in mortgage originations in 2025 * Ranked among the Top 30 Mortgage Lenders nationally by Scotsman Guide * Maintain a 4\.9\-star average rating across 45,000\+ customer reviews * Recognized by Freddie Mac with two 2026 Home Possible RISE Awards® for Greatest Volume and Fastest Growth * Honored by the Minnesota Mortgage Association as 2025 Leaders of the Year But the story is bigger than growth metrics and awards. Luminate Bank is building a culture designed for ambitious, high\-performing people who want to shape the future of banking. We move quickly, think boldly, and invest deeply in our people. Innovation, accountability, collaboration, and customer experience are at the center of everything we do. What began as a rapidly growing lending and banking platform is now entering its next phase: building a nationally recognized financial brand that redefines how modern banking is experienced. For leaders who want the opportunity to build, scale, and leave a lasting impact, this is a rare moment to join a company with startup energy, national momentum, and a long runway ahead. **POSITION OVERVIEW** Luminate Bank is building a technology team that moves fast and delivers. We are looking for a Senior Technology Project Manager who owns our bank technology projects from idea to go\-live. You will set the plan, assign the work, lead our core and digital banking vendors, and make sure projects finish on time and in scope. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will translate business needs into clear requirements for Jack Henry and our other core banking system providers, recommend the right technical solution, and partner with our development team when a gap calls for a proprietary application or AI agent built on vendor APIs. **RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES** **Own and Run Projects** * Lead bank technology projects end to end: intake, scoping, planning, execution, testing, go\-live and post\-launch review. * Build and maintain project plans with tasks, owners, dates and dependencies; assign work across business, technology and vendor teams. * Run kickoffs, working sessions and status meetings; publish clear weekly status, risks and decisions. * Hold stakeholders and vendors to their commitments; escalate early, with a recommended path forward, when dates or quality are at risk. * Manage several projects at once and keep them moving; no project stalls without a plan to unblock it. **Control Scope and Deliver Quickly** * Define scope, success criteria and out\-of\-scope items up front and get business sign\-off before work begins. * Run a formal change\-request process; assess the impact of new asks on time, cost and risk before accepting them. * Break large initiatives into phased deliveries that put value in users’ hands sooner. **Lead Vendor Implementations** * Manage implementations, upgrades and conversions with Jack Henry and other core, digital banking, payments and fintech providers. * Review SOWs and project plans with Vendor Management; own the bank\-side plan and hold vendors to theirs. * Coordinate testing (UAT), cutover planning, training and go\-live readiness. **Business Analysis \& Technical Recommendations** * Lead discovery with business owners; document current\- and future\-state processes and requirements. * Write clear functional and technical requirements for vendors, and translate vendor responses back for the business. * Evaluate options (configure, buy, or build) and recommend solutions with trade\-offs, cost and risk. * Work with the Engineering team on integrations, proprietary applications and AI agents that use vendor APIs; define requirements, acceptance criteria and priorities, while Engineering builds. **Bring Order and Improve How We Work** * Organize business stakeholders: clarify roles, decision owners and deadlines for every project. * Follow and help improve our SDLC, documentation standards, change management, release planning, intake and capacity planning. * Keep project documentation, requirements and decisions current and audit\-ready. * Identify and champion AI\-enabled tools that speed up requirements, ticket writing and project management. * Provide hands\-on coordination during high\-priority incidents or critical release events affecting bank systems. **QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS** **Required Experience** * 5\+ years of project management in banking or financial services technology, including leading third\-party vendor implementations to go\-live. * Hands\-on experience with core banking systems; Jack Henry (SilverLake) and MANTL strongly preferred. * Working knowledge of bank operations and products: deposits, lending, payments, digital banking, and related compliance (e.g., BSA/AML, Reg E, vendor risk). * Proven record of setting scope, preventing scope creep and delivering on schedule. * Strong business analysis skills: discovery, process mapping, requirements and UAT. * Enough technical fluency to discuss APIs, integrations, data flows and system configuration with vendors and engineers. * Confident, proactive leader who assigns work, follows up and holds peers, business leaders and vendors accountable. * Clear written and verbal communication with executives, business users and technical teams. **Preferred Experience** * Experience with core conversions, digital banking or LOS implementations. * Experience with Agile delivery and tools such as Azure DevOps, SharePoint, Jira or GitHub Projects. * Exposure to data platforms, automation or AI agent use cases in banking. **What Success Looks Like** * **First 30 days:** Knows our core systems, vendors and project portfolio; has an inventory of active projects with owners and status. * **First 90 days:** Every active project has a signed\-off scope, a working plan and a weekly status rhythm; at least one stalled project is back on track. * **First 6 months:** Has delivered at least 1\-2 vendor implementations or enhancements on time and in scope; the business sees a predictable, organized intake and delivery process. **EDUCATION** * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field preferred. * Equivalent professional experience in banking technology or technology project leadership will be considered. * PMP, PMI\-ACP, CBAP, or equivalent certification is a plus. **BENEFITS** * Competitive compensation commensurate with experience and demonstrated ability * Excellent benefits package including health insurance with pre\-tax HSA and FSA accounts, dental, and vision * Life and AD\&D Insurance, plus additional voluntary benefit options * 401(k) with robust company match * Flexible PTO program * Earned Sick \& Safe Time (ESST) * The opportunity to be a driving force behind technology transformation at the Midwest’s fastest\-growing lender

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description: At Moxie, we empower ambitious aesthetic entrepreneurs to build profitable, independent practices—without burnout, overwhelm, or guesswork. In just a few years, we've grown from an idea to a global, remote\-first team now supporting 700\+ practices nationwide. Our purpose is simple: to unlock sustainable success for aesthetic entrepreneurs, at every stage of their journey. **Director of Engineering (MGR\-5\)** ------------------------------------- We're looking for a Director of Engineering to become the day\-to\-day leader of Moxie's Engineering organization. You'll own delivery, organizational health, manager development, staffing, and engineering operating strategy for roughly 60 engineers, and you'll lead our AI strategy and execution across both the product and the software development lifecycle. Engineering is Moxie's largest organization, and this hire is how it gets a leader with the time and technical depth to take it to the next level. You'll partner daily with the Head of Engineering and with Product leadership through the Product and Engineering operating cadence.. You'll inherit a productive, fast\-moving engineering organization at an exciting inflection point, with the opportunity to further mature our engineering practices and help shape our transition toward AI\-powered software development. **Our Objectives for the Role** ------------------------------- * **Become the clear leader of Engineering.** Within three months all seven EMs report to you with a working management cadence, you run the Engineering side of the Product and Engineering operating cadence, and you are the first escalation point for cross\-team delivery, staffing, and execution issues. By month six you own delivery end to end and routine issues resolve without the Head of Engineering. * **Mature existing measures and drive improvement.** Within three months, you build on and refine existing measures of Engineering performance and health (Linear, DORA, and reliability metrics) and implement 2–3 concrete operating improvements. By month six, those KPIs are reviewed regularly and drive action across teams, with measurable gains in delivery predictability, cycle time, or reliability. * **Make AI a source of leverage.** Assess current AI usage across the product and SDLC in your first quarter, drive at least one AI or agentic initiative into production use by month six, and by month nine embed AI\-assisted development in the Engineering operating model while holding production AI to clear standards for architecture, security, cost, and reliability . * **Set an opinionated technical roadmap.** By month nine Engineering ships meaningfully more customer and technical value per engineer, with capacity deliberately allocated across product delivery, architecture, platform investment, reliability, developer productivity, and technical debt, and aligned with Product and company priorities. **We're Looking For** --------------------- * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years in engineering leadership and at least 3 years leading managers and technical leaders. * **Management depth.** You've run a 30\-60 person engineering organization through multiple Engineering Managers, ideally at a Series B\-D product company, and you set a consistent management bar, develop and coach EMs, and handle performance, staffing, and org design decisions directly, including through a reduction in agency reliance. * **Operating rigor.** You've built KPI systems (DORA, cycle time, reliability) that teams actually use to change behavior, and you can partner with Product leaders to surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early. * **Proven experience building production AI and agentic systems.** You've shipped AI in a product or SDLC with real standards for evals, observability, security, and cost, and you can explain the ROI impact of the work in detail. * **Technical judgment.** You’re very comfortable with system design, software design patterns , and engineering processes \& principles (agile, scrum, SRE, devops, etc). You’re comfortable reviewing and designing architecture, and in making capacity tradeoffs between feature delivery and platform investment, and know how to build relationships and earn the trust of your senior engineers and EMs. * **Comfort with real delegation and real authority.** You have experience in building and shaping engineering organizations, from hiring strategy and people management to maturing the SDLC and org design. You’ve worked closely with founders and senior technical leaders, and also know how to bring the best out of engineering managers and staff engineers in your org. Health tech or vertical SaaS experience is a plus. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage purely through other leaders at arm's length from the technical work; you'll stay close enough to the architecture and the AI roadmap to guide them. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * A true Engineering leadership seat at a Series C healthcare technology company, with an organization of roughly 60 engineers and meaningful ownership over delivery, org design, talent, technical execution, and strategy. * AI is a core part of the mandate. You'll have the mandate and the support to make AI a material source of leverage across both Moxie Suite and how we build it. * Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, Med Spas will remain the opportunity for independent owner\-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us. * We have much left to build. But given the market feedback we're getting and our founding team's company\-building experience, we think we are writing the next great chapter of a real success story. * Competitive salary and stock, and generous health, dental, and vision coverage. At Moxie, we believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, trusted, and included. Our team lives by our values: **act as owners, give more than we take, move with speed and care, and simplify and learn every day.** We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. If you require any accommodations to fully participate in the interview process, please let us know, we’re happy to assist. Compensation Range: $207K \- $253K

jobs.title: Founding Computational Geometry & CAD Engineer
jobs.description: About Makeable Every human is creative. But turning an idea into a physical product still means finding engineers, designers, coders and suppliers. We believe creating products should not be limited to people with technical skills. Makeable is building a platform that helps everyday people turn an idea into a usable physical hardware product, without needing an engineering team. We are bringing together 3D design, tested compatible electronics, generated software and clear assembly guidance. Our long\-term vision is for people to make, share and eventually sell products created from their own ideas and experiences. We have raised a $1M pre\-seed round from Afore Capital. The Challenge AI can generate impressive 3D shapes, but those shapes aren't necessarily ready to manufacture. A generated enclosure might look perfect but have incorrect internal dimensions, insufficient space for electronics, missing openings or geometry that cannot be 3D printed. We want to solve this programmatically. What You'll Build * Develop algorithms to analyze, manipulate and refine AI\-generated 3D meshes and CAD models. * Build geometry post\-processing systems that enforce dimensional and manufacturing constraints. * Automatically create internal cavities, component mounting points, port cutouts, screw holes and structural features. * Detect collisions, invalid geometry, insufficient clearance and other physical design problems. * Build procedural and parametric CAD generation workflows. * Develop automated geometry validation and mesh repair pipelines. * Work closely with our AI engineers to connect generative 3D models with precise, manufacturable geometry. What We're Looking For * Current undergraduate or recent bachelor's graduate in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field. * Strong Python or C\+\+ programming skills. * Experience writing software that creates, manipulates or analyzes 3D geometry. * Understanding of mesh processing, geometric transformations, Boolean operations or parametric CAD. * Experience with one or more relevant tools such as Open CASCADE, CadQuery, build123d, Trimesh, Open3D, CGAL or Blender Python. * Strong problem\-solving ability and willingness to experiment with challenging technical problems. Bonus Points * Experience building CAD plugins, procedural modelling systems or geometry\-processing libraries. * Familiarity with 3D printing, mechanical tolerances or electronics enclosure design. * Experience in robotics, computer graphics, computational design or generative 3D. * Research or open\-source contributions involving computational geometry. What Would Impress Us We'd love to see a GitHub project or technical demonstration where you've built something that automatically manipulates 3D geometry. Examples include automatic enclosure generation, mesh repair, geometric constraint checking, CAD scripting, procedural modelling, collision detection or component\-fitting algorithms. We care far more about what you've built than your university, GPA or previous company names. Who Should Apply Undergraduate students, final\-year students and recent bachelor's graduates. You do not need a master's degree, PhD, prior full\-time experience or prior startup experience. Candidates from Singapore and U.S. universities are especially encouraged to apply. You'll work directly with our founding team on core technology that could make creating physical products as easy as writing a prompt. You will collaborate with our generative\-design researcher, who joins in January. Timing and location Paid, full\-time internship starting November 2026 for approximately 12 weeks. Pay is USD 19\.61–20\.20 per hour, based on 40 hours per week. Visa support is considered individually. San Francisco preferred; exceptional remote candidates based in the United States or Singapore considered. Tell us your earliest start date and weekly availability. Any continuation beyond the internship will be discussed separately. How to apply Apply through this Indeed listing. State that you are applying for Computational Geometry \& CAD Engineering and include your strongest relevant GitHub project or demo, your personal contribution, location, earliest start date and ability to commit for approximately 12 weeks. Existing projects are welcome; no new unpaid project is required to apply. Pay: $19\.61 \- $20\.20 per hour People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94107

jobs.description: Job Description For over 130 years, we have pioneered groundbreaking science. Today, we are driven by continuous innovation to develop breakthrough medicines, vaccines and technology. Rooted in direct experience on the farm and in the clinic, we work hand in hand with our customers every step of the way. Our singular focus is to empower those who care for animals, helping them manage their vital responsibility with confidence. Because when it comes to animal health, no one sees it like we do. Specialist, Bioprocess Engineer Join Us in Shaping the Future of Animal Health As a BioTechnology Solutions (BTS) Specialist and manufacturing process engineer, you will be part of a world\-class team within Animal Health, contributing directly to the production of veterinary products that improve animal health and welfare globally. The Specialist in the BTS Americas Strategic Projects team supports regional vaccine manufacturing technology assessments, transfers and associated technical activities. This individual contributor partners with Manufacturing, Quality, Process Development, Regulatory Affairs, Production Planning, Global Engineering Solutions and other stakeholders to help ensure compliant, efficient transfer execution and stable process performance at receiving sites. The role contributes to knowledge management implementation in the region, supports technical risk assessments and mitigation actions, and assists with post\-transfer monitoring and continuous improvement. The Specialist may support onboarding/training activities and will escalate complex issues to senior team members as appropriate. Key Responsibilities * Support vaccine technology transfers by preparing technical inputs and documentation, coordinating readiness activities, and assisting during execution and start\-up at receiving sites. * Contribute to technical risk assessments and mitigation by gathering data, supporting fit\-gap evaluations, and helping implement agreed action plans prior to transfer runs. * Support cross\-functional technical workstreams/projects that enable transfer success and improve process performance, escalating risks/issues when needed. * Support regional knowledge management implementation for assigned processes by maintaining transfer packages, playbooks, lessons learned, and best practices; coordinate updates and promote consistent adoption across sites. * Assist with post\-transfer process robustness through monitoring/trending, troubleshooting support, and participation in investigations and continuous improvement in partnership with sites and Quality. * Contribute to training and onboarding by maintaining training materials and delivering selected training modules, as assigned. * Deliver compliant technical documentation and communication by drafting/reviewing protocols, reports, summaries, and trackers aligned with quality, regulatory, and internal governance expectations. **Job Requirements:** Education (Minimum) * Bachelor’s degree in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, or related life science/engineering field. Required Experience and Skills * Minimum of 2 years experience in biopharmaceutical, antigen, or vaccine manufacturing, bioprocess engineering, process development, or technology transfer. * Working knowledge of upstream, downstream, fill\-finish and lyophilization bioprocessing operations and fundamentals of process parameters definition and control strategies. * Experience working in a regulated (GxP) environment with strong attention to documentation and data integrity. * Demonstrated ability to support technical problem solving, investigations, and basic risk management tools (e.g., FMEA or similar). * Strong collaboration skills in cross\-functional teams; ability to communicate clearly and escalate effectively. * Continuous improvement mindset with good organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities. jobs.title: Manager, People Analytics & Data Science
jobs.description: Overview: **Position Summary:** --------------------- Mercury is building a connected, trusted people analytics capability that puts decision\-ready data and insights in the hands of leaders when and where they need them. The Manager, People Analytics \& Data Science will help build that capability from the data foundation through the leader experience. This role will build reliable data pipelines and analytical datasets, establish trusted metric definitions, and deliver robust dashboards that enable self\-service people data for Mercury leaders. The role will also conduct targeted research and advanced analysis—including predictive and AI\-enabled methods where appropriate—to surface new insights on workforce risks, capacity, performance, productivity, and other priorities. The successful candidate will combine technical depth with strong business judgment. They will be able to move from a business question to a data model, from a data model to a clear dashboard, and from an observed pattern to a well\-supported recommendation. This is a builder role for someone who wants to make people data easier to trust, easier to use, and more useful in the flow of business decisions. Geo\-Salary Information: ***An in\-person interview may be required during the hiring process*** State specific pay scales for this role are as follows: $128,136 to $252,194 (NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA) $116,487 to $229,267 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME) $104,839 to $206,340 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV) In CA: Typical hiring range is $171,148 to $209,181 The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location. Responsibilities: **Data foundation and analytics engineering** --------------------------------------------- * Partner with data engineers to design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines and analytical datasets that bring together people, organizational, operational, and business data from relevant sources. * Develop reusable data models, transformations, validation checks, documentation, and monitoring that support accurate and repeatable analysis. * Partner with HR Tech, Enterprise Data Science, Data \& Analytics, Finance, and other technical teams on source systems, data architecture, integrations, access, and data quality. * Translate business and People questions into clear data requirements, grains, dimensions, logic, refresh expectations, and ownership. * Establish and maintain metric contracts that document definitions, calculation logic, sources, refresh cadence, interpretation, stewardship, and action path. * Improve the reliability, transparency, privacy, and usability of people data as Mercury evolves its HRIS and broader data ecosystem. **Dashboards and self\-service people data** -------------------------------------------- * Own the end\-to\-end delivery of leader\-facing people data products, from discovery and prioritization through launch, adoption, and iteration. * Build robust operational and executive dashboards that connect people metrics to business and workforce outcomes. * Deliver focused dashboard experiences that help leaders answer what changed, what may be contributing, and what action to take next. * Design for self\-service by developing intuitive personas, access patterns, definitions, documentation, enablement, and feedback loops. * Embed relevant people insights into existing executive reporting and operating rhythms wherever possible rather than creating disconnected destinations. * Measure usage, trust, decision relevance, and adoption; use feedback and evidence to expand, refine, or retire products. **Research, advanced analytics, and predictive insight** -------------------------------------------------------- * Conduct targeted research and analysis on prioritized questions such as attrition risk, critical\-role readiness, capacity constraints, workforce planning, manager effectiveness, performance, productivity, and AI\-enabled work. * Apply exploratory analysis, statistical methods, experimentation, forecasting, segmentation, and predictive modeling as appropriate to the question and data quality. * Translate complex analysis into clear findings, limitations, implications, and recommendations for People and business leaders. * Design analyses with appropriate validation, explainability, privacy protections, and bias\-awareness; treat models as decision support, not a substitute for accountable human judgment. * Develop repeatable approaches for research intake, hypothesis formation, analysis, peer review, storytelling, and follow\-through. * Partner with stakeholders to connect analytical findings to decisions, interventions, and measures of impact. **Partnership and capability building** --------------------------------------- * Build trusted relationships with People leaders, business leaders, ce applying statistical analysis, experimentation, forecasting, segmentation, or predictive modeling to complex business questions. * Demonstrated ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to senior leaders and non\-technical audiences. * Strong hands\-on skills with SQL and Python or R, plus experience with modern data pipelines, transformation, testing, and analytical workflows. * Experience with data modeling, semantic layers, BI tools, cloud data platforms, version control, and production\-quality documentation. * Strong foundation in statistics, experimental design, causal reasoning, predictive modeling, and model evaluation. **Knowledge and Skills:** ------------------------- * Able to distinguish between a reporting need, a diagnostic question, and a research or modeling question—and choose an appropriately rigorous solution. * Product\-minded and user\-centered: starts with the decision and designs the data experience around the user. * Strong storyteller who can make complex analysis clear, precise, and actionable without overstating certainty. * Highly collaborative, curious, pragmatic, and comfortable working across business and technical teams. * Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential, sensitive, or personally identifiable People data. * Comfortable using AI and collaboration tools to improve productivity while applying responsible\-use principles. * Able to build in ambiguity, establish standards without over\-engineering, and continuously improve the quality of the work. About the Company: ***Why choose a career at Mercury?*** At Mercury, we have been guided by our purpose to help people reduce risk and overcome unexpected events for more than 60 years. We are one team with a common goal to help others. Everyone needs insurance and we can’t imagine a world without it. Our team will encourage you to grow, make time to have fun, and work together to make great things happen. We embrace the strengths and values of each team member. We believe in having diverse perspectives where everyone is included, to serve customers from all walks of life. We care about our people, and we mean it. We reward our talented professionals with a competitive salary, bonus potential, and a variety of benefits to help our team members reach their health, retirement, and professional goals. Learn more about us here: https://www.mercuryinsurance.com/about/careers \#LI\-NW1 Perks and Benefits: ***We offer many great benefits, including:**** Competitive compensation * Flexibility to work from anywhere in the United States for most positions * Paid time off (vacation time, sick time, 9 paid Company holidays, volunteer hours) * Incentive bonus programs (potential for holiday bonus, referral bonus, and performance\-based bonus) * Medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance * 401 (k) retirement savings plan with company match * Engaging work environment * Promotional opportunities * Education assistance * Professional and personal development opportunities * Company recognition program * Health and wellbeing resources, including free mental wellbeing therapy/coaching sessions, child and eldercare resources, and more Mercury Insurance is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Mercury is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities who need assistance with the application and/or employment consideration process. If you require an accommodation, you may contact us by sending an e\-mail to recruiting@mercuryinsurance.com. Please include your name, contact information, and a description of your requested accommodation in your message. Pay Range: USD $128,136\.00 \- USD $252,194\.00 /Yr.

jobs.description: Meta is looking for an experienced Business Support Engineer to play a pivotal role in shaping the technical support experience for Meta's advertising partners, customers, and clients globally. In this role, you will lead the engineering strategy for partner integrations across Meta's Ads products, working directly with Platform and Infrastructure teams to investigate and resolve complex partner issues. You will drive systemic improvements to support frameworks, influence product roadmaps through data\-driven insights, and set the technical direction for a global team of Business Support Engineers specializing in Meta's AdTech ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in API integrations, cloud infrastructure, and AI\-native tooling to proactively identify and eliminate root causes of partner\-impacting issues at scale. ### excellence of the Business Support Engineering organization * Lead the team's AI\-native technical strategy, driving large\-scale adoption of AI and LLM\-based tools to transform partner support support automation use cases * Define and implement performance monitoring systems for partner integrations across Meta's Ads and Business Messaging platforms, leveraging metrics to proactively surface and resolve systemic issues * Partner with cross\-functional leadership across Product, Infrastructure, and Partnership teams to identify root causes of recurring partner issues and influence product roadmaps with data\-driven proposals * Establish technical communication standards for the team, including authoring reference architectures, integration guides, and representing the engineering organization in partner\-facing and internal executive forums * Lead zero\-to\-one initiatives that anticipate future platform needs, designing scalable support infrastructure for new Meta business product launches and partner integration patterns * Provide oncall support coverage via rotation schedule to ensure high availability and rapid response for partner\-impacting incidents across global time zones * Mentor and develop other engineers on the team, setting technical direction and fostering an environment of continuous learning in AI, ML, and AdTech domains * Manage complex, cross\-functional programs spanning multiple business areas, driving alignment across regional offices and partnership teams to deliver consistent partner experiences globally ### **Minimum jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Overview** Every time someone uses Azure OpenAI Service, their request needs to reach the right graphics processing unit (GPU), in the right region, at the right moment. Our team makes that happen. We build the platform that decides how AI traffic flows across Microsoft's global infrastructure, so services like Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Copilot stay fast and reliable. You'll join a supportive, connected team that keeps these experiences fair and dependable for every customer while making the most of every GPU we run. As a Principal Software Engineer, AI Infrastructure on our team, you'll guide how AI requests are routed, prioritized, and matched to available computing capacity around the world. You'll shape the design of large distributed systems, work closely with partner teams across Microsoft and OpenAI, and help the engineers around you grow. This opportunity will allow you to influence the design of one of the largest AI platforms in the world, deepen your knowledge of large\-scale optimization and efficiency, and grow as a trusted technical leader across many teams. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** * Design \- Own the overall design of how AI traffic and computing capacity are managed across regions. Guide design reviews and help the team weigh speed, reliability, scale, and cost when making choices. * Coding \- Write and review clear, secure, well\-tested code for routing, prioritization, and capacity planning. Set coding practices that other teams can reuse. * Implement \- Work with product and program managers to turn the long\-term vision into a dependable, step\-by\-step roadmap. Use feature flags and gradual rollouts to test changes safely, measure their impact, and roll back quickly when needed. * Reliability and Supportability \- Take part in the on\-call rotation as a designated responsible individual (DRI) for critical AI services. Lead reviews after incidents and improve monitoring so issues are caught early and happen less often. * Understand User Requirements \- Partner with product, research, and infrastructure teams to understand what customers need as new AI models and capabilities launch. jobs.title: Data Engineer

jobs.title: Senior Motion Planning Engineer - Safety-Layer
jobs.description: **Mission Summary:** The Safety\-Layer Team is responsible for ensuring the Motional Autonomous Vehicle executes appropriate dynamic trajectories in both nominal and safety\-critical scenarios. This team focuses on refining upstream motion plans to guarantee compliance with safety\-driven requirements, executing highly dynamic evasive maneuvers at the AV's physical limits, and implementing system\-wide safety overrides. The team pursues these goals through a process of rigorous algorithmic design, implementation, validation, analysis in simulation, and comprehensive closed\-course and public road evaluation. As the team's responsibilities are growing to support more complex scenarios and the scaling of Motional's deployment area, we are looking for a Senior Motion Planning \- Safety\-Layer to help build a robust motion planning safety\-layer. You will work on enabling cutting\-edge capabilities for Motional's AV, including algorithm design and documentation, software development, metrics definition, simulation implementation and evaluation, and in\-vehicle testing. As part of this role, you will maintain cross\-functional relationships across the organization to help understand and communicate the impacts of their work on overall AV performance. **What you will work on:** * Design, implement, and test algorithms for synthesizing trajectories and selecting trajectories across asynchronous generation sources to ensure AV behaviors adhere to safety\-critical requirement specifications. * Develop evasive maneuver planning algorithms in conjunction with low\-level control systems to safely use the full actuation capacity of Motional's AV for collision avoidance. * Evaluate the role of multiple perception sensor modalities in refining the safety\-layer's identification of safety\-critical scenarios. * Construct test/analysis tooling for isolated and system\-level evaluation of safety\-layer components and processes, select test parameters, and analyze test results. * Utilize, validate, and improve dynamic simulation environments to accelerate the design and analysis of safety\-critical motion planning algorithms, including validating simulation models against real\-world data. * Define and implement performance, comfort, and safety metrics for motion planning and safety systems, and perform quantitative analysis of fleet\-wide vehicle data to validate design improvements and identify key areas of improvement. * Build a system\-wide understanding of Motional's autonomy stack components by supporting root\-cause analysis of simulation, closed\-course, and public road events from a motion planning and safety perspective. * Travel for in\-person vehicle testing at Motional's and our partner's deployment and test track locations, typically once every 4 to 6 months. **Desired Background:** * MS, PhD preferred, in one of Control Theory / Robotics / Computer Science / Applied Math or a related field * 3\+ years of experience developing motion planning and collision avoidance related algorithms and components in an industrial setting, preferably the AV industry * Strong background in modern C\+\+ programming (C\+\+17, C\+\+20\), with an emphasis on developing high\-performance and reliable systems * Experienced with concepts from motion planning including trajectory generation through numerical optimization and sampling\-based approaches, cost and heuristic\-based methods for trajectory selection, multi\-modal prediction models, geometric and physics\-based collision detection, time\-series data processing, and data visualization * Familiarity with dynamic collision modeling, convex set processing, state machine logic, and multi\-rate decision\-making processes * Familiarity with agentic\-based development tooling * Familiarity with Linux\-based operating systems **Bonus Points:** * General familiarity with machine learning, including supervised learning, reinforcement learning, training/test validation, etc. * Familiarity with vehicle dynamics modeling, including standard longitudinal/lateral vehicle dynamics models * Publications in Robotics/Controls or Autonomous Driving conferences/journals (IROS, ICRA, CoRL, RAL, TRO, CDC, ACC, TAC, CSL, Automatica, IV, ITSC, T\-ITS) * Familiarity with SQL\-based queries * Familiarity with Python * Familiarity with Gitlab, Bazel, VSCode / CLion * Familiarity with AV industry simulation tooling \#LI\-BP1 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube. *Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. jobs.description: **About ProjectorScreen.com** ProjectorScreen.com is a specialty ecommerce retailer of projectors, projection screens, and home theater products. Customers rely on us for expert guidance and an online shopping experience that helps them choose the right equipment. **The role** We're looking for an in\-house Shopify Developer \& Administrator to own the technical operation and ongoing improvement of our Shopify store. This is a hands\-on technical role combining storefront development, custom app development, store administration, database work, and ownership of our app ecosystem. You'll work directly with the owner, our Ecommerce \& Marketing Manager, sales and operations teams, and outside developers. You'll turn business needs into reliable functionality, troubleshoot problems, and make the store easier to operate. Marketing will set campaign and merchandising priorities; you'll build and maintain the technology supporting them. **What you'll own** * **Shopify development:** Develop and maintain themes, templates, sections, and custom storefront features using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Improve product pages, collections, navigation, mobile usability, and the buying experience. * **Custom apps:** Build, deploy, and maintain custom Shopify applications and integrations. Own frontend and backend functionality, authentication, data storage, testing, monitoring, and ongoing support. * **Store administration:** Manage technical configuration for products, variants, collections, metafields, metaobjects, navigation, permissions, and store settings. Support bulk imports, catalog updates, promotions, and data quality. * **App ecosystem management:** Own the inventory, configuration, costs, permissions, and dependencies of our installed apps. Evaluate new tools, resolve conflicts, manage vendor support, and recommend when to configure an existing app, replace it, or build custom functionality. * **Search and merchandising technology:** Support the technical setup and operation of Searchspring and other search, filtering, recommendation, review, and merchandising tools. Work with marketing to implement and test the desired shopping experience. * **Integrations and automation:** Connect Shopify with HubSpot, product feeds, marketplaces, inventory, order, and fulfillment systems. Use APIs, webhooks, Shopify Flow, and other appropriate tools to reduce manual work and improve accuracy. * **Database development and administration:** Design and maintain databases supporting custom apps and integrations. Write and optimize SQL queries, manage schemas and migrations, configure access, and maintain backups and recovery procedures. * **Troubleshooting and reliability:** Diagnose storefront errors, app conflicts, slow pages, broken links, feed issues, and synchronization failures. Build useful logging, alerts, error handling, and recovery processes into custom systems. * **Testing and releases:** Use Git, development environments, and appropriate testing to release changes carefully. Maintain rollback procedures and document how the store, apps, and integrations work. * **Marketing support:** Build landing pages and promotional functionality, support tracking and technical SEO, and test the store ahead of major launches and shopping events. **Technical expertise required** * Demonstrated experience developing and administering a production Shopify store. * Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Liquid, and Shopify theme development. * Experience personally building and maintaining a custom Shopify app or substantial integration in production. * Backend development experience with Node.js/TypeScript or a comparable stack, including server\-side logic, authentication, and background processing. * Strong SQL and relational database skills, including schema design, query optimization, migrations, permissions, backups, and recovery. * Experience with GraphQL, REST APIs, webhooks, and reliable data synchronization, including retries and duplicate\-event handling. * Ability to deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and support the custom applications you build. * Experience managing third\-party apps and evaluating their effects on performance, data, cost, and operations. * Sound practices for protecting customer data, credentials, and application access. * Ability to explain technical choices clearly, prioritize by business impact, and follow projects through to completion. * Ability to work full\-time, in person in Riverdale, NJ 07457\. Experience should include writing and maintaining production code, as well as operating the store. A degree is not required. **Practical AI skills** Use Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable tools to improve development, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, and data workflows. You must understand, review, and test AI\-generated code before release. Be prepared to demonstrate a workflow you use, explain its limitations, and show how you verify its results. **Additional experience we value** * Searchspring, HubSpot integrations, Shopify Flow, and ecommerce automation. * Product information, inventory, ERP, order\-management, or fulfillment systems. * Technical SEO, structured data, GA4, conversion tracking, and marketplace feeds. * Large product catalogs, product comparison tools, and consumer electronics ecommerce. * Computer hardware, employee workstations, business software, and general IT administration. This experience is useful for diagnosing routine issues and coordinating with outside IT providers; the primary responsibility is Shopify and its connected ecommerce systems. **How to apply** Apply with your resume and brief examples of: * A Shopify store you developed or administered and what you personally owned. * A custom app or integration you built, including its database and how you supported it after launch. * An AI\-assisted workflow you use and how you check its output.
