jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: Onto Innovation is a leader in process control, combining global scale with an expanded portfolio of leading\-edge technologies that include: 3D metrology spanning the chip from nanometer\-scale transistors to micron\-level die\-interconnects; macro defect inspection of wafers and packages; metal interconnect composition; factory analytics; and lithography for advanced semiconductor packaging. Our breadth of offerings across the entire semiconductor value chain helps our customers solve their most difficult yield, device performance, quality, and reliability issues. Onto Innovation strives to optimize customers’ critical path of progress by making them smarter, faster and more efficient. **Job Summary \& Responsibilities** **About the role** ================== Onto Innovation designs and manufactures the inspection and metrology tools that the world’s leading chipmakers rely on. We believe AI will be a key enabler of faster, more reliable measurement and decision\-making in semiconductor manufacturing. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You will work closely with system engineers, algorithm developers, and applications teams to understand complex metrology workflows and data flows. You will set the vision and architecture for AI in metrology, then design, build, and productionize AI systems, including agentic ones, that speed up setup and troubleshooting and improve measurement quality. The emphasis is on agents grounded in real tools and data, with the right human oversight. You will also set technical direction and mentor the AI and ML engineers around you. **What you’ll do** ================== * **Set the vision and own the architecture.** Define the AI strategy and reference architecture for metrology, choose what to build and what to buy, and keep the roadmap tied to the problems customers actually have. * **Build it yourself.** Write, test, and ship production code — prototypes, agent workflows, evaluation tooling, and the systems that run them — and set the standard by example. * **Design agent workflows for the metrology lifecycle** — guided recipe and model setup, qualification runs, tool matching, and root\-cause triage when a measurement drifts. * **Give agents real tools.** Connect them to our simulators, solvers, and tool data so the agent orchestrates and the physics computes. * **Ground agents in fab knowledge:** retrieval manuals, recipes, service tickets, and historical measurement outcomes, with provenance on every answer. * **Design for trust.** Human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, confidence and uncertainty carried through every step, full audit trails, and refusal when the evidence is thin — a number without an error bar is not a measurement. * **Deploy where fabs allow it.** On\-premises and air\-gapped inference, with local or hosted models chosen on latency, cost, and data\-control constraints, and a release path that survives customer change control. * **Build the evaluation harness:** golden task sets, tool\-call correctness, agent\-built versus expert\-built recipes compared against the TMU budget, and regression tests on every model or prompt change. * **Keep the measurement science sound.** Surrogate models, parameter inference, tool calibration, and calibrated uncertainty remain the engines agents call. Own the ML behind them where it matters, including domain shift across tools, layers, and fabs. * **Lead technically.** Set standards, run design and code reviews, mentor mid\-level and junior engineers, and make the approach and build\-versus\-buy calls. Raise software quality with unit testing, test automation in CI/CD pipelines, refactoring of legacy code, and static and dynamic analysis. * **Set the practice for AI\-assisted development.** Apply AI coding tools responsibly to coding, debugging, documentation, and test generation, and maintain secure, reliable workflows for evaluating AI\-generated code: human review, automated testing, static analysis, security scanning, and validation against requirements. Spot gaps in team processes and toolchains, and drive improvements. * **Translate between fab and model.** Turn a customer’s setup or yield problem into a tractable agent workflow, then explain the result to engineers who will judge it against a reference technique. **Qualifications** **What you’ll bring** ===================== * MS or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, physics, applied mathematics, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 6\+ years of applied ML/AI experience in production, including 3\+ in technical leadership, leading projects or owning the technical direction of a significant AI system. * Experience defining AI strategy and system architecture, and getting a technical vision adopted across engineering. * Hands\-on depth in LLM\-based systems: agents, tool calling, retrieval, and prompt and model evaluation, shipped to real users and monitored after release. * Strong ML foundations: deep learning in PyTorch, plus regression, anomaly sted production code every day. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools: writing clear prompts, critically reviewing generated code for errors and incorrect assumptions, and turning it into maintainable production code. * A working understanding of software security, intellectual property, data privacy, and responsible AI when using AI in enterprise software. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for complex software systems, and the ability to research and solve hard technical problems independently. * Experience developing software on Windows with Visual Studio and Azure DevOps confirm toolchain. * A record of owning AI systems in production after launch: monitoring them, diagnosing failures, and shipping updates. * Clear technical writing, and the patience to explain an AI system’s decision to a process engineer who will not accept “the model decided” as an answer. **What would make us especially interested** ============================================ * Strong programming skills in C\+\+, C\#, or CUDA where the model meets the instrument are a plus. * Semiconductor process control experience — metrology, inspection, SPC, yield analytics, or time spent in a fab. * Scatterometry or OCD, ellipsometry, reflectometry, interferometry, or e\-beam imaging. * Tool\-calling and MCP frameworks, multi\-agent orchestration, vector and hybrid search, LLM fine\-tuning, and on\-premises LLM serving. * Security and IP protection for AI systems, and shipping inside a regulated release process or with customer data that can never leave the site. * Physics\-informed ML, surrogate modeling, physics\-based modeling and numerical simulation, or Bayesian inverse methods such as MCMC or variational inference. * Parallel or high\-performance computing. * Experience in integrating AI into the software development process, such as AI\-assisted code review, automated test creation, and requirements analysis. **Working here** ================ This role is on\-site by design: it depends on close, daily collaboration with applications and system engineering. Expect regular time in the office, and occasional time at a fab or customer site. Our customers do not tolerate surprises, neither do we. Work here is reviewed, documented, and qualified before it ships — and once it does, it runs in production lines measuring wafers around the clock. Why Join Onto Innovation? At Onto Innovation, we believe your work should matter—and so should your well\-being. That’s why we offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family. From health, dental, and vision coverage to life and disability insurance, PTO, and a 401(k) with employer match, we’ve got you covered. You’ll also enjoy access to our Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), wellness initiatives, and cutting\-edge tools—all within a collaborative, inclusive culture where your contributions are valued and recognized. **Compensation \& Growth** * Base Salary Range: $129,600\.00 \- $194,400\.00, offered in good faith and based on experience, location, and qualifications.* Additional Rewards: Annual bonus opportunities and potential long\-term incentives tied to both company and individual success. Empowering Every Voice to Shape the Future: Onto Innovation is committed to creating a workplace where every qualified candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed. We evaluate applicants based on skills, experience, and potential \- without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe diversity of thought and background drives innovation and strengthens our team. Important Note on Export Compliance For certain positions requiring access to technical data, U.S. export licensing review may be necessary for applicants who are not U.S. Citizens, Permanent Residents, or other protected persons under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\).

In response, Prisma AIRS delivers model security, posture management, AI red teaming, and runtime protection. Our customers can confidently deploy AI\-driven innovation while ensuring a formidable security posture from development through runtime. We are looking for a Senior Principal DevOps Engineer to join the Prisma AIRS shared services team. In this role you will be a technical leader whose influence extends across the entire Prisma AIRS organization. We value deep expertise in a few core areas and a strong desire to master the technologies that drive our platform forward. * Cloud and orchestration: GCP (primary), Kubernetes, AWS, containerization tools * CI/CD and GitOps: GitLab CI, Argo CD, Argo Rollouts, GitHub Actions * Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Kubernetes Config Connector (KCC), Helm, Terraform, Cue * Languages and core tooling: Python (modern, typed), Go (highly desired), BASH, rego We actively leverage AI coding assistants like Claude to boost our productivity. * **Your Impact** * Act as a force multiplier for our engineering teams by building and evangelizing a cohesive Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that simplifies, builds safety into, and accelerates the path to production. * Drive the adoption of GitOps and progressive delivery across the organization. Leveraging the Argo suite, you will provide safe, automated, and observable deployment pipelines that engineering teams can trust, directly improving the quality and velocity of our product. * Elevate the organization's cloud\-native expertise by setting the standard for Kubernetes and GCP best practices. Your guidance and the patterns you create will directly influence the architecture, reliability, and security of our core products. * Architect and operate a highly available, secure, and scalable cloud infrastructure. Your work will form the resilient foundation that Prisma AIRS is built upon, ensuring our customers are protected around the clock. * Manage expensive GPU/TPU resource allocation, spot\-instance fleets, and cluster usage dashboards. * Reduce engineering toil and eliminate entire classes of problems through insightful automation, self\-service tooling, and observability frameworks. You will give time back to every engineer in the AIRS org. * Set the technical direction for shared platform services and drive infrastructure architecture decisions across the Prisma AIRS organization. * Mentor engineers, raise the engineering bar, and champion high standards of automation, reliability, and security across teams. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Platform Engineering, including designing and operating large\-scale cloud infrastructure. * Mastery of Infrastructure as Code and cloud platforms. You have extensive, hands\-on experience building and managing cloud infrastructure declaratively. You are an expert in modern IaC tools (Terraform, Helm, Crossplane/ACK/KCC) and have deep proficiency with a major cloud provider, ideally GCP. * Deep expertise in the cloud\-native ecosystem. You have a thorough understanding of Kubernetes in large\-scale production environments and are fluent in building automation and platform tooling using modern, typed Python. * Extensive production experience with GitOps and CI/CD: Argo CD and Argo Rollouts for continuous delivery and progressive rollout, and GitLab CI for automating complex software delivery pipelines. * Hands on with infrastructure: doesn't just use infrastructure or manage infrastructure via applications, but builds infrastructure. Examples: cloud\-native, kubernetes\-native, builds internal developer platforms, builds terraform providers. * A superpower for debugging. When things break, you are the person people turn to. You have a deep command of engineering fundamentals — from Linux internals and networking to application performance — that allows you to systematically diagnose and solve problems in complex distributed systems, regardless of the specific technology stack. An innate sense of ownership and a collaborative spirit. You are a highly technical, self\-motivated contributor who sees projects through from idea to production. Crucially, you are easy to work with and excel at navigating the organization, acting as a central point of collaboration for multiple engineering teams. * **Preferred Qualifications** * MLOps experience operating GPU\-accelerated inference and model\-serving infrastructure at scale (Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, NVIDIA Triton Inference Server). * Advanced MLOps: data/feature pipelines, model serving (KServe/Seldon), ML security and governance, and LLMOps (RAG, eval, guardrails). * Languages and core tooling: Python (modern, typed), Go (highly desired), BASH, rego. * Cloud\-native monitoring and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, GCP Cloud Monitoring). * Cloud security compliance, IAM controls, and securing container workloads. * Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, etc.). * BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. \#LI\-TD1 **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. $177,500\.00 \- $287,100\.00/yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. jobs.description: **Support Operations Engineer I \| United States \| Remote** ------------------------------------------------------------ Pax8 is hiring a **Support Operations Engineer I in the United States** to turn support data, automation, ServiceNow solutions, and emerging AI capabilities into better experiences for our partners and support teams. **Build your skills where support meets automation** ---------------------------------------------------- This is an opportunity to grow at the intersection of **technical support, operational data, automation, knowledge management, and AI** . You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, learning how to spot recurring support challenges and turn them into practical improvements that make support simpler, smarter, and more scalable. As Pax8 continues exploring AI\-enabled ways of working, you’ll have room to experiment, learn, and develop alongside the technology. You don’t need to arrive knowing everything. You’ll also take ownership of keeping project and build work visible through the team backlog and ticketing processes, while maintaining clear communication and availability during business hours. **The impact you can make** --------------------------- Your work will help the Support organization move beyond treating individual symptoms and get closer to solving recurring problems at their source. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Enterprise Trust & Governance)
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ The Enterprise Trust \& Governance team builds the control plane that lets the world’s largest organizations deploy Perplexity broadly and with confidence. Computer and our agents work across a growing share of our customers’ environments, tools, and models. For administrators, that makes precise, enforceable control essential: who can do what, with which data, through which agents, and within what usage limits. This team makes those controls easy to manage, reliable and consistent across every product, and transparent to the people accountable for them. This is a product and platform engineering role with end\-to\-end ownership, from shaping the architecture and policy models to shipping the experiences our customers’ administrators and security teams use every day. You’ll work across product and infrastructure teams to turn complex enterprise requirements into reusable primitives and intuitive controls. The scope spans identity and provisioning, fine\-grained role\-based access across connectors, tool actions, and models, customer\-managed encryption keys, admin APIs, audit logs, and policy and usage controls. Strong governance helps enterprises move from pilots to company\-wide rollouts and gives them the confidence to entrust agents with greater responsibility over time. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own enterprise identity and provisioning, including SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM, WorkOS integrations, and support for identity providers such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID. * Build the permissions platform, with fine\-grained roles and permissions for connectors, tool actions, models, and model effort levels, enforced consistently across products and agent workflows. * Design and ship secure, well\-documented admin APIs for audit logs, members, groups, roles, and settings. * Build policy controls for model and feature availability, staged rollouts, model deprecations, usage and spend limits, alerts, and cost\-center allocation. * Build admin\-facing analytics for adoption, usage, spend, and policy enforcement, helping organizations measure value and manage their deployments. * Deliver audit logs and change notifications that help administrators investigate activity, track configuration changes, and support compliance. * Set the technical bar for authorization correctness and reliability, with fast, consistent, explainable permission checks, well\-defined failure behavior, and strong tenant isolation. * Partner with Product, Design, Security, Sales, and Customer Success to translate complex enterprise requirements into reusable platform capabilities and intuitive admin experiences. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 4\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex backend systems from design through production operation. * Strong system design skills, including building reliable, scalable, multi\-tenant SaaS platforms with clear security and isolation boundaries. * Strong proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Rust, and hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS and Kubernetes. * Deep expertise in at least one of the following: + Enterprise identity and provisioning, including OAuth, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM. + Permissions platforms, fine\-grained authorization, and policy enforcement. + Encryption, customer\-managed keys, and key lifecycle management. + Enterprise admin platforms, audit infrastructure, or usage and spend analytics. * Experience building or integrating enterprise identity and access systems, including platforms such as WorkOS, Okta, or Microsoft Entra ID. * Sound technical judgment in security\-sensitive systems, balancing threat models, authorization correctness, and failure behavior with usability and delivery speed. * A track record of leading ambiguous, cross\-team initiatives from architecture through adoption, setting technical direction for shared platforms, and raising engineering quality through mentorship. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value demonstrated impact, deep ownership, and the initiative to turn ambiguity into results.

jobs.title: Senior ASIC Design Verification Engineer (AI Compute)
jobs.description: Who we are Persimmons is building the infrastructure that will power the next decade of AI. If you're ready to join a world\-class team and play a critical role in making a global impact, we want to talk to you. What you'll do As a founding Senior ASIC Design Verification Engineer, you will own verification of the AI Persimmons inference chiplet, that runs the smallest to largest AI models. You will partner daily with the design, algorithm and compiler teams to make sure silicon matches its intended feature set and is free of critical bugs before tape\-out. Your primary duties and responsibilities include: * Lead verification planning and execution from subsystem to full chip. Collaborate with the CTO, design and software teams to build test plans that validate implementation against specifications with no significant gaps. * Design and implement UVM testbenches with constrained\-random stimulus, compute reference models, and scoreboards that stay portable from subsystem to chip level and are built for fast debugging. * Drive coverage closure using code, functional, and formal coverage, applying formal verification where it is most effective in the compute logic. * Develop and validate C/C\+\+ firmware tests running on RISC\-V cores to exercise compute features end to end. * Extend verification with FPGA prototyping on Synopsys HAPS, enabling software teams to run small real workloads. * Use AI agents to attack the highest\-cost parts of verification: testbench generation, stimulus creation, regression triage, log analysis, and coverage closure. * Run efficient, automated regressions that conserve EDA licenses, analyze bug trends, and systematically drive bugs to closure, with a passion for finding them early. **Requirements** What You Bring To The Table: * Educational Foundation: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Proven Experience: 5\+ years of hands\-on verification experience spanning test plan development, simulation environment creation, test implementation, and complex debugging across IP blocks, SoCs, and system\-level designs. * Compute Expertise: Verification experience on compute and fabric datapaths. * Technical Mastery: Advanced SystemVerilog/Verilog and UVM, plus C/C\+\+ embedded code development and validation on RISC\-V or similar processors. * Verification Leadership: A track record of scalable verification flows, coverage\-driven strategies, assertion\-based and formal verification, and data\-driven calls on what to cut and what is non\-negotiable before tape\-out. * AI\-Driven Workflows: You have built real AI\-driven workflows, not just chatted with a model. You've written instructions for agents and shipped automation, ideally for regression triage, log analysis, or testbench generation. * Startup Ready: Comfortable leading and being hands\-on in a small, high\-ownership team, staying calm under pressure, and working on site in San Jose. **Benefits** * Competitive salary and benefits package * Flexible PTO * 401k Please note: Our organization does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from external recruiters or agencies. jobs.title: Systems Specialist II
jobs.description: Description: Proven IT is hiring a Systems Specialist II for its internal IT team. You will own escalated employee support requests and keep the systems our teams use every day reliable and secure. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can diagnose issues across identity, Microsoft 365, endpoints, applications, servers, and networks; communicate clearly with the people affected; and follow work through to a verified resolution. You will work with colleagues in infrastructure, security, automation, and business applications. The right person enjoys solving the immediate problem and improving the process or documentation, so it is less likely to happen again. **What you will do** * Own support tickets from investigation through resolution, including prioritization, timely updates, accurate work notes, and a clear handoff when another team or vendor is needed. * Administer employee accounts and access across Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and other business systems. Support onboarding, role changes, and offboarding with appropriate approvals and license cleanup. * Troubleshoot Microsoft 365, email, collaboration tools, line\-of\-business applications, workstations, printers, and mobile devices. * Support endpoint deployment and management, including device enrollment, application delivery, patching, and tools such as Intune and Autopilot. * Maintain servers and core applications; review monitoring alerts, investigate recurring failures, and verify that backup jobs and recovery tests complete as expected. * Troubleshoot common network issues involving DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, VPN, switching, and site connectivity. Work with senior engineers and vendors on more complex changes. * Triage security events such as suspicious email, endpoint detections, and access issues; contain or escalate them according to team procedures. * Support technology at company offices, including meeting\-room equipment, copier and scan workflows, and physical\-access systems when assigned. * Write useful knowledge articles and runbooks, and coach less\-experienced teammates through issues you have resolv Requirements: **What you bring** * At least four years of relevant IT support or systems administration experience, including hands\-on work with server infrastructure, and at least two years of practical network troubleshooting. * Experience administering Windows endpoints, Active Directory or Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 in a business environment. * The ability to isolate a problem, test a fix, communicate status, and document the outcome without losing ownership of the request. * Good judgment around access, security, change control, backups, and when to escalate. * Strong written and verbal communication and a service mindset with employees at every level of the company. **Helpful experience:** Intune and Autopilot; virtualization and backup platforms; endpoint detection and response; Fortinet or Ruckus networking; PowerShell or other scripting; access\-control systems; and IT service\-management tools. Relevant Microsoft, CompTIA, Cisco, or vendor certifications are welcome. Equivalent hands\-on experience is valued. **Work arrangement** This role participates in scheduled support coverage and may require occasional after\-hours or weekend work for incidents and planned changes. Travel to other Proven IT locations may be needed. **Benefits** **GROUP HEALTH INSURANCE:** After a 30\-day waiting period, full\-time employees (who work at least 30 hours per week) and their dependents, are eligible to enroll in health benefits utilizing the Cigna network. Health options include a choice of 2 PPO plans or a High Deductible Health Plan with employer contributions to a Health Savings Account (HSA). In addition, Dental benefits are available through Mutual of Omaha as well as a Vision PPO plan utilizing the EyeMed network. Proven also offers voluntary worksite benefits including critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident coverage, short\-term disability insurance, supplemental life and pet insurance. Additional offerings include an employee discount program, home and auto insurance services and commuter/transit FSA. **EMPLOYER PROVIDED LIFE/AD\&D INSURANCE:** After a 30\-day waiting period, Proven IT provides a flat $25,000 Life Insurance benefit, administered by Mutual of Omaha, to all full\-time employees (who work at least 30 hours per week). Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) benefit payments are determined based on the type of loss incurred and are payable up to the full Life Insurance benefit amount. Life and AD\&D Insurance coverage amounts are reduced at ages 65, 70 and 75\. **EMPLOYER PROVIDED LTD:** Long\-Term Disability (LTD) insurance is an employer\-provided benefit and provides protection from loss of income in the event that an employee is unable to work due to illness, injury, or accident for a long period of time. The elimination period is 90\-days, and the maximum benefit is 60% of covered payroll up to $6000/month. This benefit is paid entirely by Proven IT and has no cost to the employee. **EMPLOYEE ASSISTANCE PROGRAM:** All employees may utilize the Disability Resource Services through Mutual of Omaha to assist themselves and their immediate family with convenient resources to help address emotional, legal and financial issues. Telephonic counseling and web\-based services are available as well as a limited number of geographically accessible face\-to\-face sessions. **401K PLAN:** All employees are eligible after 120 days of service to contribute on either a pre\-tax or post\-tax (Roth) basis to the 401K plan, administered by Principal Financial Services. Proven offers an employer match equal to 100% of the first 3% of deferrals plus 50% of the next 2% of deferrals. **FINANCIAL ADVISORY SERVICES:** Proven IT partners with Merrill Lynch to offer financial advisement to all employees. Merrill Lynch financial advisors are available to assist employees at no cost, with their 401k and retirement questions. **PERMISSIVE TIME OFF POLICY:** Proven provides a competitive paid time off policy for all full\-time regular employees after a 90\-day waiting period. Proven IT empowers their employees to work with their managers and team to coordinate all time off. Managers may impose a limit to requests for time off based on performance and tenure. **PARENTAL LEAVE:** Proven IT offers a generous parental leave policy for new parents. After 24\-months of employment, Proven provides full\-time regular employees with 90\-days of paid Maternity leave and 10\-days of paid Paternity leave. Employees with less than 24\-months of service may take the same amount of unpaid time off. **FITNESS CENTER:** Proven IT offers a free on\-site fitness center at the Tinley Park headquarters office location to all employees 24/7 Monday through Sunday. Employees utilize the gym equipment at their own risk. Proven IT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> DSP Architecture and Design **General Summary:** **General Summary** Qualcomm is seeking a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (6\+ years of experience) to join the Core Platform Kernel software team. The Core Platform Kernel team develops and deploys real\-time operating system (RTOS) software across multiple subsystems on Qualcomm SoCs, servicing Mobile Handset, XR, Compute, Automotive, Cloud AI, and IoT market segments. The team is responsible for the deployment and evolution of two RTOS platforms at scale: QuRT OS and Zephyr RTOS. As part of Qualcomm's continued investment in open source software, this role will help drive our Zephyr strategy and serve as a technical leader for Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr ecosystem. We are specifically seeking engineers who can contribute to and help maintain upstream Zephyr components while enabling Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm products. This role is well suited for engineers who enjoy deep technical work, influence system architecture, collaborate across organizational boundaries, and have a passion for building software that benefits both Qualcomm products and the broader open\-source community. What You'll Do As a Staff Engineer, you will: * Design, implement, and maintain RTOS and low\-level system software components. * Own and drive resolution of complex system\-level issues involving performance, stability, scalability, and correctness. * Lead feature development from problem definition through deployment. * Analyze crash dumps, traces, and logs to perform deep root\-cause analysis. * Collaborate closely with hardware, systems, validation, and software teams to deliver robust solutions. * Participate actively in design and code reviews, influencing technical direction and engineering standards. * Drive Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr open\-source community through technical discussions, code reviews, and upstream collaboration. * Mentor engineers on upstream development practices, code quality, and community engagement. Influence technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and software quality initiatives across the organization. * You will be expected to take ownership of key technical areas, make sound engineering tradeoffs, and help raise the effectiveness of the broader team through technical leadership and example. QuRT OS QuRT OS is Qualcomm's real\-time operating system optimized for the Hexagon DSP, enabling high\-performance, low\-power workloads including edge AI, modem processing, audio, sensor processing, and other specialized compute workloads. In the QuRT OS space, you will: * Drive enhancements to expose the full capability of the Hexagon processor architecture. * Design and implement new RTOS features with attention to correctness, performance, and maintainability. * Own features end\-to\-end: requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, integration, and support. Improve CI, automation, and test infrastructure to increase development velocity and software quality. * Zephyr RTOS The Core Platform Kernel team is a major adopter of Zephyr RTOS across Qualcomm SoCs and subsystems. We maintain a scalable Zephyr platform while contributing improvements back to the upstream community. This role is focused on technical leadership, stewardship, and upstream engineering within the Zephyr ecosystem. Successful candidates will possess a strong understanding of RTOS architecture, embedded systems, and open\-source development practices. In the Zephyr space, you will: * Serve as a maintainer or technical owner for key Zephyr subsystems, drivers, platform infrastructure, or architecture components. * Review, guide, and integrate contributions from both internal and external developers. * Design and implement new Zephyr capabilities with an emphasis on upstream acceptance and long\-term maintainability. * Lead architecture discussions and influence technical direction within the Zephyr project. * Drive Qualcomm's upstream contribution strategy and ensure internal development aligns with community best practices. * Collaborate with maintainers and contributors from other companies across the Zephyr ecosystem. * Enable Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm platforms through board support packages, architecture enablement, driver development, and system software integration. * Improve testing, CI infrastructure, release readiness, and software quality across upstream and Qualcomm\-maintained components. * Represent Qualcomm in technical working groups, design reviews, and community discussions. Help shape the future evolution of Zephyr through upstream contributions, reviews, and technical leadership. * **How You Work (Tools, Automation \& Modern Engineering)** Staff Engineers at Qualcomm are expected to be force multipliers, not just individual contributors. In practice, this means: * Applying modern develop ence collaborating across company boundaries in community\-driven software development environments. * **Why This Team** This team builds foundational RTOS software deployed across a broad range of Qualcomm products and markets. We work close to the hardware, solve difficult system\-level problems, and influence both platform architecture and engineering practices. Qualcomm is making a long\-term investment in Zephyr RTOS as a strategic platform across multiple product lines. This role provides a unique opportunity to shape both Qualcomm's internal RTOS strategy and the future direction of one of the industry's most important open\-source embedded operating systems. The team values analytical thinking, technical excellence, collaboration, clear communication, and continuous improvement. Staff Engineers are expected to lead through technical expertise, mentor others, influence architecture decisions, and help deliver high\-quality software at scale while remaining deeply hands\-on with the code. jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, AI Model Enablement & Software Tools
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Machine Learning Engineering **General Summary:** As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next\-generation experiences and drive digital transformation, creating a smarter, connected future for all. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer in the Qualcomm AI Stack SDK Software team, you will provide technical leadership for bringing state\-of\-the\-art AI models to Snapdragon platforms using Qualcomm’s AI software stack and model\-enablement frameworks. You will lead the analysis, adaptation, optimization, quantization, compilation, and execution of modern model architectures, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Large Vision Models (LVMs), Vision\-Language Models (VLMs), and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). You will work closely with AI Research teams to understand model internals, identify operator\- and graph\-level gaps against Qualcomm AI accelerator backends, and develop scalable solutions that can be reused across model families. The role operates at the intersection of model architecture, machine learning algorithms, graph transformations, quantization, compiler and runtime technologies, and hardware\-aware optimization. You will define technical direction and improve the Qualcomm AI software stack and model\-enablement frameworks through reusable model adaptations, quantization recipes, graph optimizations, compilation flows, and execution interfaces. You will collaborate with ML Research, AI accelerator hardware and software teams, compiler and runtime teams, Product Management, Program Management, QA, and customer engineering teams to take new model architectures from initial analysis through production\-quality execution on Qualcomm devices. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will lead and manage a small team of engineers while continuing to contribute as an individual contributor, drive architecture and implementation, establish engineering priorities, mentor team members, and own delivery across multiple model\-enablement initiatives. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 6\+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer - ClickHouse
jobs.description: Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world! Senior Software Engineer (Data Platform, ClickHouse) We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Senior Software Engineer to work on Qualys’ next\-generation Data Platform and middleware. For this position, we are looking for someone with expertise in ClickHouse. Working alongside a very talented team of engineers and architects, you will be responsible for prototyping, designing, developing and supporting a highly scalable SaaS based cloud security Data Platform. This is a great opportunity to be an integral part of a team building Qualys’ next generation microservices based technology platform processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day, leverage open source technologies, and work on challenging and business\-impacting projects. **Responsibilities** For this position, we are especially looking for someone with below capabilities: * Brings **deep expertise** in ClickHouse internals and architecture, various ClickHouse engines, partitioning, ordering keys, indexing, and query execution. * Design and review schemas against real\-world read/write patterns, optimizing ingestion, query performance, and storage efficiency. * Operate ClickHouse at scale on premise or cloud, including replication, sharding, workload management, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting. * Drive capacity planning across CPU, memory, storage I/O, and network resources, accounting for workload growth, concurrency, background merges, and reliability requirements. * You will be responsible for engineering of services running data stored with millions of transactions per second, scaling to 100s of terabytes of data. You will be responsible for driving the data source and providing data platform as a service to various applications built in Qualys. * Be the face and developer advocate of the technology stack you own and contribute back to open\-source community if any enhancement needed to fit in Qualys ecosystem. * You will be instrumenting both day 1 and day 2 operations on these data technologies keeping the 100s of thousands if not millions of operations per second. Migrate, burst into cloud and scale the stack with zero or least amount of downtime. * You will be responsible for delivering resilient client SDKs to the applications to communicate with the data source you are responsible for. * You will be constantly in the hunt for better solutions out there to resolve the current scaling, availability, and cost\-effective alternative solutions. **Qualifications** * BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Applied Math or related field. * Experience and expertise in ClickHouse as outlined earlier * 5\+ years hands\-on experience with developing SaaS based software products and solutions for service\-oriented deployments in public (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, etc.) or private clouds. * Proven expertise in data\-driven critical thinking problem\-solving * Ability to debug systems of software and people * Demonstrated ability to write high\-quality, production\-ready code (readable, well\-tested, with well\-designed APIs) * Demonstrated passion for innovation with an ability to work within agile software development methodologies * Experience with infrastructure orchestration and automation tools (Terraform) * Hands\-on experience using CI/CD pipelines * Strong analytical and debugging skills. * Java programming skills including object\-oriented design, prototyping, development, testing, profiling, etc. * Knowledge of JVM concepts like garbage collection, heap, stack, profiling, class loading, etc. * Strong in data structures and algorithms. * Ability to clearly articulate and communicate technical concepts within and across teams. * Knowledge of the below is a plus * Experience with distributed systems like Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Ceph, Flink, Spark or similar technologies * Experience with applying data encryption and data security standards. * Experience with container and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes etc. * Experience with monitoring tools such as Graphite, Grafana and Prometheus. * Experience with HashiCorp technologies such as Consul, Vault, Terraform and Vagrant. * Experience with configuration management tools such as Chef, Puppet or Ansible. * In\-depth experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines. * Exposure to Maven, Ant or Gradle for builds. jobs.title: Healthcare Software Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Healthcare Software Integration Engineer** ============================================ Quest International \| Remote – United States (California Preferred) **Pay:** $32\.00–$35\.00 per hour DOE (Depending on Experience) **Employment:** Full\-Time, Temp\-to\-Hire **Location:** Remote – United States **Preferred Location:** California **Work Environment:** Remote / Healthcare Technology Integration **What's in It for You?** ------------------------- **Grow:** Build your career in healthcare technology, medical software integration, and technical support. **Collaborate:** Work with healthcare customers and technical teams to connect medical software with hospital systems. **Develop:** Expand your experience with HL7, DICOM, Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, and healthcare software interfaces. **Impact:** Help ensure patient information transfers accurately and reliably between healthcare systems. **Stability:** Join an established global technology services company. **About Quest International** ----------------------------- For more than 40 years, Quest International has supported medical device manufacturers, healthcare organizations, OEMs, and technology customers through equipment repair, field service, logistics, and technical support. We are looking for an experienced DICOM/HL7 Integration Engineer to support healthcare software integration projects. This remote opportunity is available to qualified candidates throughout the United States, with a preference for candidates located in California. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Connect medical software applications with hospital information systems. * Configure, test, and maintain HL7 and DICOM software connections. * Help ensure patient information transfers correctly between healthcare systems. * Troubleshoot software integration problems, connectivity issues, and system errors. * Test software connections to identify and resolve technical issues. * Work with customers to understand their healthcare software integration requirements. * Collaborate with technical teams to complete integration projects. * Configure healthcare software interfaces and support connectivity with Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems. * Investigate software issues and develop appropriate technical solutions. * Document technical work, testing results, system configurations, and troubleshooting activities. * Communicate technical findings and project updates to customers and internal teams. * Learn new healthcare software applications and integration processes as needed. **What You Need to Qualify** ---------------------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree. * At least 3 years of relevant professional experience. * Hands\-on experience working with HL7 and DICOM systems. * Knowledge of Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems. * Experience configuring healthcare software and interfaces. * Ability to test and troubleshoot software connections. * Ability to understand customer requirements and resolve technical issues. * Strong analytical thinking and technical problem\-solving skills. * Good communication and organizational skills. * Ability to document technical work accurately. * Ability to collaborate effectively with customers and technical teams in a remote work environment. ### **Preferred Experience — Not Required** Experience with any of the following is a plus: * SQL databases, including Firebird or Microsoft SQL Server. * Reading or understanding Pascal programming code. * Hospital information systems and healthcare software applications. * Healthcare software interface configuration and troubleshooting. * Technical project coordination. * Technical documentation and software testing. * Working with multiple healthcare technology systems. Experience with HL7 and DICOM is required. Knowledge of SQL databases and Pascal programming is preferred, not required. **Compensation — What Does DOE Mean?** -------------------------------------- DOE means "Depending on Experience." Quest International offers **$32\.00–$35\.00 per hour** for this position. Starting pay will depend on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated technical skills. Candidates with experience configuring HL7 and DICOM interfaces, integrating healthcare software with hospital systems, and troubleshooting complex software connections may qualify for compensation within the posted range. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- Quest International offers eligible employees benefits, including during the temp\-to\-hire period: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Life insurance and AD\&D coverage * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance * Critical illness and hospital indemnity insurance * Accident insurance * Voluntary supplemental life insurance * Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Technical training and career development opportunities Benefits are subject to applicable plan eligibility, enrollment requirements, coverage effective dates, and employee contributions. **Who We're Looking For** ------------------------- We're looking for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, understands healthcare software systems, and can communicate effectively with customers and technical teams. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience connecting medical software to hospital systems, configuring HL7 and DICOM connections, and troubleshooting issues that affect the transfer of patient information. You should be comfortable working independently in a remote environment, documenting technical activities, testing software interfaces, and helping customers resolve integration challenges. **California\-based candidates are preferred, but qualified applicants throughout the United States are encouraged to apply.** If you have at least three years of relevant experience, knowledge of healthcare information systems, and hands\-on HL7 and DICOM experience, we encourage you to apply. **Ready to Start Your Quest?** ------------------------------ If you enjoy healthcare technology, solving software integration challenges, and helping medical systems communicate effectively, we'd love to hear from you! Quest International, Inc. www.questinc.com **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- Quest International is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on job\-related qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs without unlawful discrimination. Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer – EdTech Startup
jobs.description: **Early in your career, sharp on backend, and ready to own whole systems? Start here.** A fast\-growing startup in New York builds software for K\-12 education. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: **Thirty Madison is now part of** **Remedy****! You can read more about the acquisition** **here****. We are excited to join forces and continue to revolutionize healthcare accessibility!** ### **About the Role** Remedy is looking for a Product Designer to help shape intuitive, accessible, and engaging digital experiences that empower patients to better manage their care. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how patients interact with healthcare. You'll work across web and mobile platforms, identifying patient needs, solving complex user problems, and designing elegant solutions that make healthcare simpler and more accessible. As a member of our Product team, you'll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and cross\-functional partners to bring thoughtful, user\-centered experiences to life. You'll also help evolve our growing design system, ensuring consistency and quality across our digital products. We're looking for a data\-driven, hands\-on designer who enjoys experimenting, testing ideas, and using both qualitative and quantitative insights to continuously improve the patient experience. ### **Comp \| Perks \| Benefits** * The base pay range for this position is **$225,000 – $300,000 per year.** * Potential to earn equity * Robust and affordable Health, Dental, and Vision plan options * Flexible time off policy *Base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Equity may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.* ### **What You'll Own** You'll contribute to the design and optimization of Remedy's patient\-facing digital experiences, which may include: * **Patient Experience:** Designing intuitive, accessible experiences that help patients navigate their care across web and mobile platforms. * **End\-to\-End Product Design:** Taking user problems from initial discovery and concept development through visual design and implementation. * **Design Systems:** Contributing to the growth and evolution of our design system to ensure consistency, usability, and scalability. * **Experimentation \& Optimization:** Using A/B testing, prototyping, and rapid iteration to improve user engagement and conversion. * **User Research \& Insights:** Incorporating qualitative and quantitative data, user feedback, and usability testing into design decisions. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partnering with Product, Engineering, and brand teams to deliver cohesive, high\-quality digital experiences. ### **What You'll Do** #### **Design Thoughtful, Patient\-Centered Experiences** Translate complex patient needs and healthcare workflows into simple, intuitive digital experiences. Own design work from initial concepts and user flows through high\-fidelity mockups and implementation support across web and mobile platforms. Apply strong visual design principles, including typography, color, layout, and interaction design, to create accessible and engaging experiences. #### **Use Research and Data to Inform Design** Participate in product discovery to ensure problem statements, design decisions, and hypotheses are grounded in patient needs and customer insights. Use qualitative and quantitative data to identify opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve the user experience. Seek out and incorporate user feedback throughout the design process. #### **Experiment, Test, and Iterate** Develop prototypes to explore ideas, test assumptions, and validate potential solutions. Partner with cross\-functional teams to conduct A/B tests and usability testing, using results to inform design improvements. Embrace rapid experimentation and iteration to deliver experiences that improve usability, engagement, and conversion. #### **Contribute to Our Design System** Help maintain and expand Remedy's growing design system, creating reusable components and patterns that support consistency across products. Collaborate with other designers and engineers to ensure designs are scalable, accessible, and implemented with a high level of quality. #### **Collaborate Across Product and Engineering** Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and brand stakeholders to translate business and patient needs into effective design solutions. Clearly communicate design decisions, explain tradeoffs, and incorporate feedback from cross\-functional partners. Actively participate in design reviews, sharing ideas and constructive feedback to elevate the quality of our work. ### **What We're Looking For** * **2–4 years of product design experience**, ideally within a consumer\-focused, product\-driven company. * Experience designing complex user flows, interactions, and interface states across web and mobile platforms. * Proficiency in Figma, including the ability to create polished, high\-fidelity mockups and prototypes. * Experience working with and contributing to established design systems. * Strong foundational visual design skills, including typography, color, layout, and interaction design. * Experience conducting or supporting A/B testing, usability testing, and iterative design processes. * Demonstrated ability to use both quantitative and qualitative data to inform design decisions. * Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and tradeoffs. * Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and cross\-functional business teams. * A portfolio that demonstrates your design thinking, problem\-solving approach, and visual design craft. * A genuine interest in making healthcare more consumer\-centric and improving the experience of patients managing specialized health conditions. ### **Nice to Have** Experience with one or more of the following: * Healthcare, health and wellness, or consumer\-focused digital products * E\-commerce or subscription\-based products * Conversion rate optimization and subscription experience design * Foundational knowledge of HTML, CSS, React, or common web development principles * Accessibility standards and inclusive design best practices ### **What Success Looks Like** Within your first year, you'll have developed a strong understanding of Remedy's patients, products, and design system, becoming a trusted design partner to Product, Engineering, and cross\-functional teams. You'll have contributed to meaningful improvements across our web and mobile experiences, using research, experimentation, and data to inform solutions that improve usability, engagement, and patient satisfaction. You'll also have helped strengthen our design system and establish consistent, scalable design patterns that support the continued growth of our products. Most importantly, you'll help Remedy deliver **simple, accessible, patient\-centered digital experiences that make managing healthcare easier and more intuitive.** **U.S. Applicants Only** **Don't meet every single requirement?** Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Remedy we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions. Contact us at recruiting@thirtymadison.com to request accommodation. \*This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I\-9 Form information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.\* * **Please be aware that there are fraudulent entities who are falsely claiming to be or represent Remedy in order to solicit sensitive personal information or payment. Remedy is not in any way associated with these entities or practices. The safety and integrity of those seeking employment with us is of the utmost importance and we actively work with our legal and security teams to prevent future incidents.** **Remedy will never ask for sensitive information or payment when engaging with job seekers. The entities use many methods to perpetuate these scams, including but not limited to: participating in a text\-only interview, using Remedy's trademarks on their correspondence, or providing you with a seemingly legitimate offer letter. If you suspect you are a victim of this scamming, we encourage you to cease further contact and report the crime to** **The Federal Trade Commission****.**

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Data Engineer** **Salary \- $****125,000 (Chicago)** **About Retail Insight** At Retail Insight, we're transforming the way some of the world's biggest retailers and CPG brands use data, analytics and technology to make smarter decisions. Our people are at the heart of what we do. We bring together talented people with different experiences, perspectives and expertise to solve complex problems, challenge the status quo and make a real impact for our clients. We're growing, and we're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Engineering team. **About the role** We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to build and support the reliable, scalable data systems that power our solutions for US retail clients. As our US client portfolio grows, you'll work with complex data environments, helping translate business requirements into practical technical solutions. Working closely with our Chicago\-based Lead Data Engineer, alongside data scientists, analysts and product teams, you'll build data pipelines and products that help our clients make better decisions. This is a hands\-on role combining strong technical skills with collaboration and clear communication. You'll contribute to the evolution of our data platform, improve reliability and performance, and help maintain high engineering standards. You'll also work with colleagues and client stakeholders to understand their needs and support successful delivery. **What you'll be doing** * Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, developing and optimising batch and streaming workflows for reliability and performance. * Contributing to the design and implementation of data architecture. * Implementing data quality checks, monitoring and observability across pipelines. * Applying security, access control and governance standards established by our platform team. * Collaborating with data scientists and analysts to deliver data products that support their work. * Working with the Lead Data Engineer to translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Participating in code reviews, setting a high bar for engineering quality and contributing to team standards. * Helping identify opportunities to optimise cloud costs and platform performance. * Contributing to platform documentation, tooling choices and continuous improvement. **What we’re looking for** * Solid, demonstrable experience in data engineering, including building and maintaining production\-grade Databricks pipelines. * Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog and Databricks Asset Bundles. * Strong hands\-on knowledge of Apache Spark, Delta Lake and Databricks Workflows. * Proficiency in Python and SQL, with a good understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT patterns and distributed data processing. * Experience with Azure data platforms, including Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2 and Azure DevOps, or equivalent services on AWS or GCP. * Experience implementing data quality checks and pipeline monitoring. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical colleagues. * A collaborative approach, ownership of quality outcomes and a drive to learn and improve. * A degree in computer science, data engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Willingness to travel as required. **Bonus points if you also have** * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or Bicep. * Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation frameworks. * Exposure to real\-time streaming technologies such as Kafka or Event Hubs. * Exposure to retail or consumer packaged goods (CPG) data, such as point of sale, inventory or supply chain. * Experience working directly with clients. **Some of our extras...** We believe in flexibility, growth, and taking care of our people, both in and out of the office. **Hybrid \& Flexible Working:** Work from anywhere benefits, plus summer hours and extra days off for life’s big moments (including your birthday and wedding). **Generous Time Off:** 26 days PTO (accrued with service), paid volunteer days, and full support for your wellbeing, including mental health resources. **Career \& Learning:** Access to a top\-tier learning platform, career progression plans, and support to create your ideal home workspace. **Health \& Financial Benefits:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus a 6% matched retirement plan. **Personal Perks:** Annual phone reimbursement, onsite gym access, and customizable benefits via our online platform. Plus much more! **Our Interview Process** Our interview process may vary slightly depending on the role. We’ll always let you know what to expect at each stage and give you plenty of opportunities to ask questions along the way. **People Team Introduction and Cultural Drivers Interview** An initial conversation with a member of our People Team to learn more about you, your experience and what you’re looking for in your next role. We’ll also introduce you to Retail Insight and explain the opportunity and interview process. During the call, we’ll ask interview questions based on our cultural drivers to understand how your values, behaviours and ways of working align with ours. **Role and Technical Interview** This stage explores your experience and the skills most relevant to the role, as well as how you approach your work. Depending on the position, it may include a practical task, presentation or technical assessment. We’ll always explain what’s involved in advance. **Senior Leadership Coffee Chat** The final stage is an informal coffee chat with a member of our senior leadership team. It’s an opportunity to learn more about our business and culture, ask any remaining questions and make sure Retail Insight feels like the right fit for you. ***Be your authentic self*** *\- Retail Insight is committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment. All employees and any job applicants will receive equal treatment. We actively seek to create an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and encouraged to contribute their best work.*

Operating out of a major regional airport hub, they seamlessly blend R\&D, structural analysis, and manufacturing to deliver elegant engineering solutions across multiple aviation platforms, offering teams a unique environment to tackle complex aerospace challenges. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Base Salary:** $120,000 \- $140,000 per year * **Starting Bonus:** Impactful end\-of\-year bonus opportunities based on experience and performance metrics * **Relocation Assistance:** Comprehensive relocation assistance available for qualified out\-of\-state candidates * **Shift:** Standard business hours (Onsite) * **Benefits Package:** Traditional and high\-deductible Medical plans, Dental, Vision, Prescription coverage, Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Holidays, Paid Parental Leave, Retirement savings programs, Disability benefits, Supplemental options, and ongoing training/development access **Job Summary** Acting as a pivotal technical and operational leader, the Design Engineering Manager directs the engineering department to guarantee the safe, precise, and on\-time release of critical product designs. jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the HR Product Team** ----------------------------- The HR Product Engineering team is the foundational layer of Rippling's unified workforce management system. Our mission is to build seamless, global, and compliant systems that power the entire employee lifecycle, from hire to retire. We operate at the critical intersection of HR, compliance, and enterprise software. Our products manage the most sensitive and essential aspects of a company's relationship with its people, requiring us to solve complex problems related to scale, data security, and multi\-product integration. ### **What We Build** The team is composed of high\-impact squads focused on four core domains: * **HRIS (Human Resources Information System):** Building the core employee record, organizational structure, and workflows that serve as the single source of truth for all other Rippling products. * **Time:** Developing accurate, scalable, and globally compliant Time \& Attendance systems, including clocking, time\-off accrual, and scheduling, ensuring employees are paid correctly and legally. * **Benefits:** Creating and maintaining the marketplace and administration tools for health, retirement, and other employee benefits, handling complex enrollment, eligibility, and provider integrations. * **Talent:** Designing products that manage employee growth, performance, and learning, helping companies develop and retain their workforce effectively. **What you will do** -------------------- * Design, implement, and test reliable backend services and APIs that power core product features and business logic at scale. * Work across key technical domains, including API design, data modeling, event modeling, and optimizing service performance. * Own the development lifecycle for defined features, from implementation and testing to deployment, monitoring, and support in a production environment. * Effectively integrate into cross\-functional teams, contribute to technical discovery, and rapidly learn from code and system feedback. **What you will need** ---------------------- * 2\+ years of professional experience as a backend engineer, preferably with Python, Go, or a similar production language, and strong experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL). * Care about business impact, balancing technical craft with speed and the bottom line to deliver value quickly. * Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, dynamic environments, demonstrating resilience and agility in the face of changing product needs. * Excellent skills in communicating complex technical ideas with clarity to enable effective collaboration with peers and stakeholders. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 152,000 \- 225,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)
