jobs.title: Postdoctoral Associate | Vertebrate Genome Laboratory
jobs.description: Organization Overview: The Vertebrate Genome Laboratory (VGL) at The Rockefeller University leads international efforts in vertebrate genome sequencing, assembly, annotation, and evolutionary analysis. As a core laboratory of the Vertebrate Genomes Project and a major hub of the Earth BioGenome Project, VGL is at the forefront of generating high\-quality, telomere\-to\-telomere genome assemblies across vertebrate diversity.The laboratory provides an end\-to\-end genomics platform spanning sample processing, sequencing, genome assembly, and downstream data analytics. It specializes in high\-molecular weight DNA extraction and long\-read genomic technologies, offering integrated library preparation and sequencing services for high–molecular weight genomic DNA, long amplicons, and full\-length transcriptome sequencing (Iso\-Seq). These capabilities are tightly coupled with in\-house computational expertise for genome assembly, curation, annotation, and comparative genomics, and are supported by state\-of\-the\-art platforms including PacBio and ONT. Overview: We seek a Postdoctoral Associate with expertise in conservation genomics, population genetics, and computational biology to join GAIA—Genomic Artificial Intelligence Applications—a collaborative initiative among The Rockefeller University, Revive \& Restore, Cornell University, and other academic and technology partners, supported by the Bezos Earth Fund and Google.org. GAIA is developing next\-generation artificial\-intelligence systems that scale genome assembly and enable rapid genome\-informed conservation decision making. Its two central goals are:* To build Jarvis, an AI Genome Curation Assistant that combines machine\-learning approaches with large\-scale biological data to detect, interpret, and correct structural errors in genome assemblies, substantially reducing the manual effort required to produce high\-quality reference genomes. * To build Genera, a multimodal, agentic AI system that integrates genomic, ecological, and other biological data to assess extinction risk and generate actionable genetic\-rescue strategies for conservation practitioners. The successful candidate is interested in applying genomic research to biodiversity conservation and species recovery and will provide the population\-genetic, evolutionary, and conservation\-genomics expertise needed to guide the technical development, validation, and application of these systems. The Postdoctoral Associate will work closely with AI scientists and engineers across partner institutes, providing complementary skills and knowledge in biodiversity genomics. The position will focus solely on non\-human species and will connect high\-quality reference genomes and population\-level genomic data to real\-world questions in biodiversity conservation. The candidate will also help establish an evidence base connecting prior uses of genomic information, conservation decisions, and documented recovery outcomes. Potential research areas include genetic diversity and inbreeding, demographic history, deleterious variation and genetic load, local adaptation, reproductive failure, disease susceptibility, population viability, and predicting the genomic consequences of potential conservation interventions. The candidate will have substantial opportunity to shape an independent research program within this broad framework and to develop applications across diverse endangered and recovering species. Responsibilities: Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:* Lead computational analyses in population, evolutionary, and conservation genomics across non\-human species. * Identify biologically meaningful questions, genomic features, and conservation use cases that can guide the development and evaluation of GAIA tools. * Review and synthesize historical applications of genomic data in conservation, linking the genomic evidence used, the management interventions undertaken, and the resulting conservation outcomes to inform Genera’s development and validation. * Develop and apply approaches to quantify genomic diversity, heterozygosity, runs of homozygosity, demographic history, effective population size, genetic load, deleterious variation, population structure, and signatures of selection or adaptation, with particular emphasis on methods that can be interpreted by an AI model. * Integrate chromosome\-level reference genomes with population resequencing, functional annotation, ecological, phenotypic, demographic, and conservation\-status data. * Organize, curate, and evaluate genomic datasets used as inputs, training resources, benchmarks, or validation datasets for Genera and related GAIA systems. * Critically assess the biological validity, robustness, uncertainty, and interpretability of outputs produced by AI models. * Compare conclusions derived from individual reference genomes with those obtained from population\-level datasets and identify when additional sampling is required. * Develop r manuscripts, conservation\-genomics reports, software and data releases, presentations, and collaborative grant activities. * Mentor junior researchers and contribute to the broader scientific activities of the VGL, GAIA, the Vertebrate Genomes Project, and the Earth BioGenome Project. Qualifications: **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:*** Ph.D. or equivalent degree in non\-human population genetics, conservation genomics, evolutionary genomics, computational biology, bioinformatics, or a related field. * Strong research experience in the analysis of genomic variation within or among non\-human populations. * Demonstrated knowledge of population\-genetic and evolutionary\-genomic theory and methods. * Experience working with genome assemblies, whole\-genome resequencing data, genomic variants, and functional annotations. * Proficiency in at least one scientific programming language, preferably Python or R. * Experience developing reproducible computational workflows in Linux and high\-performance or cloud\-computing environments. * Strong quantitative, analytical, and scientific\-writing skills. * A record of scientific productivity appropriate to the candidate’s career stage. * Ability to work effectively in a highly interdisciplinary and cross\-institutional collaborative environment. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Research experience in conservation genetics or genomics involving threatened, endangered, managed, or non\-model species, and ability to work in large, multispecies projects. * Experience estimating demographic history, inbreeding, genetic load, effective population size, population structure, gene flow, or adaptive variation. * Experience integrating genomic data with ecological, environmental, phenotypic, geographic, or life\-history information. * Familiarity with long\-read genome assemblies, telomere\-to\-telomere genomes, genome annotation, comparative genomics, or pangenomics. * Experience with commonly used population\-genomics and variant\-analysis tools and workflows. * Familiarity with conservation\-management frameworks, genetic rescue, population viability, or recovery planning. * Experience collaborating with field biologists, wildlife agencies, zoos, biobanks, conservation organizations, or species\-recovery teams. * Interest in evaluating or interpreting machine\-learning models, multimodal datasets, or foundation\-model outputs. Prior experience developing machine\-learning models is welcome but is not required. * Experience communicating complex genomic findings to collaborators without specialized computational or genomics training. * Experience with systematic reviews, evidence synthesis, meta\-analysis, or the development of structured datasets linking conservation interventions to biological or management outcomes. The successful candidate will be based at The Rockefeller University in New York City and will work under the supervision of Drs. Giulio Formenti and Erich D. Jarvis, in close collaboration with researchers at Revive \& Restore, Cornell University, and other GAIA partner organizations. The position is expected to be supported for two years, subject to institutional appointment procedures and satisfactory progress. The Rockefeller University is an equal opportunity employer – veterans/individuals with disabilities. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal law, including but not limited to disability and protected veteran status. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on various factors, including but not limited to organizational budgets, qualifications, experience, education, licenses, specialty, and training. The hiring range provided represents The Rockefeller University's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. Compensation Range: Min: USD $72,100\.00/Yr. Compensation Range: Max: USD $72,100\.00/Yr.

You will be responsible for the entire ML lifecycle—from collaborating with module owners to define classification logic, to architecting scalable vision models that operate within our high\-throughput, 24/7 manufacturing environment. synthesize complex ML metrics into actionable business insights for a broad range of audiences, from fellow engineers to site leadership. * **Execution Excellence** : A history of managing complex technical projects from conception to delivery while adhering to strict deadlines and software design principles. *The current base salary range for this role is between $106,000 \- $145,000\. jobs.title: 2027 Spring Co op Biologics Design and AI Cambridge MA
jobs.description: **Job Title:** *2027 Spring Co\-op Biologics Design and AI* * **Grade:** *Co\-op* * **Location:** *Cambridge, MA* * **Duration:** *6 months* **About the Job** Looking to launch your career at the cutting edge of healthcare? Join Sanofi for a chance to develop with mentoring and guidance from inspirational leaders while helping to make an impact on the lives of countless people worldwide. We are seeking a highly motivated **Spring Co\-op** to join our **Biologics Design and AI team**. Sanofi is seeking a highly motivated and intellectually curious Data Scientist Spring Co\-op to join our Biologics and Design AI team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of a highly innovative project: bridging the world of Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous AI agents with biophysical protein predictive models. Biologics like antibodies and nanobodies are highly effective therapies but optimizing them is a complex challenge. You will closely work with computational biologists and AI scientists to build intelligent, agentic workflows that can reason over structural data, orchestrate predictive tools, and map protein sequences to critical therapeutic properties, ultimately accelerating our biologics pipeline. Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams. **About Sanofi** We’re an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. **Main Responsibilities** * **LLM Fine\-Tuning \& Cross\-Modal Adaptation:** Fine\-tune conversational, natural language LLMs to directly interface with and reason over data from specialized protein prediction models. Using parameter\-efficient techniques (e.g., LoRA, PEFT), you will adapt these human\-language models to comprehend protein sequences, structural embeddings, and biophysical constraints. By bridging the gap between human\-like generative AI reasoning and rigorous structural biology, you will build hybrid architectures designed to significantly enhance the accuracy of critical antibody and nanobody property predictions, such as binding affinity and thermal stability. * **Collaboration \& Reporting:** Partner closely with experimental protein engineers and computational biologists to understand biological constraints, define the agent's objectives, and validate model predictions, ultimately presenting your methodologies, insights, and model performance to cross\-functional R\&D teams at the conclusion of the spring term. **About you** **Basic Qualifications:** * Currently pursuing a Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Bioengineering, or related field with plans to graduate by Spring 2027 (or 2028\). * Must be permanently authorized to work in the U.S. and not require sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H\-1B or green card) at the time of application or in the future. Students currently on CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT usually require future sponsorship for long term employment and do not meet the Internal requirements for this program unless eligible for an alternative long\-term status that does not require company sponsorship. * Must be enrolled in an accredited college or university throughout the duration of the co\-op/internship. * Must be able to relocate to the office location and work 40hrs/week, Monday to Friday for the full duration of the co\-op/internship. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Previous academic projects or industry experience demonstrating the application of NLP, LLMs, or agentic workflows to complex, ideally scientific, problems. * Familiarity with biological data, specifically protein sequences and 3D structures. * Basic domain knowledge in immunology, structural biology, or biophysics. * Strong programming skills in **Python** and standard data science libraries. * Hands\-on experience with LLM fine\-tuning methodologies and orchestration frameworks. * Experience with deep learning frameworks such as **PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX**. * Experience using state\-of\-the\-art AI tools for biology (e.g., Protein LLMs, AlphaFold, Rosetta). * Excellent problem\-solving communication skills, with a passion for working at the intersection of generative AI and healthcare. * Fluent in English. **Why Choose Us** * Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future focused team. * Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you. * Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare. Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve. * **Compensation** The salary range for this position is **$47 \- $60** hourly. All compensation will be determined commensurate with demonstrated experience. \#LI\-Onsite \#vhd

jobs.title: Lead Analytics Engineer, AI Native Self Service Analytics
jobs.description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise. **Culture at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer. We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in\-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in\-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location. So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long\-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. **The Team** Data \& Analytics is building the DNA of an AI native Scribd, Inc. Bringing together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Data Analytics, D\&A partners across product, technology, content, and the business to scale intelligence, advance understanding, shape strategy, and turn insight into lasting growth across our four brand portfolio. Making this ambition real at scale starts with Analytics Engineering. The team transforms fragmented data, inconsistent definitions, and dispersed analytical knowledge into trusted, reusable, production quality data foundations and products that enable intelligence to scale across the company. In partnership with Engineering, Analytics Engineers ensure critical data is captured, centralized, documented, secured, and governed. The team builds canonical datasets, shared metrics, and semantic layers, together with the quality, observability, lineage, and evaluation systems that make these assets trustworthy. On top of this foundation, Analytics Engineers develop AI agents and analytical tools that bring reliable intelligence directly into the decisions and workflows of teams across the company. **The Role** We’re hiring for a Principal/Lead Analytics Engineer to scale data for an AI native Scribd, Inc. In this role, you will shape the technical foundations, modeling standards, and development practices that allow Analytics Engineering to move faster with greater confidence. You will operate as a senior individual contributor, deeply connected to the work, trusted for your judgment, and able to raise the quality of systems, decisions, and execution across teams. Your impact will come through technical leadership. Your strong strategic judgment is paired with enough proximity to the work to guide technical decisions credibly. You will connect Analytics Engineering investments to company priorities, communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders, and contribute thoughtfully to decisions about data modeling, architecture, governance, quality, tooling, and developer experience. Your pragmatic approach keeps the organization moving forward. Rather than waiting for an ideal end state, you will think in sequences and ask, “What is the right next version?” Communication happens early and often because transparency, thoughtful feedback, and visible decision making build trust and help teams move with confidence. The transformation happening through AI is an opportunity to expand what talented teams can accomplish. Agentic coding, AI assisted development and analysis, and automated workflows can increase human judgment, creativity, and impact rather than replace them. You approach these technologies with curiosity and pragmatism, applying them where they create clear and measurable value. Above all, this role is about strengthening the discipline of Analytics Engineering. Success is reflected in data systems that are more reliable, understandable, scalable, and useful, and in teams that become more capable because of your technical leadership. **The Essentials** * 10/8\+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence engineering or a related discipline * Depth in building governed, canonical data models and semantic layers, giving core business concepts one authoritative, discoverable definition instead of letting teams reconcile competing sources * Experience designing the data quality, observability, documentation, governance, access control, privacy, lineage, and evaluation systems that ensure data and d governance * Experience leading on call rotations, coordinating incident response, resolving production issues, and driving follow up improvements that strengthen system reliability \- At Scribd, Inc., your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States. In the state of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $179,000 \[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market within California] to $253,500 \[maximum salary in our highest geographic market within California]. In the United States, outside of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $149,000 \[minimum salary in our lowest US geographic market outside of California] to $240,500 \[maximum salary in our highest US geographic market outside of California]. In Canada, the reasonably expected salary range is between $178,000 CAD\[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market] to $227,000 CAD\[maximum salary in our highest geographic market]. We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job\-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a competitive equity ownership, and a comprehensive and generous benefits package. **Working at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- **Are you currently based in a location where Scribd, Inc. can employ you?** Employees must have their **primary residence in or near** one of the following cities. This includes surrounding metro areas or locations within a typical commuting distance: **United States****:** Atlanta \| Austin \| Boston \| Dallas \| Denver \| Chicago \| Houston \| Jacksonville \| Los Angeles \| Miami \| New York City \| Phoenix \| Portland \| Sacramento \| Salt Lake City \| San Diego \| San Francisco \| Seattle \| Washington D.C. **Canada****:** Ottawa \| Toronto \| Vancouver **Mexico****:** Mexico City **Benefits at Scribd, Inc.** * Scribd Flex (flexible work model) * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Mental health support and disability coverage * Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick time, holidays, winter break, volunteer time, and sabbaticals * Paid parental leave and family support benefits * Retirement matching and employee equity * Learning and development programs and professional growth opportunities * Wellness and home office stipends * Complimentary access to the Scribd, Inc. suite of products * Enterprise access to leading AI tools **Get to Know Scribd, Inc.** **About Scribd, Inc.** **Life at Scribd, Inc.** *We want our interview process to be accessible to everyone. You can inform us of any reasonable adjustments we can make to better accommodate your needs by emailing accommodations@scribd.com about the need for adjustments at any point in the interview process.* *If you apply for a job with Scribd, Inc. or otherwise engage with us in connection with employment (including as an employee, contractor, or other personnel), the personal information we process in that context is subject to our Employee and Applicant Privacy Policy, which is available* *here**.* *Scribd, Inc. is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply, and believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.*

Advanced MATLAB programming skills * Experience developing scientific simulation and data\-analysis software * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skillsPreferred Qualifications * Experience with frac treatment diagnostics and pressure interpretation * Knowledge of: * \- proppant transport\- slurry transport\- acoustic or pressure\-wave propagation * Experience with: \- finite\-volume jobs.title: Security & IT Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sofar Ocean** --------------------- Sofar Ocean is building the world's largest real\-time ocean sensor network. Our Spotter buoys collect ocean data across the globe, and our software, including Wayfinder for voyage optimization, turns that data into decisions for commercial shipping, government, and defense customers. We're a team of about 100 based at Pier 28 in San Francisco, and we're growing fast. **About the role** ------------------ You’ll own Sofar’s corporate security and identity infrastructure and lead our security compliance program. You’ll turn security priorities into working controls, and be the internal point person for customer security reviews. Helpdesk and facilities IT are handled by our managed IT partner, whom you’ll work alongside. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Identity and access:** own Google Workspace as our identity provider. Roll out SSO and SCIM provisioning across our SaaS tools, automate joiner/mover/leaver processes, and run periodic access reviews. * **Endpoints:** own device management (MDM, EDR) and endpoint detection and response, including device compliance policies. * **Security operations:** tune and triage SIEM detections. Track vulnerability remediation across Dependabot findings and pen test results. Maintain and exercise our incident response plan. * **Compliance:** run day\-to\-day work toward SOC 2 and other compliance processes. That includes maintaining policies, operating our compliance platform, collecting audit evidence, and reviewing vendors and subprocessors. * **Customer trust:** own responses to customer security questionnaires and assessments. Keep our answers accurate, consistent, and defensible. * **Vendors:** manage day\-to\-day relationships with our managed IT provider, security vendors and advisors, contractors, and auditors. **What you bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years in IT systems, corporate security, or security engineering, ideally at a startup * A clear, well\-reasoned point of view on how a \~100\-person startup should approach security, including where to invest early, where to accept risk, and how to sequence compliance work. You can defend that view and adjust it when the context changes. * Hands\-on administration of Google Workspace and an SSO/SCIM stack, plus MDM and EDR tooling * Working knowledge of AWS IAM. Scripting ability in Python or similar for automation. * Has been through at least one SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audit from the inside * Writes clearly and precisely. You prefer a defensible claim to an optimistic one. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience Vanta or Drata, AWS CloudFormation, Auth0 * experience with SIEM detection engineering **Location, Compensation, \& Benefits** --------------------------------------- * The preference is for this role is based at our Pier 28 office in San Francisco a few days a week to work seamlessly with our team. However, we are open to remote applicants. * The base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $200,000, plus equity. Final pay depends on experience and skills. We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), flexible PTO, and a learning and development stipend. * The range listed is what we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and may be modified in the future. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, experience, and equity package. **Our Approach to AI in the Hiring Process:** --------------------------------------------- At Sofar, we use AI tools in our day\-to\-day work, and we don't expect our hiring process to be any different. Here's how we think about it: **Applying:** Write your own first draft — we want to hear your voice and understand your real experience. AI is fine for refining and polishing, not for generating your story. **Take\-home assessments:** Complete these on your own unless we've explicitly said otherwise. We'll always be upfront about it when AI is allowed. **Interview prep:** Go for it. Use AI to research Sofar, practice your responses, and sharpen your thinking before we meet. **During interviews:** This is you. We're a small team and we move fast — live conversations are how we get to know you, and we're genuinely curious how you think in real time. **A note on transparency:** We're a lean People team, and we use AI to help with things like drafting job descriptions, preparing interview questions, and candidate communications. We don't use it to make hiring decisions — those are always ours. The through line: use AI to show more of yourself, not less :) **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas and retain an immigration lawyer to support the process. While we can't guarantee sponsorship for every role or situation, if we make you an offer, we'll make every reasonable effort to make it work. **A note on applying:** We mean it when we say we want the strongest people — not the most credentialed ones. If you're excited about this work but don't check every box, please apply anyway. Research consistently shows that underrepresented candidates are more likely to self\-select out, and that's a loss for everyone. Sofar operates at the intersection of ocean science, climate, and technology — the problems we're solving are consequential, and the perspectives we bring to them matter. We're actively working to build a team that reflects that. **Sofar Ocean is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.** Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

That's how this team builds the infrastructure, tooling, and observability our AI agents need to run reliably at scale, often several efforts at once. We're also in the middle of rethinking how we deploy and operate agents in production, pushing quality and safety checks earlier in the pipeline and raising our bar for release velocity and stability. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer- Rust / C++
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Thomson Reuters is hiring Senior Software Engineers to build the core of the document\-processing platform behind our AI products. The platform turns very large volumes of documents, millions of pages a day, into clean, structured output through a queue\-driven pipeline. It powers flagship products like Westlaw and CoCounsel and serves internal product teams across the company. The work is mostly Rust in DU Core, with regular work in the C\#/.NET services (DU Apps) that sit in front of it. As a Senior Software Engineer II, you’ll lead high\-impact projects across Core and Apps, shape how the platform evolves, and set the technical bar for the team. **Key Responsibilities:** * Turn asks into requirements. Take requirements from product owners and consuming teams, and propose your own improvements. Turn them into clear functional and technical requirements: the problem, who is asking, how much traffic it affects, acceptance criteria, non\-goals, and how we’ll know it worked * Design with explicit trade\-offs. Write design docs and ADRs that include all the options considered and why the chosen solution won out. Cover cost, latency, quality, failure modes, operability and security, not just the happy path. * Define the architecture. Shape how our services are designed, deployed and run on Azure, and decide where the boundaries between services belong. * Find and fix bottlenecks. Use production metrics, profiling, latency distributions and traffic mix to find where the pipeline is slow or wasteful, and to set timeouts, limits, concurrency and rollout plans. Back decisions with benchmarks and load tests, and be clear about what the results do and don’t show. * Build and run the processing pipeline end to end. It’s a queue\-driven pipeline that handles millions of pages per day. That means autoscaling, rate limiting, retries and failover across third\-party vendors, very large inputs, and streaming with bounded memory while minimizing latency and maximizing throughput. * Work across Core and Apps. You’ll likely spend most of your time in the core backend Rust services, but be willing to pivot to C\#/.NET to support the customer\-facing services that sit in front of them. * Evolve contracts safely. Change message schemas, API surfaces and feature flags across services, and often across repos, in one coordinated change. Internal product teams depend on our output, so keep changes additive and backward compatible, ship with a rollout and rollback plan that covers every side, and return errors that consumers can act on. * Keep a strong engineering mindset. Prefer simple designs over convoluted ones, deliver in small reviewable steps, test at the right layers, and leave code better than you found it. * Work agentically. Write specs and plans that coding agents can carry out, break work into reviewable pieces, and check agent output with tests and evidence. Evaluate AI tools for specific use cases. You own the correctness every line you merge, whoever or whatever wrote it. * Improve how humans and agents work here. Evolve our agent instructions, skills and review automation so they capture what the team knows, and measure whether they help. Write code, docs and PRs clear enough that a new teammate and an AI agent can both understand the intent, constraints and invariants. * Own it in production. Instrument services so you can see how they behave, take part in the on\-call rotation and incident response, write blameless postmortems, and turn what you learn into lasting fixes. * Lead high\-impact work. Own the design and rollout of large projects from requirements through production, break * them into pieces the team can deliver, and keep the vision for where they’re headed. * Raise the team’s bar. Mentor engineers and set the standard in code and design review. Influence direction. Translate business needs into technical solutions, explain hard trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical audiences, and shape product and platform decisions with consuming teams and leadership * **Required Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of professional software development experience building and operating backend services in production in Rust or C\+\+. If your background is C\+\+, you should be keen to work in Rust day to day. * Experience leading complex projects across teams, including architecture for multi\-region or highly available systems. * Experience designing features with privacy and compliance requirements in mind, and building those requirements into code. * Deep distributed\-systems expertise: message queues and at\-least\-once delivery, idempotency, backpressure, retries and timeouts, failure detection, and autoscaling. * Experience choosing between storage options (relational, NoSQL and others) for a given workload. * A record of performance work at scale: profiling, benchmarking, memory budgets, concurrency limits, and handling inputs that don’t fit in memory * A track record of written design work (d catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. jobs.title: Sr Scientist, Tech - Science
jobs.description: **About the Role** The Rider team is the centerpiece of the Uber consumer experience, owning the flagship app used by over 100M monthly active users. The Personalization team builds the ranking, recommendation and agentic systems that shape what millions of riders see and do in the app. We are looking for a Senior Scientist to bring scientific rigor to this work and to help set its direction. You will be an experimentation and causal inference expert with strong ML fluency who will own how we measure whether our AI/ML systems are working, and you will use deep\-dive analysis to show the team where the biggest opportunities are. You will partner closely with applied scientists and ML engineers to ensure we can trust our results, understand why a model wins or loses, and focus the roadmap on what moves rider outcomes. **What You'll Do*** Own experimentation for personalization. Design, run and analyze experiments for ranking, recommendation and agentic features. This includes interleaving, holdouts, switchbacks, and variance reduction (e.g., CUPED/regression adjustment). Use difference\-in\-differences, synthetic control, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, or propensity methods, and be clear about the identifying assumptions. * Close the gap between offline and online evaluation. Build offline evaluation and simulation frameworks (e.g., NDCG/MRR, counterfactual and off\-policy evaluation). Diagnose why offline gains don't show up online, including novelty effects, distribution shift and training\-serving skew. * Go deep on the data. Run deep\-dive analyses of rider behavior, funnels, and ranking and recommendation outcomes. Include heterogeneous treatment effects and long\-term versus short\-term tradeoffs. Surface proactive insights that change what the team builds next. * Define success, guardrail and long\-term metrics for personalization surfaces. Make results easy to find and use through dashboards, query templates and debugging tools. * Shape the roadmap. jobs.description: **Job no:** 503959 **College / VP Area:** College of Engineering **Work type:** Faculty **Location:** Newark, DE **Categories:** Biomedical Engineering **Tenure\-Track Faculty Position in Biomedical Engineering** **Musculoskeletal Bioengineering** The Biomedical Engineering Department (BME, www.bme.udel.edu) at the University of Delaware (UD) invites applications for tenure\-track assistant professor in basic and preclinical Musculoskeletal Research that includes, but is not limited to, understanding the physical and biological mechanisms of musculoskeletal structure and function, applied research in musculoskeletal disorders, and strategies for therapeutic interventions. Research can span a range of length scales from organisms to molecules. Successful applicants will be part of the Delaware Center for Musculoskeletal Research (DCMR), an NIH\-funded Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE). The DCMR recently received NIH Phase II funding to support multiple new faculty across collaborating departments with opportunities for joint appointments. The DCMR provides research infrastructure and supports faculty success with mentoring and funding opportunities. UD BME is ABET accredited with world class research programs in musculoskeletal biomechanics, disease modeling, drug delivery, nanomedicine, neuro\-engineering, and cell and tissue engineering. Successful applicants will share in our vision to be a BME department recognized for high impact research and delivering an exceptional engineering education. We seek creative individuals eager to work in a collaborative interdisciplinary environment, have demonstrated research excellence, are outstanding educators and mentors, and will contribute to a climate that attracts and affirms students from various backgrounds. UD BME has new state\-of\-the\-art research laboratories located on the STAR (Science, Technology, and Advanced Research) Campus, a hub of biomedical research and innovation at UD. Core facilities across the UD campus include: the DCMR Research Core (pre\-clinical models, in vivo animal imaging, histology, and biomechanics), the Center for Biomedical and Brain Imaging (3T human and 9\.4T small animal/specimen MRIs), the Delaware Biotechnology Institute (world\-class Bio\-Imaging Center, DNA sequencing \& genotyping, bioinformatics, and proteomics cores), and core labs for human\-based studies. Access to active outpatient clinics is fostered through long\-standing partnerships with UD’s outstanding Physical Therapy Department. UD BME also enjoys close relationships and opportunities for innovative clinical and translational collaborations with Nemours Children’s Health, Thomas Jefferson University, the University of Pennsylvania, and others. UD is home to several outstanding institutes, including the Institute for Engineering Driven Health, the Data Science Institute, and the National Institute of Innovation in Manufacturing Biopharmaceuticals (NIIMBL). UD’s Newark, Delaware campus provides a vibrant college town with convenient access to the major cities of the East Coast. Candidates must have a Ph.D. degree in engineering or a related field. For full consideration, applicants should submit: a cover letter, curriculum vitae, research statement (max 4 pages), a statement on teaching and mentoring (max 2 pages), a statement on leadership and service (max 2 pages), and contact information for at least 3 references. jobs.title: Copy of Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: Vynyl's technologists, designers and product strategists are experts at system modernization, new product development, and rescuing projects in distress. We use the best cloud\-native and AI\-enabled tools, and apply a battle\-tested combination of Agile, Lean, and design thinking to collaboratively solve our client's most pressing challenges \- and do it right the first time. We often work in regulated industries, such as healthcare, financial services, government and education. Our work helps detect diseases, identify kids who need special educational support, applies AI to support complex legal settlements, helps people access mental health services, and so much more. **The Role** ============ As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key leader across the entire software development lifecycle, from conceptual design to deployment and monitoring. You will be responsible for building robust, scalable backend services using Python and AWS Serverless technologies (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge), developing event\-sourced systems that provide complete state history and auditability. A critical component of this role is a demonstrated fluency with modern AI/ML development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, agentic coding tools, large language models). We are looking for candidates who not only use these tools daily but can articulate a clear, thoughtful perspective on their limitations, security implications, and the strategic opportunities they create for the engineering profession. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * **Design** **and implement** highly scalable, cost\-efficient backend services using Python and AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge). * **Architect and build** event\-sourced systems and event\-driven pipelines, ensuring reliable message processing, idempotency, and eventual consistency across distributed services. * **Collaborate** with product managers and designers to translate requirements into technical designs and shippable code. * **Implement** best practices for security, logging, monitoring, and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform or CloudFormation). * **Perform** rigorous code reviews, mentor junior and mid\-level engineers, and drive technical excellence across the team. * **Actively research, propose, and integrate** new technologies and patterns, with a focus on optimizing development velocity and system performance. * **Clearly articulate** a professional point of view on how to effectively, securely, and ethically integrate AI tools into the software development lifecycle. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * **5\+ years** of professional experience in full\-stack software development. * **Expert\-level proficiency** in Python for backend development (including Django). * **Strong** working proficiency with Vue.js (and typescript). * **Deep practical experience** designing, deploying, and maintaining applications using serverless architectures (preferably AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and managed services). * **Proficiency** with SQL, preferably PostgreSQL. * **Solid understanding** of event sourcing and event\-driven architecture patterns, including experience with message brokers or streaming services (e.g., SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or Kinesis). * **Experience** with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code. * **Demonstrated Fluency in AI\-Assisted Development**: Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, hands\-on experience using AI\-powered coding tools to achieve specific, quantifiable productivity gains, while also clearly understanding and mitigating the associated risks (e.g., code quality, security, IP concerns). **Nice to Have** ---------------- * **Experience** with advanced AWS services (e.g., Step Functions, Kinesis, SageMaker). * **Experience** working in a regulated or compliance\-focused environment. * **A Bachelor's or Master's degree** in Computer Science or a related technical field. **AI and the Evolution of Software Engineering \& Ops** ======================================================= All candidates must be prepared to discuss and demonstrate the following during the interview process: * **Practical AI Tool Usage:** Specific examples of AI tools used in professional or personal projects to enhance productivity, solve complex problems, or accelerate development. If you have a preferred agentic tool setup, please share! * **Understanding of AI Limitations:** A clear understanding and articulation of the current technical, ethical, and accuracy limitations of modern AI tools in the engineering context. * **Strategic AI Opportunity:** A viewpoint on how AI tools create new opportunities for software engineering, such as shifting focus from boilerplate code to complex problem\-solving or architectural design. * **Evolution of the Engineering Role:** A well\-articulated point of view on how your role has already changed (e.g., new workflows, skills, ways of collaborating) due to the introduction of AI and how you expect the role to evolve in the coming years based on your assessment of coming advancements in AI tools and technologies. **Application Process** ======================= To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter. Your cover letter should be informed by the "AI and Forward\-Looking Requirements" section above. The hiring process includes: * **Initial** **screening email** * **Technical** **Assessment Interview** * **A Panel Interview** **Salary Range $140,000 \- $175,000** ===================================== **Benefits for Full\-Time Employees** Excellent health, dental, vision, and life insurance Excellent 401(k) plan with annual employer match of 4%

jobs.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer** **San Jose, CA, USA** **12 Months** **$70/HR on W2 OR $80/HR on C2C** **Any visa is fine** **Need candidates who are in California. W2 candidates are encouraged to apply.** Client is an AI\-enhanced security processor company redefining the control and management of every digital system. The company builds silicon\-rooted security and management chips — including the TCU (Trusted Control/Compute Unit) — for AI data center infrastructure, combining platform security, BMC/firmware, and on\-chip AI for real\-time threat detection and dynamic power/thermal management. **Job Description** **About the role** We’re looking for an ML engineer who works across the full stack from model to silicon — comfortable optimizing training and inference performance on GPU/AI\-accelerator infrastructure, building or tuning models, and adapting model and inference\-engine design to the constraints of the underlying chip and its NPU. You’ll move fluidly between algorithm work, systems\-level software, and infrastructure work, closing the loop end\-to\-end rather than owning just one layer of the stack. This is a rare chance to work the full cycle of AI silicon, from model down to chip — something most ML engineers at large companies never get access to. **What you’ll do** * Optimize training and inference performance across GPU and AI\-accelerator infrastructure, including MLOps pipelines * Design, train, and evaluate ML models (deep learning, LLM, CV, or recommendation systems) and take them into production * Harden and extend NPU cores (e.g. building on an open RVV/tensor core like CoralNPU) into production silicon * Build or optimize inference engines and serving runtimes against real hardware constraints — latency, memory, and power * Work below the application layer where needed — BMC firmware, embedded Linux, or RTOS (e.g. Zephyr) — so AI features run reliably on real systems * Build automated test/verification harnesses that close the loop for AI\-assisted RTL/DV, hardware bring\-up, or manufacturing test * Apply ML to security — AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security work * Collaborate closely with RTL/hardware, firmware, and QA teams to ship AI features end\-to\-end, from training through deployment and monitoring **Requirements:** * 8\-10\+ years of hands\-on AI/ML experience; Master’s required, PhD preferred * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML infrastructure and performance — GPU clusters, distributed training, inference\-serving optimization, MLOps pipelines * Model / algorithm development experience — designing, training, and evaluating ML models * Experience taking models into production — feature engineering, data pipelines, deployment * AI chip / hardware\-aware ML experience — optimizing inference engines for a specific chip, or adapting model architecture/quantization to chip constraints * Deep, hands\-on expertise in at least 2 of the following 5 specialty areas — we don’t expect all five: – **NPU / AI\-accelerator —** hardening or extending an NPU core into production silicon, mapping models onto MAC/tensor\-engine constraints, or NPU\-aware RTL/DV work – **Systems / Sys\-level software —** BMC firmware, embedded Linux, RTOS (e.g. Zephyr), or other low\-level system software – **Inference engine / runtime —** built or materially optimized an inference engine or serving runtime against real hardware constraints – **Test / verification harness —** built an automated harness that closes a loop, e.g. an agent\-driven RTL/DV test runner or a hardware bring\-up / MFG test harness – **Cyber security —** AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security

jobs.title: Cloud Developer
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The Cloud Developer performs critical infrastructure and development functions for Vanderbilt’s growing initiatives in digital scholarship, cloud\-based research computing, and generative AI (GenAI) deployment. Working closely with technologists across the Heard Libraries and other campus units, the Cloud Developer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the scalable cloud infrastructure required to make research data scalable and accessible. Given the agile, collaborative nature of the work unit, this role demands a blend of deep technical execution, nimble project management, and mentorship capabilities. The Cloud Developer will serve as a "Principal Engineer" within our experiential learning programs, helping to manage student developers, architect "fail\-fast" innovations, and scale computational solutions for wide impact. **About the Work Unit:** The Jean and Alexander Heard Libraries at Vanderbilt University comprise nine libraries and multiple specialized service departments. The libraries are fundamental to the university’s goal of advancing scholarship and learning by collecting, preserving, and making accessible a wide variety of resources,and partnering with faculty and students to shape research. The Digital Lab advances the creation, development, and sustainability of faculty and student\-driven digital projects. As an applied research and learning center, the Lab transforms unstructured library collections into machine\-readable computational assets and builds cutting\-edge software solutions leveraging generative AI. The AWS\-sponsored Vanderbilt Cloud Innovation Lab (VCIL), which provides immersive, hands\-on software development experiences for student fellows, is a core focus of this work. By embedding students directly into professional engineering workflows as junior developers, the Digital Lab bridges advanced faculty research, technical mentorship, and scalable cloud infrastructure to broaden computational innovation across campus. **Key Functions and Expected Performance:** Cloud Architecture \& Software Development Design, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable cloud infrastructure (primarily AWS) to host digital scholarship platforms and process massive library archives. Implement and scale generative AI pipelines and machine\-learning models to automate metadata enrichment and text extraction. Ensure faculty and institutional projects are built on modern, sustainable, and well\-documented technical stacks that integrate efficiently with broader university infrastructure. **Position Description** Project Management \& Operational Delivery Manage the full lifecycle of assigned digital projects, tracking timelines, deliverables, and resource allocation across partner units. Serve as an agile project manager for select faculty\-driven R\&D initiatives, ensuring transparent communication and consistent progress. Coordinate technical requirements and scope with key campus partners, including Research IT, the Advanced Computing Center for Research \& Education (ACCRE), and the Data Science Institute. Student Mentorship \& Team Leadership Recruit, interview, and hire undergraduate and graduate student fellows and research assistants. Act as a "Principal Engineer" by embedding students into professional software development workflows, conducting code reviews, and providing technical mentorship. Guide student teams through real\-world deployment challenges, balancing structured learning with hands\-on software delivery. Sustained Innovation \& Grant Support In coordination with Digital Lab leadership, write staff technical expertise and infrastructure costs into external grant applications. Explore and implement "fail\-fast" innovations using emerging technologies to maintain the Lab's best\-in\-class standing in GenAI and research computing. **Education and Certifications** Undergraduate degree in computer science, cloud computing, data science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience and industry certifications is required. Postgraduate degree preferred. resources and costs related to data processing. * Lead efforts to improve data quality, lineage, and metadata management. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand and prioritize data needs for strategic initiatives. **JOB QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:** **Knowledge/Experience:** * 6\+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or a related field * Bachelor's degree in Computer programming languages considered * Extensive experience with data orchestration tools like Prefect or Airflow * Strong experience with data transformation and modeling tools like dbt and data the major cloud platforms required, Azure preferred * Leadership skills for mentoring and guiding junior team members * Problem\-solving skills for complex data engineering challenges. * Effective communication for collaborating with cross\-functional teams * Project management abilities for overseeing multiple data projects **Salary:** $155,000 \- $189,000 per year*; in addition to base jobs.title: Senior Service Leader

jobs.title: Lead Designer, Digital Experience Standards
jobs.description: **About the Team/Role:** As the Lead Designer for Digital Experience Standards at WEX Inc., you will set and hold the bar for experience quality across our digital portfolio and codify it through scalable platforms. Reporting to the Director of Digital Platforms \& Practice, you are a senior individual contributor accountable for how our products look, sound, and feel as more of the experience is generated by agents rather than assembled by hand. This is a “tastemaker” role. We define taste as the ability to draw from deep customer empathy, consider your product’s brand tone, voice, and identity, and channel them into an end\-to\-end experience that is consistent, recognizable, seamless, and delightful. As AI collapses the cost of producing an interface, taste becomes the constraint that matters—and the difference between a portfolio that feels intentional and one that merely functions. This role sits within WEX’s centralized digital standards and practices group. While design teams are aligned to individual product lines, this position connects that work through shared standards, design systems, and AI\-enabled practices. You will influence quality across dozens of web and mobile experiences, partner with the branding team, and coach designers rather than own a single product’s roadmap. If you hold strong opinions about craft, have an instinct for what customers feel but do not say, and can encode that judgment so other people—and agents—apply it at scale, this is the role for you. **What You’ll Do:** * **Set Experience Standards \& Taste:** Define what “good” looks like across the portfolio and encode it as standards, patterns, and reference examples that any designer or agent can apply without you in the room. * **Make Coherence Scalable:** Build a system in which experiences feel recognizably WEX in brand, tone, voice, and interaction regardless of which team or agent produced them. * **Lead Portfolio\-Level Critique:** Lead critique and calibration that builds judgment in other designers and raises craft rather than policing it. * **Anticipate Emerging Modalities:** Bring a point of view on voice, conversational, and multimodal interaction so standards anticipate how customers will work rather than how they have worked. * **Own the Design OS for the Agentic Lifecycle:** Own the reusable components, skills, standards, and machine\-readable context that agents invoke to generate consistent UI in ADLC Foundations Hub and Discovery \& Delivery Systems. * **Translate Design Intent into Build\-Ready Artifacts:** Partner with the design system engineer to create tokens, patterns, schemas, and documentation that both humans and agents can consume. * **Make Quality the Default:** Make the standard the path of least resistance, so generated experiences inherit accessibility, usability, and brand quality by default rather than by review. * **Use AI\-Assisted Coding and Prototyping:** Use modern AI\-assisted coding and prototyping tools to explore concepts, test interactions, and operationalize repeatable design guidance. Tools discussed for this role include Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex. * **Define Experience Quality Measurement:** Establish an enterprise experience quality rubric with dimensions, criteria, and severity scales for usability, accessibility, brand and voice coherence, language clarity, and end\-to\-end journey quality. * **Build Agentic Evaluation at Scale:** Develop evaluation capabilities that allow agents to navigate live customer portals, mobile apps, and internal tools across full journeys and return evidence\-backed findings. * **Make Quality Visible to Leadership:** Produce a portfolio\-level experience quality index and heat map showing strengths, weaknesses, and specific quality dimensions across lines of business. * **Connect Quality to Business Outcomes:** Correlate experience quality with NPS, CSAT, and customer trust measures, and use those signals to direct standards, coaching, and investment toward experiences where customer risk is highest. * **Partner and Influence Across Teams:** Work with product designers, engineering, and the branding team to unify experiences across WEX’s digital portfolio and raise the quality and polish of web and mobile products. * **Coach Without Direct People Management:** Coach and mentor designers across product teams, bringing exceptional visual/UI design taste and attention to detail while maintaining a collaborative, outcome\-focused approach. **What You Bring:** * **Design Experience:** Approximately 8–10 years of product, system, web, or related design experience across multiple products or portfolios. * **Exceptional Visual/UI Craft:** Demonstrated visual design taste, artistic judgment, strong attention to detail, and a high bar for polish and aesthetics across digital experiences. * **Standards and Systems Thinking:** Ability to define, document, and scale design standards, patterns, and systems that improve consistency and quality across teams and products. * **AI\-Native Design Practice:** Strong fluency with AI coding and prototyping tools, including tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex, and the ability to use them practically in design workflows. * **Machine\-Readable Design Guidance:** Understanding of how to express design standards and context in reusable, structured formats such as Design MD/design.md so people and AI agents can apply them consistently. * **Customer\-Centered Judgment:** Deep customer empathy and the ability to translate customer needs, brand identity, tone, voice, and interaction principles into cohesive end\-to\-end experiences. * **Collaboration and Influence:** Low\-ego, collaborative, and outcome\-focused approach with the ability to influence designers and cross\-functional partners without relying on direct authority. **Nice to Have:** * Background in graphic design, web design, human factors, or another related artistic or design discipline. * Experience coaching or mentoring designers across multiple product teams or portfolios. * Familiarity with general\-purpose AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini; this is useful but does not replace practical fluency with AI coding and prototyping tools. * UX boot camp experience. **Why This Role Matters:** WEX is working to unify the quality of digital experiences across business lines while expanding the use of AI in how those experiences are designed and built. This role will help shape the standards, systems, and evaluation practices that make high\-quality, accessible, recognizable WEX experiences repeatable across dozens of web and mobile products. By turning design judgment into reusable guidance for both people and agents, the role helps WEX scale experience quality without relying on manual review alone. The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non\-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well\-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section. Pay Range: $154,600\.00 \- $171,500\.00

specifications for proposed solutions. **Required Qualifications:** Six (6\) years of progressively more complex problem solving as a developer designing, developing or maintaining large\-scale MVC, Entity Framework, SQL, TFS, SharePoint, etc. **OR** Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or closely allied field. **AND** Seven (7\) years of programming experience with Java and/or .NET technologies and/or C\# .NET framework. Seven years of experience working with relational databases (JDBC, SQL). **AND** * The ability to take action to learn and grow * The ability to take action to meet the needs of others. **Additional Required Qualifications:** * Working knowledge of Agile values and principles as they apply to application development. * Working knowledge of Scrum development methodologies, artifacts and traditions. * Working knowledge of DevOps concepts. * Experience working in a highly regulated environment where IT assets and data are subject to a broad range of State and federal information security requirements and regulations. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience maintaining and supporting IT applications in a 7 day a week / 24 hour a day availability situation. * Agile Training or Certification. * Data Engineer, Data Scientist, Data Architect, or Solution Architect certifications. * .NET Developer training or certification * Experience in SCRUM, Agile, and iterative development processes. **How do I apply?** Complete your applicant profile on careers.wa.gov and attach the following documents: * Current resume detailing experience and education. * Letter of Interest that de s the flexibility to choose between multiple investment options. **Social Security** All state employees are covered by the federal Social Security and Medicare systems. The state and the employee pay an equal amount into the system. **Public Service Loan Forgiveness** If you are employed by a government or not\-for\-profit organization, and meet the qualifying criteria, you may be eligible to receive student loan forgiveness under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. **Holidays** Full\-time and part\-time employees are entitled to paid holidays and one paid personal holiday per calendar year. **Note:** Employees who are members of certain Unions may be entitled to additional personal leave day(s), please refer to position specific Collective Bargaining Agreements for more information*.* Full\-time employees who work full monthly schedules qualify for holiday compensation if they are employed before the holiday and are in pay status for at least 80 nonovertime hours during the month of the holiday; or for the entire work shift preceding the holiday. Part\-time employees who are in pay status during the month of the holiday qualify for the holiday on a pro\-rata basis. Compensation for holidays (including personal holiday) will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status in the month to that required for full\-time employment, excluding all holiday hours. Pay status includes hours worked and time on paid leave. **Sick Leave** Full\-time employees earn eight hours of sick leave per month. Overtime eligible employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month, earn a monthly proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Overtime exempt employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month do not earn a monthly accrual of sick leave. Sick leave accruals for part\-time employees will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. **Vacation (Annual Leave)** Full\-time employees accrue vacation leave at the rates specified in WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA). Full\-time employees who are in pay status for less than 80 nonovertime hours in a month do not earn a monthly accrual of vacation leave. Part\-time employees accrue vacation leave hours in accordance with WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) on a pro rata basis. Vacation leave accrual will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. As provided in WAC 357\-58\-175, an employer may authorize a lump\-sum accrual of vacation leave or accelerate the vacation leave accrual rate to support the recruitment and/or retention of a candidate or employee for a Washington Management Service position. Vacation leave accrual rates may only be accelerated using the rates established WAC 357\-31\-165\. **Note:** Most agencies follow the civil service rules covering leave and holidays for **exempt** employees even though there is no requirement for them to do so. However, agencies are required to adhere to the applicable RCWs pertaining holidays and leave. **Military Leave** Washington State supports members of the armed forces with 21 days paid military leave per year. **Bereavement Leave** Most employees whose family member or household member dies, or for loss of pregnancy, are entitled to five (5\) days of paid bereavement leave. In addition, the employer may approve other available leave types for the purpose of bereavement leave. **Additional Leave** Leave Sharing Parental Leave Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Leave Without Pay Please visit the State HR Website for more detailed information regarding benefits. jobs.title: IT Engineer
jobs.description: Location San Francisco Type Full\-Time Department Tech Compensation $132,000 \- $147,000 **About Watershed** ------------------- Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit\-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product\-building, want to work hard at a mission\-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us! **The role** ------------ As an IT Engineer at Watershed, you’ll own the internal technology and SaaS platforms our teams rely on every day and shape how employees experience IT across our global offices. It’s an exciting time to join: we’ve equipped employees with best\-in\-class AI tools, and you’ll help define what modern IT looks like when AI is woven into how we work. You’ll support employees directly while designing agent\-driven workflows, integrations, and self\-service resources that reduce toil and turn repetitive tickets into well\-engineered systems that make your colleagues’ lives meaningfully better. As we grow globally, you’ll have real ownership over the systems you build and a direct hand in shaping where IT goes next, partnering closely with teammates in San Francisco and London. We’re looking for someone with deep experience who finds joy in solving problems for people, thrives in a creative, collaborative environment, and has the judgment to balance quick fixes with long\-term engineering. If you’re customer\-obsessed, hard\-working, proactive, inclusive, and optimistic, you’ll fit right in. This position is based in our San Francisco office, where you’ll work four days per week as part of our in\-office culture. ### **You will:** * Design and implement scalable IT solutions that enhance employee productivity and security across our global offices * Manage and maintain our core IT systems, including Okta, Kolide, Iru (formerly Kandji), Google Workspace, Notion, and Slack * Develop and optimize our global asset management processes for employee devices throughout their lifecycle * Build and maintain reliable automations and integrations across our IT systems, reducing repetitive work in onboarding, access management, device operations, and support * Own and improve employee onboarding, role change, and offboarding lifecycle processes through reliable provisioning, access controls, automation, and device workflows in partnership with People and Security * Partner with Security, People, Workplace, Engineering, and our external IT support provider to deliver reliable services and a thoughtful employee experience * Serve as an escalation point for elevated hardware, software, and network\-related issues, as well as occasional in\-person support within the San Francisco office * Maintain a secure, reliable macOS fleet through device provisioning, configuration, patching, endpoint protection, and compliance monitoring * Manage and optimize our conference room technology and A/V systems * Turn recurring issues into lasting improvements through root\-cause analysis, clear run books, employee\-facing guidance, and self\-service tools; maintain IT policies and procedures that support consistent service delivery * Use AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, system architecture design and workflow development * Administer and support our AI platforms, including Claude, ChatGPT, Dust.tt, and Notion AI, managing access, configuration, integrations, and secure adoption across the company ### **You might be a good fit if:** * You have 3\+ years of increasing experience and responsibility in IT at high\-growth technology companies * You have hands\-on experience administering Okta, including SSO, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows, and understand least\-privilege access * You have hands\-on experience using AI to improve your work, can explain where it has helped, and know when to verify its output or use a different approach * You’re comfortable building scripts, using APIs, and workflow automation to solve operational problems, and you test, document, and maintain what you build * You have experience managing and supporting Mac\-based environments * You have experience with asset management systems and lifecycle management for employee devices * You're knowledgeable about IT security best practices and compliance requirements * You have excellent problem\-solving abilities and a track record of managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment * You're an effective communicator with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * You have experience supporting a breadth of modern SaaS applications * You have experience managing vendor relationships and external service providers * You're passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and find fulfillment in helping others succeed ### **Nice to have:** * First\-hand experience building custom tools and applications to solve internal business challenges * Experience with zero\-trust security frameworks * Knowledge of corporate networking fundamentals and troubleshooting * Familiarity with office setup and infrastructure planning * Direct experience with IT compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO) * Industry certifications related to our technology stack (e.g., Okta, Google Workspace, Cisco) **Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)** Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so. **What’s the interview process like?** It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process. **What if I need accommodations for my interview?** At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long\-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy\-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.
