jobs.title: Director, TechEx, Software Engineering
jobs.description: **Are you ready to make an impact?** **Director, TechEx, Software Engineering** From building customer\-facing software to integrating complex platforms and modernizing legacy systems, we help clients use technology to solve important business problems. We bring software engineering, cloud, data, and AI together to design and deliver secure, scalable solutions. This includes embedding AI capabilities into applications and platforms, modernizing systems to support AI, and helping engineering teams adopt AI across the software development lifecycle. As a Director in our Technology \& Experience Practice Software discipline, you will help clients turn AI opportunities into practical engineering solutions. You will build client relationships, shape new opportunities, and lead teams delivering custom software, AI\-enabled applications, platform integration, legacy modernization, and engineering transformation. You will help clients move from AI experimentation to production by aligning business needs with architecture, data, integration, security, governance, and delivery plans. You should be passionate about solving business problems with technology and ready to contribute to West Monroe’s fast\-growing, entrepreneurial environment. **What will you be doing?** The primary responsibility of this role is business development: winning new clients, growing existing relationships, and partnering with our industry teams to generate opportunities across the practice. You will focus on software engineering, modernization, and applying AI to technology solutions and delivery. You will also own client relationships, lead engagements, ensure strong delivery outcomes and client satisfaction, and help grow our engineering and AI capabilities. As a Director within West Monroe, you are responsible for: **Business Development** * Lead and collaborate with industry segment teams and key accounts on account planning and growth. * Use your network of technology, engineering, and AI executives, including CIOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers, and software engineering leaders—to secure executive introductions and generate new business. * Identify opportunities where software engineering, modernization, and AI can address client priorities. Shape solutions, develop proposals and SOWs, apply onshore and nearshore delivery models, build client relationships, and close deals. * Help clients define practical paths from AI strategy and experimentation to production solutions, including AI\-enabled applications, intelligent agents, and AI\-supported engineering workflows. * Develop go\-to\-market messaging and sales materials that explain how West Monroe applies AI within software engineering and modernization engagements. * Create work plans, pricing estimates, and risk assessments for potential engagements, including plans that address data, architecture, integration, security, governance, and adoption considerations. * Contribute thought leadership on AI\-enabled software engineering, application modernization, and responsible AI delivery. * Attend networking events and build relationships across the local professional and affiliate community. * Identify partnerships that can generate revenue for software engineering and AI capabilities, and work with our partnerships team to develop those relationships and pursue opportunities. **Client Leadership** * Advise senior client executives on how to apply AI to business and technology challenges, connecting strategic goals to feasible software solutions and delivery plans. * Lead teams that design, architect, and deliver custom software, AI\-enabled applications, intelligent agents, and modernized platforms that create measurable business value. * Help clients identify and prioritize AI use cases, assess technical readiness, and determine the data, architecture, integration, and operating model needed to take solutions into production. * Guide modernization efforts that make applications and platforms more scalable, secure, adaptable, and ready to support AI capabilities. * Lead client engagements and take overall accountability for successful delivery, demonstrating executive presence with senior client stakeholders. * Provide quality assurance and hold regular executive check\-ins to confirm that engagements are delivering and communicating value. * Work with program and project leaders to establish processes and technology that improve business outcomes and efficiency across business and technical functions. * Lead multidisciplinary teams in translating business objectives into software engineering strategies, architectures, and delivery plans. * Help clients incorporate AI into the software development lifecycle, including appropriate uses for coding, testing, documentation, and developer productivity. * Address responsible implementation throughout delivery, including security, privacy, governance, model evaluation, human oversight, and ongoing monitoring. * Identify, develop, and apply re g, growing, and closing large software engineering, modernization, or AI\-related opportunities using onshore and nearshore delivery models. * Expertise in sales strategy, business development, pricing, account management, sales operations, sales enablement, and bringing new services to market. * Ability to combine technical experience with strong management and leadership skills, including client relationship management, business case development, and engineering delivery leadership. * Experience selling software engineering or technology services in one or more of these industries: Healthcare, Financial Services, Energy \& Utilities, High\-Tech and Software, Life Sciences, Private Equity, Consumer \& Industrial Products, and Insurance. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively to coordinate and drive sales processes. Enter description here Based on pay transparency guidelines, a reasonable expectation for the salary range for this role is listed below. Employees are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan, purchase shares from our employee stock ownership program and be eligible to receive annual bonuses. Employees will also receive unlimited flexible time off and ten paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Eligibility for ten weeks of paid parental leave will also be available upon hire date. National $200,000 \- $250,000 USD ### **Other consultancies talk at you.** **At West Monroe, we work with you.** We’re a global business and technology consulting firm passionate about creating measurable value for our clients, delivering real\-world solutions. jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager

Your expertise in modern data technologies and methodologies will ensure our data architecture is robust, scalable, and efficient. AWS and GCP experience a plus. * Strong experience database modeling, data architecture and design, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Experience with data quality, validation, and governance processes. * Solid background in scripting and software development. * Demonstrated experience in agile software development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.), project management, ITIL concepts, service desk management and incident and request management. * Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to mentor, inspire, and drive high performance. * Experience in Redshift, SQL Server, Oracle, and other data warehouse platforms a big plus. * Experience in real\-time stream processing and data ingestion a big plus. * Result\-oriented with exceptional analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Willing to work odd and irregular hours including nights, weekends, and holidays * Willing to travel and participate in training as recommended or required * Must have a valid and current State Driver's License and an insurable driving record for purposes of driving company vehicles as required * Must have a Tribal Gaming License (or the ability to obtain and maintain a license) as a requirement for this position * Must have willingness and ability to work in a smoke/secondary smoke environment **NATIVE AMERICAN INDIAN PREFERENCE IN HIRING POLICY SHALL BE ADHERED TO AT ALL TIMES** **Complaints about the recruitment or selection process for employment should be directed in writing to office of the President and CEO of Wind Creek Hospitality.**

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: At Worthington Enterprises, we are not just experimenting with AI—we are embedding it into how we operate, make decisions, and create value for our customers. We are looking for a hands\-on, forward\-thinking AI Engineer to transform governed enterprise data into impactful business solutions. You will build and deploy AI\-powered applications, agents, predictive models, and intelligent workflows that help people work more efficiently, make better decisions, and improve operational performance. This is an opportunity to shape reusable enterprise AI patterns, tackle meaningful manufacturing and business challenges, and see your solutions progress from idea to measurable impact. **This hybrid role is based in Columbus, Ohio, and requires at 2 to 3 days per week on\-site**. Occasional travel—approximately 10%—to corporate and manufacturing locations may be required. **This position is not eligible for relocation assistance or U.S. work sponsorship.** **What You'll Do** * Design, build, deploy, and improve AI applications including enterprise agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), natural\-language analytics, predictive models, and workflow automations. * Build Snowflake\-native AI and ML solutions using capabilities such as Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, semantic views and structured\-data tools, Cortex AI functions, Snowpark, Model Registry, and Feature Store where appropriate. * Engineer retrieval and context pipelines for structured and unstructured data, including ingestion, chunking, metadata, hybrid search, citations, permissions, and freshness. * Create reliable agentic workflows in n8n or comparable orchestration platforms, incorporating tool calling, human approval, retries, idempotency, secrets management, auditability, and exception handling. * Develop secure integrations with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, enterprise APIs, databases, file sources, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. * Establish evaluation and monitoring practices for answer quality, task completion, drift, safety, latency, cost, adoption, and business value. * Apply software engineering practices including modular design, automated testing, code review, Git\-based delivery, CI/CD, documentation, and production support. * Partner with business teams to frame opportunities, prototype quickly, translate ambiguity into a delivery plan, and guide adoption of solutions that are useful and trusted. * Contribute reusable patterns, standards, and guardrails that help other teams and AI Champions build responsibly. * Continuously evaluate new models and capabilities, separating durable value from short\-lived hype. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, information systems, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. * Typically 3–5 years of relevant experience in AI/ML engineering, software engineering, data engineering, or data science, including evidence of delivering at least one AI\-enabled solution beyond a one\-off prototype. * Strong Python and SQL skills, plus experience with APIs, source control, testing, and maintainable application or pipeline development. * Hands\-on experience with one or more of the following: LLM applications, RAG, tool\-using agents, natural\-language analytics, ML pipelines, or intelligent automation. * Understanding of data modeling, identity and access control, privacy, secure development, and responsible AI principles. * Ability to evaluate AI system quality systematically and diagnose failure modes rather than relying on anecdotal testing. * Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to both technical and business partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Snowflake AI/ML experience, especially Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, semantic views, Snowpark, Model Registry, Feature Store, or related capabilities. * n8n or comparable workflow/agent orchestration experience such as Workato, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar tools. * MCP, function/tool calling, structured outputs, event\-driven integrations, containers, serverless services, or cloud application delivery. * LLMOps/MLOps practices, evaluation frameworks, observability, model/prompt versioning, Docker, CI/CD, or MLflow. * Enterprise knowledge and productivity integrations involving Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, or governed data catalogs such as Alation. * Experience applying AI in manufacturing, supply chain, finance, operations, or another industrial domain. **Team and Collaboration Context** You will join the Corporate IT – Data, Analytics \& AI team and partner with data engineering, analytics, architecture, security, infrastructure, and business functions. We value curiosity, sound judgment, disciplined experimentation, and people who enjoy turning difficult business problems into simple, reliable experiences. **Why Worthington?** Worthington is applying modern AI inside a real operating business, where better data, smarter automation, and trusted decision support can improve how work gets done every day. This role offers the opportunity to build enterprise AI products that move beyond demos and become part of the way employees ask questions, automate tasks, and make decisions. **Benefits** * Health, dental, and vision insurance starting on the first day, including employer HSA contribution. * On\-site medical center, pharmacy, barbershop, and fitness center. * 401(k) match plus employer contribution. * Employee Assistance Program. * Flexible work schedule. * Quarterly profit sharing, with no cap. Our Company is proud to have a dynamic and inclusive workforce where employees are empowered to innovate, thrive and grow. We believe that each employee’s unique strengths contribute to the success of our organization. This belief extends to how we consider our job applicants. Your talents may align with this position or other opportunities within our organization. Apply today to start unlocking your career potential with Worthington Enterprises. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in the application and hiring process. If you are interested in employment with Worthington Enterprises and need an accommodation or assistance using the careers website, please contact careers@wthg.com. Worthington Enterprises (NYSE: WOR) is a designer and manufacturer of market\-leading brands that help improve everyday life by elevating spaces and experiences. The Company operates with two primary business units: Building Products and Consumer Products. The Building Products segment includes cooking, heating, cooling and water solutions, architectural and acoustical grid ceilings and metal framing and accessories. The Consumer Products segment provides solutions for the tools, outdoor living and celebrations categories. Product brands within the Worthington Enterprises portfolio include Balloon Time®, Bernzomatic®, Coleman® (propane cylinders), CoMet®, Elgen, Garden Weasel®, General®, HALO™, Hawkeye™, Level5 Tools®, Mag Torch®, NEXI™, Pactool International®, PowerCore™, Ragasco®, Well\-X\-Trol® and XLite™, among others. Founded in 1955 as Worthington Industries, Worthington Enterprises follows a people\-first Philosophy with earning money for its shareholders as its first corporate goal. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, Worthington Enterprises and its joint ventures employ approximately 6,000 people throughout North America and Europe.

jobs.title: Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: Great benefits. Competitive pay. We know these are some of the things people look for in a job. controls. * Serve as a security subject matter expert for the organization and third\-party vendors. * Design and administer identity and access management controls, including authentication, SKILLS, \& ABILITIES** * Strong knowledge of identity management, access controls, permissions, privileges, encryption, web security, intrusion prevention, and data loss prevention technologies. * solutions. * Proven ability to work effectively with teammates, business partners, vendors, and other stakeholders to accomplish objectives and resolve security\-related issues. * Skill in developing clear technical documentation and security training materials. * Strong analytical, diagnostic, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify, assess, and resolve complex security issues. * Strong configuration, implementation, and solution\-design skills. * Self\-motivated and able to take initiative and drive projects to completion in a project\-based environment. * Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, including the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced, evolving environment. * Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when working with sensitive information and security\-related matters. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with individuals of diverse backgrounds and technical skill levels. * Ability to influence others and build consensus without direct authority. * Independent thinker with strong critical\-thinking and analytical capabilities. * Team\-oriented with a desire to collaborate and engage with others in day\-to\-day activities. * Commitment to fostering a positive work environment and supporting team and organizational success. * Unequivocal commitment to the highest standards of personal and business ethics and conduct. * Mission\-driven, guided by core values, and a pleasure to work with. **EXPERIENCE** **Requirements** * Five years of experience working in information security. * Three years of experience designing, implementing, or administering enterprise security technologies and controls. * Experience with identity and access management, security architecture, data protection, cloud security, application security, or related security disciplines. * Experience performing security assessments, risk analyses, vulnerability management, and security control implementation. * Experience partnering with technical and business stakeholders to implement security improvements and best practices. **Preferences** * Experience supporting cloud\-first environments. * Experience supporting Microsoft\-based security ecosystems or comparable enterprise security platforms. * Experience with identity governance, data protection, security operations, or security monitoring technologies. * Experience supporting security governance or compliance initiatives **EDUCATION** **Requirements** * Bachelors’ degree in computer science, information systems, or related field. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Wounded Warrior Project via email, the Internet or directly to hiring managers at Wounded Warrior Project in any form without a valid written search agreement in place will be deemed the sole property of Wounded Warrior Project, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Wounded Warrior Project as a result of the referral or through other means."*
